Bechuanaland, 1888; recvr. of revenue, Vryburg, and P.M.G., Bechuanaland, 1889; examnr. of accts., acctnt. to high comsnr., Cape-town, 1890; paymr. (rank captain), Bech. Br. pol., 1891, combined with prin. cust. offr., for Bech. Prot., 1896; specially employed in charge of finances, Mafeking siege, and financial asst. to mil. govt., Bloemfontein, 1899-1900; transf'd. to S.A.C. as ch. paymstr. and acctnt.-gen. (rank major), Oct., 1900; promoted lt.-col., 1901.

GREENHALGH, N., B.Sc., Hons. (Vic.).—B. 1888; agric. and science master, Antigua gram. schl., 1910; lecturer in agric. science to students of training coll., Antigua; asst. inspr. of schls., Barbados, 1912; lecturer in educ. and master of method, training inst., Codrington Coll.; ag. chief inspr. of schls., Trinidad, 29th June to 4th Oct., 1915.

GREENHILL, MARCUS ARTHUR.—B. 1899; entd. C.O., Sep., 1914; apptd. after compet. exam., asst. clk., C.O., Oct., 1916; on military service, May, 1917, to Feb., 1919.

GREENHOUGH, COL. FREDERICK HARRY, D.S.O., 1918; Offr., Order of Leopold, Chevalier Legion of Honour, 1918, M.I.C.E.—B. 1871; engineering student, Bradford Tech. Coll., 1886 to 1890; asst. engr., S. Devon Double; G.W.R., L.D. and E.C. rly. constnt., Port Talbot rly., and docks, 1890 to 1896; engr. in charge qua. wall constnta. and reclamation, Vera Cruz harb., Mexico, 1896-97; chief engr., Eastern section, Admiralty harb., Dover, 1897 to 1903; chief engr., Admiralty breakwaters, Grand harb., Malta, 1903 to 1907; dist. engnr., Nigerian rly., 1908; engr. in charge open lines constnt. and survey, Lagos terminus, 1909 and 1910; ag. suptgd. engr., 1911; asst. chief engr., 1914; served Br. Army in France, 1915-19 (3 times ment. in desps.); tech. rep. of Br. Army on interallied constn. of rlys., docks and waterways in France, 1917-19; ch. engrnr., 1917; dep. gen. man., 1921.

GREENIDGE, CHARLES WILTON WOOD.—B. 1889; educ. Harrison Coll., Barbados, and Downing Coll., Camb.; B.A. (Nat. Sci. Tripes) 1910; LL.B., 1911; called to the bar, Mid. Tem., 1st May, 1912; 1st cls. hon. criminal law; admitted to bar, Barbados, 1912; assisted indexing revised Laws of Barbados; ag. mag., dist. "F," Barbados, Nov., 1912; ag. mag., dist. "A," June to Nov., 1914; parochial treas., St. James', Barbados, and clk. to boards for poor relief, sanitation and highways, Feb., 1915; ag. mag., dist. "A," Sept., 1915, ditto, dist. "B," Mar., 1916, to Apr., 1919; ag. judge, ct. of appeal, Barbados; mag., dist. "D," St. Kitts, May, 1919; ag. crown atty., St. Kitts, and mem. legis. coun., Aug., 1919, to Jan., 1920.

GREENWAY, J. W.—B. 1861; ed. Ontario schls.; removed to Manitoba, 1879, in charge of schl. lands admtn. in Man. and N.W. Territories (now Sask. and Alta.), 1898; commnr. of Dom. lands, 1904.

GREENWOOD, ALFRED CRAVEN, O.B.E. (1918).—Exec. staff, inventions exhib., 1886, and Col. and Ind. exhib., 1886, and Royal Jubilee exhib., Manchester, 1887; sec. to various charitable instit., 1887 to 1890; priv. sec. to Sir A. Shea, gov. Bahamas, and clk. to coun., 1891-4; treas. of Gibraltar, 1897; J.P. and mem. of sanitary comm., chrmn. at various times, also contract. offr., 1897; ag. capt. of port on various occasions; hosp. commnr., 1903; chrmn. of comitee on wharfage tolls and storage waterport wharf, 1902; chrmn. of comitee on management.
working and revenue of new comm., mole, 1904; ag. pol. mag., inspr. of schls., and coroner on various occasions; ag. col. sec., 1914; chrmn., sanitary commsnr., 1918; chrmn., mkt. comtee., 1918.

GREENWOOD, RENNETT.—B. 1876; called to the bar, Lincoln's Inn, Jan., 1899; N.E. Cir., Leeds, Bradford, West Riding and N. London Sen.; asst. dist. commsnr., S. Nigeria, 23rd Mar., 1907; asst. col. sec., 1st July, 1908; asst. pol. mag., 1st Jan., 1909; pol. mag., 23rd Jan., 1911; ag. solr.-gen., 1912; mem. of special commsnr., Ogota, December, 1912; ag. prizew judge, Dec., 1915; solr.-gen., Sierra Leone, 29th Jan., 1914.

GREENWOOD, THOMAS JAMES.—B. 1864; supt. of transport, Egyptian campaign, 1882; awarded Queen's medal and Khedive's star; inspr. Cyprus pol., Feb., 1887; ag. local comdt., Limassol, Oct. to Dec., 1894, and Apr. to July, 1895, bronze medal, roy. hum. soc., for saving and attempting to save life during Limassol floods, Nov. 12th, 1894; local comdt., Cyprus pol., 1896; ag. commsnr., Kyrenia, May to Nov., 1900; ditto, ditto, Larnaca, Oct. to Dec., 1901; ag. commsnr., Paphos, 1st Nov. to 26th Dec., 1907, and 12th June to 11th Sept., 1914; ditto, ditto, Larnaca, 17th June to 23rd Nov., 1910, 3rd May to 6th Nov., 1912, and 23rd Apr. to 29th Oct., 1915; provost marshal, 15th Aug., 1914 to 31st July, 1921; refugee commsnr., 9th Nov., 1915 to 7th Feb., 1918; cable censor, 7th June, 1916 to 7th Feb., 1918; ag. commsnr., Larnaca, 4th July, 1916 to 10th Feb., 1918; ditto, Paphos, 12th Feb., 1918 to 19th Feb., 1919; commsnr. and coroner, 26th Feb., 1919.

GREGOROWSKI, REGINALD ADDINGTON.—2nd elk., govt. sec.'s office, O.F.S., Dec., 1890; priv. sec. to state pres., 6th Mar., 1896; landdrost elk., Bethlehem, Dec., 1897; priv. sec. to state pres., July, 1898; landdrost elk., Wepener, Jan., 1899; priv., govt. schl., Reddersburg, O.B.C., 1st Oct., 1900; asst. elk., educ. dept., 1st Mar., 1901; ch. elk. and reg., educ. dept., 1st July, 1901; priv. elk., col. sec.'s off., June, 1909; ch. elk. to adminstr., O.F.S. prov., 10th Aug., 1910.

GREGOROWSKI, REINHOLD.—B. 1856; B.A. and Porter scholar, Univ. of Cape of Good Hope; Ist. cls. studentship in Roman and Jurisprudence, Inns of Court, 1877; called to the bar, Gray's Inn, Nov., 1878; judge of sup. ct., O.F.S., 1881-1892; atty.-gen., O.F.S., 1892-96; judge of sup. ct., S. African Republic, 1896-97; atty.-gen., ditto, 1897-98; chief justice, ditto, 1898-1900; M.L.A., Transvaal, 1907-1910; judge of sup. ct., S. Africa, 1912.

GREGORY, CHARLES WILLIAM, M.B.E. (1919).—Natal Mounted pol. (Zululand), 1896-1901; attached to Army Service Corps, 1901-1902; chief storekeeper, central stores, Pretoria, Transvaal repatriation department, 1802-1904; Transvaal civ. ser., 1906; chief storekeeper, P.W.D., East Africa Prot., Sept., 1906.

GREGORY, HON. FRANCIS BROOKE, LL.B.—B. 1862; ed. at pub. schls. and Harvard Univ.; admid. an atty., New Brunswick, 1884, and called to the bar, 1885; called to the bar, B. Columbia, 1890; regar. of probate etc., York Co., New Brunswick, 1888-1890; French cons. agrt. at Victoria, B. Columbia, 1904-1909; commd. 5th regt. Canadian garr. artil., at Victoria, B. Columbia, 1898-1903; lieut.-col., reserve of offrs. (Canadian Militia); mem. of Diamond Jubilee contingent to England, 1897; on spec. ser. to Alaska in connection with Behring sea fisheries dispute, 1891-2; judge of sup. ct., B. Columbia, Nov., 1909.

GREGORY, HON. HENRY.—B. 1860; M.L.A., for N. Coolgardie, W. Australia, 1897; ditto for Menzies since 1901; min. for mines, 1901-2, and 1902-4; min. for mines and rly., Aug., 1906; ditto, 16th Sept., 1910, to Oct., 1911; mem. H. of R., C. of A., 1913.

GREIG, CLINTON HENRY.—B. 1875; entd. customs dept., B. Guiana, 1895; sub. inspr., B. Guiana police, Dec., 1900; 2nd lieut. (unattached), B. Guiana militia, Dec., 1900; on special service to Trinidad (after riots), Apl. to July, 1903; inspr. of police, Trinidad, and comdt. Port of Spain fire brigade, Sept., 1903; capt., Trinidad local forces, May, 1905; special certif. (captain's), infantry training, schl. of instr., Chelsea Barracks, London, and Hythe certif. (musketry), D., 1905; asst. supt. of police, Gambia, Aug., 1910; commsnr. of police, sheriff and inspr. of prisons, July, 1911; ag. chief mag., Gambia, July to Oct., 1912; capt. comdg. Gambia volr. artil., Sept., 1912; ag. rec.gen., July to Aug., 1912, and Jan. to Mar., 1914; ag. offr.-in-charge of secretariat, and provnst. M.I.C., 1912; provnst. M.E.C., Dec., 1913; on active serv. in Cameroons, June, 1915, to Mar., 1916; dist. offr., with judicial powers, Duala prov., Cameroons, July, 1915; apptd. hon. capt. in the Army (for services with Cameroons Expd. Force), as from Mar., 1916; temp. capt., W.E.F., Gambia, Mar., 1917.

GREIG, GORDON EARLLEY, A.R.S.M.—B. 1879; ed. Wellington Coll., and Royal Schl. of Mines, London; inspr. of mines, F.M.S., 1902; ag. asst. warden, Pahang, 1907; asst. warden, Perak, 1910; ag. warden, Selangor, 1914; ag. warden, Perak, 1916 and 1920; ag. senr. warden of mines, F.M.S., Mar., 1921; warden of mines, Perak, Mar., 1921.

GERLI, JESSIE MITCHINSON POTTER, M.B., B.S. Cantab., M.R.C.S., L.R.C.P.—B. 1880; entd. med. serv., Trinidad, 1st June, 1906; dist. med. offr., 1st Aug., 1912.

GRENFELL, 1ST BARON OF KILVEY (creat. 1902), FIELD-MARSHAL SIR FRANCIS WALLACE, G.C.B., G.C.M.G. (1892).—B. 1841; gov. and comdr.-in-chief of Malta, 1898; A.D.C. to Sir A. Cunynghame; also staff offr. to Col. Glyn in the Transkei, 1887-8; dep. asst. adjt. and qrtmr.-gen. in the Kaffr war, 1878; the same in the Zulu war, 1879; asst. qrtmr.-gen. in the Boer war, 1881; served in the Egyptian campaign of 1882, and the Nile expdn. of 1884; was Sirdar of the Egyptian army from 1885 to 1892; commanded the troops employed at Suakin against the Dervishes; after filling various posts at home, went again to Egypt in 1897 to command the British troops; with Lord Kitchener in the Nile campaign, 1898; gov. of Malta, 1899 to 1903; commd. 4th Army Corps, 1903-4; G.O.C. forces in Ireland, 1904.

GRENIER, WILLIAM EDMUND.—B. 1864; entd. Ceylon clerical serv., June, 1884; office asst. to asst. govt. agt., Kalutara, in Class V. of Ceylon civ. ser., Nov., 1913; ag. 1st asst. acctnt., general treas., Nov., 1915; office asst. to asst. govt. agent, Kalutara, April, 1916; ag. 2nd asst. acctnt., gen. treas., July, 1918; ag. 1st asst. acctnt., ditto, July, 1919; office asst. to asst. govt. agt., Kalutara, July, 1920.

GREY-WILSON, SIR WM., K.C.M.G. (1904), K.B.E. (1918), C.M.G. (1891).—B. 1852; ed. at Chelt. Coll.; priv. sec. to Sir William Grey, gov. of Jamaica, 1874; to Lieut.-Gov. Edwd. E. Rushworth, Mar., 1877; admstr., Major-Gen. J. R. Mann, R.E., Aug., 1877; to Lieut.-Gov. F. P. Barlee, Br. Honduras, Sept., 1877; and elk. of the
exec. and legis. couns., June, 1878; ag. mag., Orange Walk, in charge of frontier scouts, Dec., 1879, to Apr., 1880, and June, 1880, to Mar., 1881; ast. col. sec. and treas., S. Leona, 1883; special commr., Sulymah, Dec., 1883, to June, 1884; 4th ast. col. sec., G. Coast Col., 1884; col. sec., St. Helena, July, 1886; ag. gov., 1887; gov., 1890; gov., Falklands, 1897; gov., Bahamas, 5th May, 1904; ret., 1912; Commander, Star of Roumania, 1922.

GRIEK, SELWYN MACGREGOR.—B. 1878; ed. at Marlboro' Coll. (classical scholar) and Pembroke Coll., Cambridge (classical scholar); 2nd class tripes, 1900; 1st class French and English special, 1901; B.A. 1900; called to the bar, Nov., 1910; schoolmaster at Berkhamstead, Herts., 1901-1902; ditto, Cheam, Surrey, 1902-1905; ast. res., Northern Nigeria, 1906; passed in Hausa, 1907; 3rd class res., 1st Oct., 1908; in charge of Zaria prov., April, 1910; and from May, to Nov., 1911.

GRIESS, WILLIAM MASON.—Ed. at Repton Schl. and Cooper's Hill; senr. astt. engr., Uganda Rly., 20th Dec., 1895; dist. engr., Apr., 1909.

GRIFFIN, CHARLES JAMES.—B. 1875; B.A. (hons.) Royal Univ., Ireland; 1st scholar in modern literature, exhibitioner; Chancellor's gold medallist; called to the Irish Bar, June, 1898; went Connaught circuit; apptd. Crown prosecutor, B.C.A. Protectorate (now Nyasaland), July, 1901; ag. chief judicial offr. and H.B.M. vice-consul, Nov., 1901, to June, 1902; ag. judge of High Court, Feb. to Oct., 1904, and Nov., 1905, to Feb., 1906; atty.-gen., Nov., 1905; judge of High Court, Feb., 1906, and member of H.B.M. Court of Appeal for Eastern Africa; chairman of comnr. on trading and licensing, May to Sept., 1909 (reed. thanks of Prot. govt.); comnr. for revision of Nyasaland laws, 1913, and reed. thanks of Prot. govt.; atty.-gen., Gibraltar, Oct., 1914; King's proctor for prize ct. proceedings; K.C. for the colony, Dec., 1914; chief justice, Leeward Is., 1919.

GRIFFIN, EUGENE PATRICK, M.B.E. (1918).—Third clk., treas., Gibraltar (after compet. exam.), Feb., 1883; pol. clk., 1883; 3rd clk., col. sec.'s office, 1886; 2nd class clk., Jan., 1890; 1st class clk., Jan., 1893; ch. clk. and cashier, P.O., Nov., 1893; transf. to col. sec.'s office, July, 1895; ch. clk., col. sec.'s office, and regar. of births, marriages, and deaths, 1913; ag. astt. col. sec. on various occasions; chief astt. sec., col. sec.'s office, and sec. to bd. of health, Aug., 1919; ag. col. sec., 5th to 26th Oct., 1920.

GRIFFITH, A. W. M.—Administrative offr., S. Rhodesia admntr., 12th Apr., 1912; war serv. with 2nd Rhodesia Regt., 30th Nov., 1914 to 12th Sept., 1916; polit. offr., Tanganyika Territory, 12th Sept., 1916.

GRIFFITH, CARL.—Astt. auditor, Gold Coast, 14th Jan., 1920.

GRIFFITH, FRANCIS W.—Matric. Lond. Univ., 1885; supernum.P.O. St. Vincent, Sept., 1885; clk. P.O., Jan., 1886; clk. to col. regar., June, 1886; marshal V.-A. ct., Nov., 1887; escheator-gen. and casual receiver, Nov., 1890; inspr. of schls., Dec., 1890; ch. clk. govt. office and clk. of couns., June, 1893; J.P., Apr., 1894; filled combined offices of inspr. of schls. and local audit clk., Jan.-Dec., 1897; med. regar., Jan., 1898; spec. ment. in desps. and commended by S. of S. for services rendered in connection with hurricane relief work, 1898; sec. of hurricane loan bd., June, 1899; mag. 3rd dist. and mag. 1st dist. (crim. jurisdn.), Oct.-Nov., 1899; offl. visitor and visiting just., Kingstown prison, June, 1900; nominated offl. mem., Kingstown bd., 30th June, 1900; sec. to hosp. and asylum inquiry comnr., 1900; supvr. of cust. and port offr., Apr.-May, 1901; supt. of Crown lands, land comnr., and in charge of survey dept., May, 1903, to Jan., 1904; chief of pol., chief of excise, etc., Jan., 1905; confirmed July, 1907; chief of pol., Grenada, Oct. to Dec., 1907; deleg. of St. Vincent at Canadian Reciprocity Conference, held at Barbados, Jan., 1908; land comnr. and in charge of crown lands, May to Nov., 1910, and from Feb. to Apr., 1911; offl. representative of St. Vincent before Canada-West Indies Royal Comnr., 1910; mem. exec. legis. couns., Apr., 1911; rep. St. Vincent at Canadian-West Indian Reciprocity Conference held at Ottawa, 1911; fed. treas., Leeward Is. and treas., Antigua, Apr., 1913; J.P., Antigua, 1914; rep. Leewards at cuit. confec., Trinidad, 1919; capt., Antigua defence force, has held various ag. appointments.

GRIFFITH, MAJOR H. W. G. MEYER.—F.R.G.S., F.R. Hist. S., F.S.A. Scot.; 2nd lieut. 3rd S. Wales Borderers, 1900; served in S. African war, 1900-1902 (2 medals, 5 clasps); R.S.O., S.S.O., press censor; French Interpreter, 1902; capt., 3rd N. Lance., 1905; major comdg., Glenalmond O.T.C., 1910; A.D.C. and priv. sec. to Sir E. M. Mercwether, gov. of S. Leone, 1914.

GRIFFITH, LEWELLYN.—B. 1872; cler. astt., Basutoland, 1896; sub.-inspr., pol., 1897; inspr., 1905; astt. comnr., 1913; served in European war with Native Labour Contingent.

GRIFFITH, W. L.—Agt. of the Canadian govt. in Wales for some years; sec. to high comnr. since Mar., 1903.

GRIFFITH, SIR WM. BRANDFORD, KT. BACH. (1898).—B. 1858; Gilchrist scholar, 1877; B.A. (Lond.), 1880; called to the bar, Mid. Term., June, 1881; ag. Queen's advoc., G. Coast Col., Apr. to Oct., 1884; dist. comnr., 1885; ag. puisne judge, Lagos, Jan., and Cape Coast, May, 1885; ag. Queen's advoc., 1886 and 1887; compiled ordinances of G. Coast Col., 1887; res. mag. Jamaica, 1888; R.M. St. Catherine, Feb., 1893; ag. atty.-gen., May to Dec., 1893; ch. just., G. Coast Col., May, 1895; admstd. govt. of Lagos, July to Aug., 1896; dep. for gov. G. Coast, Aug. to Nov., 1897; revised ordinance of G. Coast Col., 1898 and 1903; retired, 1911.

GRIFFITHS, JEFFREY ARTHUR.—B. 1884; Ed. Univ. of Liverpool; veterinary offr., Nyasaland, 7th June, 1913; attached Intell. Corps, Nyasaland Field Force, Aug., 1914 to July, 1917; seconded to rinderpest comnr., German E. Africa, July, 1917, to May, 1919; ag. rinderpest comnr., Aug., 1918 to May, 1919; chief vet. offr., 14th June, 1919; ment. in desps. (gallantry in action) South Africa, 1901; ment. in desps., services with Field Force, Nyasaland, 1915 and 1917; ag. dir. of agr., Oct. to Dec., 1920.

GRIMMER, WARD CHIPMAN HAZEN, K.C., LL.D.—B. 1808; admitted atty., 1880; barrister, 1881; K.C., 1902; elected to prov. legis., N. Bruna., 1903; re-elected, 1908, 1912; surv.-gen. N. Bruna., 1908; atty.-gen., 1911; puisne judge, appeal ct. of N. Bruna., Jan., 1914.

GRIMSHAW, HERBERT C. W.—B. 1874; ed. privately, and at Trin. Coll., Dublin; B.A. 1896; barrister-at-law, Inner Temple, 1896; lieut., 5th Batt., Royal Dublin Fusiliers, 1902-1911; dist. comnr., Gold Coast, 1902; ag. solr.-gen., 3rd May to 10th Aug., 1907; cantonment mag., Coomassie, 1909; prov. comnr., Gold Coast, 1911; ret. through ill-health, 1915; ag.
paymaster, army pay dept., Oct., 1916 to Mar., 1917; pres., dist. ct., Cyprus, 14th May, 1917.

GRINDLE, SIR G. E. A., K.C.M.G. (1922); C.B. (1919); C.M.G. (1914).—B. 1869; scholar of Corpus Christi Coll., Oxford; 1st class classical mods., 1889; 1st class in final classical schl., 1891; B.A., 1891; elected fellow of C.C.C., 1891; Chancellor's English Essay, 1892; M.A., 1894; 2nd class clk. in local govt. board, Feb., 1893; called to the bar at Lincoln's Inn, Nov., 1895; 2nd class clk., after compet. exam., in office of S. of S. forCols., 10th Feb., 1896; ast. priv. sec. to Mr. Chamberlain, Nov., 1898; 1st class clk., 30th June, 1900; prin. clk., 30th June, 1900; ast. under-sec. of state, 4th June, 1916.

GRINLINTON, F. H., C.M.G. (1903), B. 1853, F.R.G.S., A.L.C.K., F.R. Met. S.—Apptd. to Ceylon survey dept., Apr., 1870; dist. survr., Jan., 1877; ch. survr., Nov., 1881; ag. survr.-gen., Aug., 1894; survr.-gen., Dec., 1896; ret. June, 1901; proceeded to F.M.S. to advise govt. on reorganiz. of survey dept., Oct., 1904.

GRISDALE, JOSEPH HIRAM.—B. 1870; ed. Vankleek Hill Acad.; Albert Coll., Belleville, Ont.; Ont. Agril. Coll. (gold med.); Toronto Univ.; Iowa State Coll. of Agr., Ames, Ia. (1st class hon.); agriculturist, cent. experimental farm, Ottawa, 1899-1911; dir. of experimental farms, 1911; ag. dep. min. of agr., Can., 1918; dep. min., 1919.

GROOM, HON. LITTLETON ERNEST, M.A., LL.M.—B. 1867; M.P. for Darling Downs, Queensland; elected to 1st hse. of rep., C. of Aust., 1901; re-elected, Dec., 1903; mem. of royal comm. on Iron Bonus, 1902, and Navigation Bills, 1904-5; several times Crown prosecutor, and twice ag. judge of dist. ct., Queensland; min. for home affairs, C. of Aust., 5th July, 1905; atty.-gen., 13th Oct., 1906; min. of external affairs, June, 1909, to Apr., 1910; min. of trade and customs, June, 1913-Sept., 1914; hon. min., Feb., 1917; vice pres., exec. coun., Nov., 1917 to Mar., 1918; min. for works and railways, Mar., 1918; ag. atty.-gen. from Apr., 1918.

GUERITZ, ELTON LAWRENCE.—B. 1884; ed. Trin. Coll., Glen Almond and Glasgow Univ.; M.A., 1st cls. hon. economics and 2nd cls. hon. classics, 1907; examr., colonial audit branch, E and A dept., Dec., 1908; ast. auditor, S. Nigeria, Apr., 1909; auditor, Gambia, 1915; ag. revwr.-gen. and P.M.G., and provl. M.L.C., May-Sept., 1915, Apl. to Oct., 1919, and from 16th Oct. to 26th Nov., 1920; offr.-in-charge, P.W.D., Oct., 1919 to Jan., 1920; ast. food contr. Jan.-Apr., 1920; ag. rec.-gen. and P.M.G., Oct.-Nov., 1920; just. of the peace and commr. of the ct. of requests, 1921.

GUGGISBERG, BRIG.-GEN. SIR FREDERICK GORDON, K.C.M.G. (1922), C.M.G. (1908), D.S.O. (1918), Chev. Legion d'Honneur (1917).—B. 1869; passed into R. M. Academy, Woolwich, 1886; 2nd Lieut., Royal Engineers 1889; Lieut., 1892; Capt., 1900; Major, 1906; Lieut.-Col., 1916; Brig.-Gen., 1917; Brevet-Col., 1919; retired from Army, 1919; served in Singapore, 1893 to 1896; instructor, R.M. Academy, 1897-1902; ast. dir. of surveys, Gold Coast, 1902; dir., 1904 to 1909; dir. of surveys, S. Nigeria, 1910; surveyor-general, Nigeria, 1914; rejoined Army on outbreak of war; commanded 94th Field Co., R.E., 1914; C.R.E., 24th Dec., 1915; C.R.E. 66th Div., 1916; commanded 197th Infantry Brigade, Mar., 1917; commanded 170th Infantry Brigade, May, 1917 to July, 1918; ast. inspr.-gen. of Training in France, July, 1918; commanded 100th Infantry Brigade, 1919; governor and commander in chief, Gold Coast, 24th Sept., 1919.

GUILLEMARD, SIR LAURENCE NUNNS, K.C.B. (1910); C.B. (1905).—B. 1862; ed. Charterhouse, and Trin. Coll. Camb.; entered Treasury, 1888; priv. sec. to Sir W. Harcourt and Sir M. Hicks-Beach, 1892-1902; deputy chmn., board of inland rev., 1902; chmn., bd. of customs and excise, 1909; gov., S. Stellins, 7th Feb., 1920.

GUNARATNA, JULIUS ALBERT.—B. 1869; apptd. to cla. V. Ceylon civ. serv., May, 1920; office ast., Matara Kachcheri, May, 1920.

GUPPY, ROBERT.—Imperial postal serv., 31st Mar., 1892; ch. clk. and acctnt., post and tel. dept., G. Coast, 1900; ag. dir. of telegraphs, 2nd June to 26th July, 1901; acctnt., 1902; prepared system of accounting passed in Council and brought into force 1st Sept., 1902.

GURNER, JOHN AUGUSTUS.—B. 1855; ed. at Chelt. Coll., and Jesus Coll. (Camb.), LL.B.; called to the bar, Inner Tem., 1877; parly. draughtsman, Victoria, May, 1882; Crown prosecutor, Mar., 1889.

GUSHUR, GEO. WILLIAM.—B. 1854; M.H.A. for Trinity Dist., Newfoundland, 1894; again elected, 1900; re-elected, 1904; min. of pub. wks., 1900.

GUTHRIE, HON. DAVID HENRY.—B. 1856; ed. Kildare St. Coll., Dublin; elected to N. Z. parl., 1908; whip to Reform party, 1910; min. of lands, 1918.

GUTHRIE-SMITH, FRANK, M.A.—B. 1873; ed. at Watson's Coll., Edinburgh Univ. and Trin. Coll., Cambridge; barrister-at-law, Lincoln's Inn, June, 1900; conveyancer to the land office, Uganda Prot., June, 1913; mag., May, 1914; ag. atty.-gen., Mar., 1917 to July, 1918; puisne judge and mem. of ct. of appeal for Eastern Africa, June, 1919; chancellor of the diocese of Uganda.

GWYN, CECIL.—B. 1867; apptd. to pay and accounts branch, W.A.F.F., Oct., 1898; astt. treas., N. Nigeria, 1901; chief astt. treas., 1903; treas., Gambia, Oct., 1909; ag. gov., Oct., 1909; ag. col. sec., Oct., 1909, to Jan., 1910; July to Oct., 1910, and from July to Nov., 1912; ag. chief mag., July to Nov., 1911; ag. gov., Oct. to Dec., 1912; senior J.P. and commr. of ct. of requests; ag. gov., Jan. to Apr., 1914, and from May to Sept., 1915; mem. exec. and legis. couns.

GYDE, CHARLIE JOHN.—Indian govt. service, 1897-1902; astt. engrnr., P.W.D., Transvaal, June, 1902; inspr. of wks., July, 1904; dist. engrnr., Mar., 1907; inspecting engrnr., Sept., 1917.

HADDON, ERNEST B., M.A., F.R.A.I.—B. 1882; ed. Christ's Coll., Camb.; nat. science tripos, 1904; dip. anthorp., Camb., 1912; astt. collr., Uganda, 1905; dist. commr., 1912.

HADDON-SMITH, SIR GEO. BASIL, K.C.M.G. (1915); C.M.G. (1901).—B. 1861; lieut. Royal Guernsey militia, 1879; attached 32nd (D.C.L.I.) regt., 1880; attached 107th (Royal Sussex) regt., 1883; astt. inspr., Lagos constab., 1886; adjt., 1887; priv. sec. to ag. gov. and clk. of couns., 1887, 1889, and 1893; ag. inspr.-gen. and sheriff of Lagos, 1888, 1890, 1891, and 1893; ag. dist. commr., 1887, 1888, 1889, and 1891; took part in Jebu expedition, 1892, mentioned in despatches (medal and clasp); political offr. on Sir G. Carter's mission to Yorubaland, 1893; astt. col. sec., Lagos, 1894; ag. col. sec., 1895; priv. sec. to Sir F. Scott in Ashanti expdn., 1896; ch. ass. col. sec.,
G. Coast, 1896; ag. col. sec., 1896-7; mem. of exec. and legis. coun., G. Coast col.; political offr. to Col. Sir J. Willcocks in the Ashanti expdn., 1900; took part in relief of Kumasi, spec. ment. in desps. (Ashanti medal and clasp); ag. gov. Gambia, July to Oct., 1901; col. sec., S. Leone, 1901-1911; ag. gov. of S. Leone on many occasions; gov., Bahamas, 1912; gov., Windward Is., 14th Dee., 1914; assumed gov't., 30th Dec., 1914.

HADDRIEL, CYRIL F.—B. 1902; apptd., after compet. exam., cler. offr., C.O., 29th Apr., 1920.

HAHN, D. M., M. Inst. C.E.—B. 1867; ed. Queen's Roy. Coll., Trinidad, Realschool, Hamburg, and Technological Inst., Hamburg; in charge of govt. saw mill, Trinidad, Jan., 1887; foreman, P.W.D., Jan., 1888; ag. astt. engr., 1891; astt. engr., in charge of wks. and bldgs., Feb., 1894; astt. engr., office and wks., Nov., 1899; engr., office and wks., Apr., 1906; ag. div. engr., N. Div., 1903 and 1907, in addition to substantive duties; ag. inspr. of mines, 1907 to June, 1908; and dep. inspr. of mines, July, 1908, in addition to substantive duties; mem. bd. of industrial training.

HALFORD, HON. W. W.—Elected M.H.A., Fogo, Newfoundland, 1913; min. of agric. and mines, 1917; M.E.C., 1917; col. sec., 1918.

HALL, FREDERICK.—L.R.C.S. and L.R.C.P., Ireland; L.M., Rotunda; B. 1874; prov. med. offr., Fiji, 1899; dist. med. offr., 1900; med. supt., med. offr. of health and stip. mag., Makogai leper asylum, 1910.

HALL, GILBERT AMOS.—Ed. at Harrow schl.; cadet, Straits, 1888; passed final exam. in Malay, Apr., 1891; ag. 3rd mag., Penang, July, 1891; ag. 2nd mag., Penang, July to Sept., 1893; ag. dist. offr., Dindings, Mar., 1894; supt. of educn., Penang, Oct., 1894; ag. dist. offr., Malacca, Nov., 1896; ag. 2nd mag., Penang, May, 1897; sheriff and dep. regir., sup. ct., Singapore, July, 1897; ag. collr. ld. rev., Penang, Mar., 1898; 2nd astt. col. sec., S. Stiltns., Aug., 1898, but continued to act as collr. ld. rev., Penang, till Mar., 1900; ag. collr. ld. rev. and offr., in charge of treas., Malacca, Sept., 1900, and confirmed, Aug., 1902; sen. dist. offr., July, 1904; ag. P.M.G., Aug., 1904; ag. inspr. of prisons, S. Stiltns., Oct., 1904; ag. aud.-gen., S. Stiltns., Aug. to Dec., 1907; ag. dist. judge, and 1st mag., Penang, 1909; dist. judge and 1st mag., Singapore, 3rd Apl., 1911, but continued to act in Penang; ag. dir. of educn., Feb., 1912; 1st mag., Singapore, May, 1914; ag. astt. judge and 1st mag., Penang, June, 1914; ag. adviser, Kedah, Apr., 1915; ag. res. coun., Penang, July, 1919; res. coun., Penang, Oct., 1919.

HALL, J. D., B.A. (Oxon).—Cadet, S. Stiltns., Nov., 1910; ag. dep. regir., sup. ct., Singapore and sec., Mohammedan and Hindu endowments bd., in addition, Apr., 1911; ag. dist. offr., Alor Gajah, Apr., 1912; passed cadet, July, 1913; supermny. offr., cls. V., continued ag. dist. offr., Alor Gajah, Dec., 1913; astt. adviser, Batu Pahat, Johore, Feb., 1914; supermny. offr., cls. IV., Dec., 1919; ag. 2nd mag., Dec., 1919; ag. 2nd astt. col. sec., Mar., 1920; 3rd astt. col. sec., Apr., 1920; ag. 2nd astt. col. sec., Apr., 1921.

HALL, J. HATHORN, D.S.O., M.C. Croix-de-Guerre (Belgium).—B. 1894; ed. St. Paul's Schl., and Lincoln Coll., Oxford (1913-14); B.A.; on mly. serv., France and Belgium, Dec., 1915 to July, 1916, Oct., 1916, to Dec., 1918, Germany, Dec., 1918, to Apr., 1919; lieut. Royal Munster Fusiliers, Dec., 1914; capt., Dec., 1915; staff-capt., Mar., 1918; brig.-major, Oct., 1918; wounded, 1916; ment. in desp., 1919; Egyptian civ. serv., miny. of finance, Sept., 1919, to Feb., 1921; apptd. under reconstruction scheme, astt. prin., C.O., 17th Feb., 1921.

HALL, ROGER EVANS.—B. 1883; ed. Winchester and New Coll., Oxford; 3rd cl. hons. mods.; 2nd cl. hons. final jurisprudence; called to the bar, Inner Temple, 1908; astt. dist. commsr., Gold Coast, 1910; crown counsel, 1914; ag. senr. crown counsel, 1914; senr. crown counsel, 1915; ag. solr.-gen., 1916, 1917 and 1918; circuit judge, Ashanti (temporary appt.), 1918.

HALL, W.—B. 1901; apptd., after compet. exam., astt. clk., and assigned to C.O., Jan., 1920.

HALLIFAX, EDWIN RICHARD, O.B.E. (1918).—Ed. Blundell's schl.; Blundell's scholar, Balliol Coll., Oxford; B.A., 1896; cadet, Hong Kong, 1897; passed cadet, 1900; ag. police mag., New Territory, 1899; pol. mag., Hong Kong, 1899; J.P., 1900; astt. supt. of pol. and pol. mag., N.T., 1900; ag. regir.-gen., Mar.-June, 1902; acted as dep. supt. of pol., astt. supt. of fire brigade, capt. supt. of pol., etc., on several occasions, 1902-04; seconded as Transvaal emigr. agt. at Chinwangtao, Mar., 1906; dist. offr., N.T., Sept., 1907; in addition, acted as astt. land offr., N.T., May-Aug., 1907, and Aug.-Sept., 1908; ag. 1st pol. mag., Oct., 1909, to May, 1911; ag. dep. supt. of police and astt. supt. of fire brig., May, 1911; ag. regir.-gen. and M.L.C., 30th Oct., 1911; M.E.C., 14th Mar., 1912; regir.-gen., 29th Nov., 1912; title altered to sec. for Chinese affairs, 26th July, 1913; priv. sec. to gov't., in addition, 11th Sept., 1914 to 19th Jan., 1918; O.B.E., 4th Oct., 1918.

HALLIFAX, F. J.—Cadet, S. Stiltns., Mar., 1893; passed final exam. in Malay, June, 1894; ag. dist. offr. Penang, Apr., 1896, and Malacca, Nov., 1896; supt. of educn., Penang, July, 1897; dist. offr., June, 1898; ag. dist. offr., Dindings, June, 1901; ag. coll. of land revenue, Penang, Apr., 1902; also ag. regir. of deeds and regir. of bills of sale, Penang, May, 1902; astt. P.M.G., Penang, Aug., 1902, but continued to act as coll. of land rev.; ag. collr. of land rev., and offr. in charge of Treasury, Malacca, Apr., 1903; 2nd mag., Penang, Jan., 1905; ag. dist. offr., Prov. Wellesley, Mar., 1906; pres. mun. commsr., Penang, 1st Sept., 1906; collr. of land revenue, Singapore, 1st Oct., 1908, but remained seconded as pres. mun. commsr., Penang; pres., mun. commsr., Singapore, 1st Jan., 1911; promoted to Cla. II., 1st Jan., 1912, but remained seconded; ag. gen. adviser, Johore, July, 1918; ag. offl. assignee and regir. of companies, Feb., 1920; pres., rent assessment bd., Feb., 1920; commsr. of currency, Feb., 1920; ag. adviser, Kedah, June, 1920; collr. of land rev. and regir. of deeds, Singapore.

HALL-JONES, HON. SIR WILLIAM, K.O.M.G. (1910).—B. 1861; ed. at publio schls.; arrived in New Zealand, 1875; mem. of house of representatives for Timaru, New Zealand, since 1890; min. of pub. wks. and marine, 1896; premier col. treas., min. of educn. and labour, June, 1906; resign, premiership, and assumed portfolios of pub. wks. and rlys. in Ward ministry, Aug., 1906; high commr. in Lond., 1906-1912; M.L.C. since 1913.

HAM, GORDON LUPTON.—Cadet, F.M.S., 7th Nov., 1908; lent to Kelantan, 13th Oct., 1913; cls. IV., S. Stiltns., 1st Jan., 1918; ag. 2nd astt. col. sec., 14th Apl., 1919; clk. of couns., 2nd Sept., 1919; 1st astt. col. sec., S. Stiltns., and clk. of couns., Jan., 1920; astt. offl. assignee, Dec., 1920; ag. sec. to high commsr., Feb., 1921; ag. astt. adviser to govt. of Kelantan, Apr., 1921.
HAMBLIN, R. A.—B. 1881; app'td. after compet. exam., clk. of the 2nd div. of the civil ser. and temporarily employed in the science and art dept. from Mar. 21st to May 26th, 1899; assigned to C.O. July, 1899; conf. clk., 1st Jan., 1918.

HAMILTON, ANDREW TODD.—B. 1879; ass't mast., educ. dept., Hong Kong, 1910; on mil'y serv., 14th Dec., 1917 to 11th Feb., 1919; ass't mast., ch. II., 1st Jan., 1920; ass't mast., Sayangpun schl., 1921.

HAMILTON, CHARLES BOUGHTON, C.M.G. (1896).—B. 1850; entered the service, 1865; 2nd clk. rec.gen.'s office, Br. Guiana, 1873, 1877; col. book-keeper, 1879; ag. rec.-gen., 1881; and ag. and gen., 1883 to 1886; received thanks of coun. on leaving for post of rec.-gen., etc., Trinidad, 1886; J.P.; ag. audr.-gen., M.E.C., and M.L.C., 1886; mem. of bd. of educ., 1887; or bd. of health, 1888; M.L.C., 1889; mem. of comtee. for widows' fund, 1889; ag. col. sec., 1890; chmn. hrbr. improvement comtee., and ag. audr.-gen. and col. sec., 1891; mem. coll. coun., 1891; rec.-gen., Br. Guiana, Dec., 1892; ag. audr.-gen. and mem. of policy, May, 1893, to May, 1896, and again Oct., 1896; sen. commr., Vlissingen estate; chmn. spirits coman., "Trotman," trust comtee.; dir. widows' and orphans' fund, etc.; mem. exec. coun., Dec., 1896; off. mem. of policy, July, 1898; chrmn., excise bd., 1901; chrmn., educ. coman., 1902; vote of thanks of comte. et al. for spec. serv. gratuitously rendered in public roads and bridges adminstr., 1894 to 1906; chmn. of comtee. for sub-dividing colony into districts, 1907; received thanks of S. of S. for "valuable services rendered the Crown and Colony during long and honourable term of office," Aug., 1908, gov't. director, Demerara Rly., July, 1910.

HAMILTON, ERIC WILLIAM, B.A.—B. 1888; ed. Blundell's, exhibtn., Sid. Succ. Coll., Camb., 1906; scholar, 1907; B.A., 1909; cadet, Hong Kong civ. ser., 17th Nov., 1911; ag. sec., sanitary bd., 1914; J.P., 1914; returned to Canton, Dec., 1914; attached to sanitary dept., Apr., 1915; passed final exam., 26th June, 1915; ag. ass't dist. offr., South, 24th Sept., 1915; ag. 3rd ass't. sec. for Chinese affairs, and dep. regir. of marriages, 14th Oct., 1915; attached to imports and exports office in addition, 19th Apr., 1916; ag. ass't. P.M.G., 11th Nov., 1916; ag. ass't. dist. offr., 16th Apr., 1917; attached to navy. dept. for sp. serv., 26th Aug., 1918; ag. ass't. dist. offr., 10th Dec., 1918; dist. offr., 10th Dec., 1918; dist. offr., South, 9th Feb., 1920.

HAMILTON, FRANK HUGH.—B. 1874; ed. Richmond, Yorks., and Lausanne; chief clk. and cashier, col. treas., Sierra Leone, Nov., 1899; 1st cl. clk., audit dept., Transvaal, Oct., 1901; prin. clk., 1st July, 1902; post abolished, 31st Dec., 1906; senr. ass't treas., Sierra Leone, Oct., 1909; ag. col. treas. for four periods; chief acctnt., P.W.D., G. Coast, Jan., 1916.

HAMILTON, FREDERICK GEARY.—Ed. at St. Paul's schl., Lond., and Magdalen Coll., Oxford; ass't collir., E. Africa Prot., 17th Dec., 1906; dist. commr., E.A.P., Apr., 1912.

HAMILTON, KENNETH.—B. 1884; ed. Edin. Acad. and Trin. Coll., Cambridge; 3rd cls. economics tripes; ass't res., N. Nigeria, 6th Apr., 1910.

HAMILTON, R.—Medical offr., E.A.P., Mar., 1911.

HAMILTON, SIR ROBERT WILLIAM, KT. BACH. (1918).—Ed. at St. Paul's schl. and Trin. Hall, Camb.; class. scholar, B.A., 1889 (honours); M.A., 1892; student, Inner Temple, 1893; called to the bar, 1895; dist. commr., Lagos, 1895 to 1897; regir., E. Africa Prot., 1897; town mag., 1899; ass't judge and admstr.-gen., 1900; judge of high court of E. Africa, 11th Aug., 1902; app'td. to serve on land coman., 31st Oct., 1904; prin. judge, E. Africa Prot., 1st Apr., 1906; chief justice, 1911.

HAMLyn, ANDREW DOUGLAS.—B. 1888; called to the bar, Inner Temple, June, 1918; junr. ass't treas., N. Nigeria, Oct., 1910; ass't treas., Nov., 1910; ass't sec., Oct., 1912.

HANCOCK, HUBERT HENRY, M.A.—Scholar St. John's Coll., Oxon; 2nd class classical moda., 1876; 2nd class classical finals, 1878; B.A., 1879; M.A., 1883; ass't master Cheltenham Coll., 1879; 2nd master Bosworth schl., 1880; prof. classics and moral philos., Codrington Coll., Barbados, 1883; ag. prin., 1889-91; 2nd master Queen's Roy. Coll., Trinidad, 1892; ag. prin., Apr. to Dec., 1894, June to Aug., 1898, Sept. to Dec., 1902, and Jan. to Dec., 1908; inspr. of schools, 14th July, 1914.

HANCOCK, WILLIAM JOHN, M.I.C.E., M.I.E.E.—B. 1865; ed. Dublin and Glasgow Univ.; G.S. & W. Rly. (Ireland workshops, Inchicore; Electric Lighting and Telephone Co. (Ireland); aspt. of telephones, W. Australia, 1886; supt. of telegraphs, 1890; gvt. electrical engnr., 1894; mem. of senate, Univ. of W. Aust.; pres., W. Aust. Inst. of Engineers, 1917-18; pres., Royal Soc. of W. Australia, 1918-19; hon. local sec., Inst. Elec. Engrs. (Lond.); lieut., A.A.M.C.

HANCOX, STANLEY EWART.—R. 1890; B.A., Oxon.; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., Jan., 1914; office asst. to govt. agt., S. Prov., June, 1914; extra ditto, Central Prov., June, 1914; addtl. pol. mag., Galle, in addition to his own duties, July, 1914; attached to Colombo customs, Sept., 1914; addtl. landing survr., Colombo customs, Apr., 1915; office asst. to prin. collr. of customs and second landing survr., Mar., 1916; on military duty, 1918; dep. food controller, June, 1919.

HAND, JOHN ST. VINCENT.—1st cls. clk., col. ec.'s off., Lagos, Oct., 1898; ch. clk., gen. man.'s off., Lagos gvt. rly., Apr., 1901; ass't sec., sec.'s off., S. Nigeria, Feb., 1904; priv. sec. to J. J. Thorburn, Eqo., ag. gov. of Lagos in 1905, 1906, 1907, 1908, 1909 and 1910; and clk. to exec. coun.; ass't col. sec., S. Nigeria, 31st July, 1907.

HANDS, ARTHUR L. C.—B. 1880; clk. in P.O., St. Helena, Sept., 1896; 2nd clk., col. sec.'s off., Apr., 1898; ch. clk. and clk. to exec. coun., Jan., 1907; J.P., 1910.

HANDYSIDE, WILLIAM LUCAS, M.A. (Glas.)—B. 1891; prizeman, hons. English, Glasgow Univ., 1913; ass't mast., Queen's Coll., Hong Kong, July, 1915; ag. normal mast., Queen's Coll., Hong Kong, 1918-20; ag. master of method, Hong Kong Univ., 1918-20; ass't mast., cls. II., 1st Jan., 1920.

HANKEY, Lieut.-Col. Sir, M. P. A., G.C.B. (1919); K.C.B. (1916); C.B. (1912).—B. 1877; ed. Rugby; joined R.M.A., 1893; served in H.M.S. "Ramillies," flagship and 2nd flagship, Mediterranean, 1899-1901; naval intell. dept., 1902-6; granted temporary rank of Major whilst serving on a special comtee., 1906; intell. offr., Mediterranean, 1907; ass't sec., comtee. of Imp. defence, 1908; app'td. sec., 1912; sec., war cabinet, from 1916; British sec., Peace Conf., 1919; comdr., Legion of Honour, 1917; commendatore, Crown of Italy, 1918.

HANKINSON, WALTER CROSSFIELD, M.C. (1918).—B. 1894; ed. Manchester Gram. Schl. and Jesus Coll., Oxford (exhibitioner); private, Royal
Fusiliers, Sept., 1914; 2nd lieut., Yorks and Lancs. Regt., 9th Jan., 1915; lieut., 1st Apr., 1915; capt., 13th May, 1915; served in Egypt and France; demobilised, 28th Feb., 1919; apprd. under reconstruction scheme, 2nd cls. clk., C.O., Feb., 1920; asst. prin., 1st Apr., 1920.

HANLEY, ALLAN HASTINGS, C.M.G. (1903); F.R.C.S.—Med. offr., Niger Coast Prot. (now S. Nigeria), May, 1893; sen. med. offr., Apr., 1901; dep. prov. med. offr., May, 1903; ag. pria. med. offr., Dec., 1903, to Apr., 1904.

HANN, HUGH—B. 1862; joined R.A., 1881; served in India, 1882 to 1890; ret. from serv., 1890; joined home prison serv., 1891; promoted clk. and schoolmaster, 1896; supt. of pris., S. Leone, 1891; sheriff and ag. supt. of pol., S. Leone, July to Sept., 1902; J.P. for colony, 1902; formed S. Leone fire brigade and first supt., 1803; 1st asst. supt. of pris., Ceylon, 1906; supr. of pris., Kandy, 1st Nov., 1906, to Sept., 1908; asst. supt., convict establishment, Colombo, Oct., 1908, to Dec., 1909; ag. insp.-gen. of prisons, Ceylon, and supt. of convict establishment, Sept. to Dec., 1909; supt., Mutwal and Hulftadorp prisons, Jan. to Aug., 1910; supt., Mahara prison, Sept., 1910; ag. insp.-gen. of prisons, Sept. to Dec., 1911; supt., Fremantle prison, W. Aust., 1st Jan., 1912.

HANNAY, HENRY DESMOND.—Sub-inspr., Bechuanaland Prot. police, 1901; ag. mag., N'Gami, 1907-08; inspr., Feb., 1914; ag. res. mag., 1914.

HANNYNGTON, JOHN ARTHUR, C.M.G. (1911).—Capt., Indian army; temp. maj., King's African Rifles; ed. at Univ. Serv. Coll., Westward Ho!; passed in Hindustani, higher standard, Pushtu, higher standard, Kiswahili, govt. test. exam. for promotion to field offr. and staff employ.; gazetted 8th June, 1889; apprd. comdt., Jubaland Camel Corps, 15th Dec., 1901; comdt., 5th King's African Rifles, Somaliland Prot., 28th Feb., 1905.

HANSON, B. E.—Educ. Clifton Coll.; clk., exchequer and audit dept., 10th Apr., 1899; clk., audit off., Hong Kong, 1st June, 1900; ag. local aud., 31st Mar., 1901, to 1st Aug., 1902; returned to head office, July, 1903; asst. aud., Uganda, 9th June, 1904; ag. local aud., May to Nov., 1904, and July to Nov., 1906; local aud., N. Nigeria, 3rd Mar., 1908; local aud., Sierra Leone, 23rd July, 1909.

HARAN, JAMES AUGUSTINE, C.M.G. (1909); M.D., M.A.—Med. offr., E. Africa Prot., 1st Feb., 1898; med. offr. of health, Mombasa, Nov., 1903; sen. med. offr., 1910; dep. P.M.O., Apr., 1913.

HARBIN, JOHN ALPHONSO.—Ch. clk. to regis., Grenada, July, 1884; ditto to regis. sup. ct., July, 1886; marshal V.-A. ct., Mar., 1887; ag. regis. sup. ct., and ag. regis. in V.-A. ct., May, 1888, to Apr., 1890; acctnt., treas., July, 1890; sec. to commn. pub. wks. dept. inquiry, Dec., 1890; ag. ch. clk., col. sec.'s office, Aug., 1892 to Feb., 1893; ag. impr. of schools, Feb., 1893, to Mar., 1894; impr. of schools, Mar., 1894; ag. col. postmaster, Aug.-Sept., 1894; mem. bd. of ed., Apr., 1896; ag. regis. sup. ct., Aug.-Sept., 1901; ag. impr. of schools, St. Vincent, Sept.-Nov., 1901; mem. bd. of ed., St. Vincent, Sept.-Nov., 1901; ag. pol. mag. and acct. treas., Carriacou, Dec., 1901, to Jan., 1902.

HARCOURT, HAROLD WALLACE—B. 1886; examng. clk., audit dept., Fiji, Nov., 1909; book-keeper, treas., May, 1910; chief audr., Tonga, under three years agreement with native govt., June, 1911; audr.-gen. and govt. sec., Sept., 1911; ag. premier, 1st Jan. to 25th Feb., 1914; 2nd asst. audr., Fiji, 14th Oct., 1914; ag. ch. clk., treas., 15th Oct., 1918.

HARDING, ALFRED J., O.B.E. (1918)—B. 1878; ed. Christ's Coll., Brecon, and St. John's Camb.; foundtn. schlr., 1899; 1st class nat. sci. trip, part I., 1900; B.A., 1900; M.A., 1920; ent. C.O. after compet. exam. as 2nd cl. clk., Oct., 1901; sec. to comte., to inquire into organisation of Crown agents' office, 1908; asst. priv. sec. to Lord Crewe, 1st Feb., 1909; sec. to Royal comm. on Mauritius, 1909; asst. priv. sec. to Mr. Lewis Harcourt, Nov., 1910; ag. 1st cls. clk., Sept., 1910 to Jan., 1911, and from 1st Apr., 1912; 1st cls. clk., 12th Oct., 1914; sec., colonial blue-books comte., 1917; asst. prin. clk., 1st Jan., 1920; asst. sec., 1st Apr., 1920.

HARDING, COLONEL COLIN, C.M.G. (1886), D.S.O. (1916).—B. 1863; formerly ch. inspr. of native police, Mashonaland; served in Mashonaland rebellion, 1896-7; comdt. of Barotse native pol., 1901-1906; dist. commnr., Northern territories, G. Coast, 1910; seconded for milly. serv., 1914; prov. commnr., 14th Feb., 1915; resumed duty in G. Coast, 9th May, 1917.

HARDING, EDWARD J., C.M.G. (1917), M.A. (1907).—B. 1880; ed. Dulwich Coll. and Hertford Coll., Oxford (scholar, 1899); 1st cls. class. mods., 1901; 2nd cls. lit. hum., 1903; B.A., 1903; called to the bar, Lincoln's Inn, 1912; apprd. after compet. exam., 2nd cls. clk., marine dept., bd. of trade, 30th Nov., 1903; 2nd cls. clk., C.O., 31st May, 1904; sec. to distressed colonial seamen comte., 1908; asst. priv. sec. to Mr. Lewis Harcourt, 14th Oct., 1912; sec. to Dominions Royal Comm., Dec., 1912; ag. 1st cls. clk., 10th Apr., 1916; 1st cls. clk., 4th June, 1916; on military service from 20th Nov., 1915, to 9th Apr., 1916; sec. to comte. for attitl. of ex-serv. men within the Empire, 1917.; ag. prin. clk., 1st Apr., 1919; prin., 1st Apr., 1920; asst. sec., 1st Dec., 1921.

HARDY, THOMAS JAMES.—B. 1900; ent. C.O., 3rd Mar., 1916; apptd. asst. clk., C.O., after compet. exam., 24th Apr., 1918; cler. offr., 1st Jan., 1920.

HARE, REGINALD CHARLES, C.M.G. (1915).—B. 1863; clk. treas., W. Australia, Apl., 1881; pol. inspr. S. dists., June, 1886; ag. govt. treas. Wyndham, May, 1888; ditto, Roebourne, June, 1889; sec. W. Australian govt. agency, London, May, 1891; ag. agent-gen., 1909.

HARKNESS, EDWARD BURNS.—Entered treas., New S. Wales, 1891; sec. to Premier's office, 1901-16; under sec., depts. of ch. sec. and public health, since 1916.

HARLEY, JOHN A.—M.B., Ch.B. (Edin.), certif. Lond. S.T.M. (with distinction), July, 1909; apptd. to W.A.M.S., Gambia, 16th Apr., 1910; ag. protectorate med. offr., 2nd Jan. to 11th May, 1911.

HARMAN, H. A. A. F., D.S.O.—B. Sc.(Lond.), Capt. 4th (S.R.) Batt., S. Staff. Regt.; prin., govt. training inst. for teachers, Accra, Gold Coast, 17th Apr., 1912; ag. adjt. Gold Coast volunteers, 29th Jan. to 30th July, 1915; supervising offr., No. 5 Young Officer Compy., West Lancs. Divn., 29th Nov., 1915, to 8th Mar., 1916 (temp. major); ag. G. Coast Regt., 14th May, 1916, to 31st Dec., 1918, for service in E. Africa (slightly wounded twice ment. in desps.); major, 2nd in command 4th Batt. Gold Coast Regt., 1st Nov., 1918; prin., King's Coll., Lagos, Dec., 1919.
HARMAN, WM. HENRY.—B. 1882; apptd., after compet. exam., clk. of the 2nd div. of the civ. serv. and assigned to science and art dept., 10th Apr., 1900; to bil. of agric., 6th June, 1901; transf. to C.O., 27th Jan., 1902.

HARPER, CHARLES HENRY, O.B.E. (1919).—Ed. at Blundell's schl., Devon, and Exeter Coll., Oxford; B.A., 1899; called to the bar, Inner Temple, 5th May, 1909; cadet, G. Coast, 24th Jan., 1900; attached to Ashanti field force, 1st June to 1st Sept., 1900; asst. dist. commr., 6th Sept., 1901; ag. asst. col. sec., 26th Oct., 1904; asst. col. sec., 8th Feb., 1906; ag. chief asst. col. sec. and clk. of couns., 14th Apr. to 25th June, 1906; cantonment mag., Coomassie, 16th Oct., 1906; prov. commr., 23rd July, 1909; cenm. offr., 1911; ag. other asst. and clk. of couns., 16th May to 29th June, 1912; ag. col. sec., June to Oct., 1912, and from 3rd May to 27th Aug., 1914; attached to Togoland field force, 29th Aug., 1914; sen. polit. offr., Togoland, 30th Sept. to 23rd Dec., 1914; chief asst. col. sec., 14th Feb., 1915; ag. col. sec., 26th June to 17th Nov., 1915, 27th Nov., 1915, to 27th June, 1916, and from 2nd Dec., 1916, to 23rd Apr., 1917.

HARPER, FRANCIS HENRY, M.B.E. (1920).—B. 1877; transferred from the service of the Royal Niger Co. as supplementary clk. to C.O., 1st Jan., 1900; conf. clk., Nov., 1912.

HARRAGIN, ALFRED ERNEST ALBERT.—B. 1877; sub-inspr., constab., Trinidad, 1st Feb., 1903; inspr., 1st Nov., 1912; now serving with the army as temp. major.

HARRAGIN, WALTER.—B. 1890; barrister-at-law; clk. of the peace and sub-registr., San Fernando and Victoria, Trinidad, 9th Mar., 1914; served with the army as temporary captain; mag., Victoria, Sept., 1915.

HARRAGIN, WILLIAM THORNTON.—B. 1887; clk., sup. ct., Trinidad, 1910; asst. mast., Queen's Royal Coll., 1911; held comm. in Gordon Highlanders, 1915-16; served in France, May to Oct., 1915; asst. mast., Queen Victoria Schl., Fiji, 1916; supervisor of customs, 2nd cls., G. Coast, 1st June, 1918.

HARREL, MELVILLE DAVID.—B. 1872; attchd. Royal Irish constab. depot, 1895; certif., drill and police duties; sub-inspr. Jamaica constab., Jan., 1896; spcl. serv. to Nicaragua, Jan., 1897; 3rd cl. inspr., Nov., 1901; 2nd cl., Feb., 1907; 1st cl., June, 1913; deputy inspr.-gen., Oct., 1913; ag. inspr.-gen. of police and prisons, July to Sep., 1914; inspr.-gen. of police and comdt. local forces, Barbados, Aug., 1916; local rank of lieut.-col., 1919.

HARRIGAN, SAMUEL SIMONS.—Head teacher, Wesleyan schls., Virgin Is., 1878; resig., 1903; clerical asst., govt. offices, Road Town, 1903; ag. govt. offr., West End, Nov., 1904, Feb., 1905, and Feb. to Apr., 1907; govt. offr., Road Town, 1906.

HARRIOTT, EDMUND COWLES.—B. 1866; clk. to commr., and to legis.bd., Turks and Caicos Isld., Nov., 1887; inspected govt. schls., 1890, 1891, and 1902; ag. regir. sup. ct., and of deeds, 1891 and 1894; ag. asst. commr. (dist. mag.), regir. sup. ct. and regir.-gen., man. savings bank, and inspr. of pol. and prisons), G. Turk, May to July, 1896, Aug. to Nov., 1901, and May to Aug., 1906; J.P., 1901; ag. and., Aug. and Sept., 1901, and June to Aug., 1906; ag. dist. mag., visiting Caicos Is., July, 1902; ag.acctnt. and clk. (collr. of cust., postmr., cashier and regir. shipping); commr.'s office, Apl. to June, 1903; confirmed July, 1903; ag. offl. mem., legis. bd., 1906; 1st cls. clk., rev. dept., Jamaica, Jan., 1907; ag. asst. commr., Salt Cay, May to July, 1909; ag. deputy stamp commr., Aug. to Nov., 1909; served in cust. dept., occupied territory, E. Africa, 1916-18; collr. of taxes and parochial treas., St. Anne, Jamaica, Jan., 1920.

HARRIS, SIR CHARLES ALEXANDER, K.C.M.G. (1917); C.B. (1904); C.M.G. (1900); C.V.O. (1917); M.V.O. (1911), B.A.—B. 1885; scholar, prizeman, and Porteus medallist of Christ's Coll., Camb.; Tancred student in com. law, Lin's Inn, 1877; 12th classic, 1878; apptd. 2nd cls. clk., C.O., after open competn., 1st July, 1879; sec. to W. Indies Finance Comm., Dec., 1882; asst. sec. Sugar Bounties Comm., 1889; priv. sec. to Mr. Buxton, M.P., Jan., 1894, to June, 1896; and to the Earl of Selborne, June, 1896; 1st class clk., 1896; specially engaged in work connected with Venezuelan bdry. arbitn., 1896-8; prin. clk., Nov., 1898; sent to Paris, 1899, in connection with the Venez. bdry. arbitn.; conducted British case in Brazilian-B. Guiana boundary arbitn., 1901-4; mem. of comttee. to inquire into organisation of Crown agents' office, 1906; ch. clk., 1st Feb., 1909; represented C.O. on advisory comttee. of comml. intell., B. of T., 1900-17; mem. of managing comttee. of Imp. Inst. 1909-16; gov. and c. in c., Newfoundland, 1st Nov., 1917; assumed govt., 17th Dec., 1917; author of numerous articles in Dict. of Pol. Econ. on economic and statistical subjects, and of lives of various colonial govs. and statesmen in Dict. of Nat. Biog.

HARRIS, HERBERT JOHN.—B. 1884; entd. serv. of Imperial Post Office, 1st Jan., 1900; transf. to dept. of posts and telegraphs, Cape of Good Hope, 13th Nov., 1902; resign., Dec., 1907, and entd. S. Rhodesia telegraph serv., 1st Jan., 1908; seconded for serv. with African Trans-Continental Telegraph Co., 12th Apr., 1908; resign., 31st Jan., 1910; provincial postmaster, S. Nigeria, 1st Feb., 1910; asst. supt. of posts and telegraphs, Fed.Malay States, 14th June, 1918; seconded for mil. serv., Mar., 1918; 2nd lieut., Indian army res. of offrs., unattached, Mar., 1918; 2nd lieut., 91st Punjabis, July, 1918; lieut., Mar., 1919; released from army serv., Oct., 1919.

HARRIS, REGINALD ROBERT.—B. 1890; ed. Queen Mary's Schl., Basingstoke; clk., govt. sec.'s office, Nyassaland Prot., 18th June, 1913; editor, govt. gaz. since 1914; clk., 1st grade, Oct., 1920; ag. ch. clk., secretariat, Nov. 1920 to June, 1921.

HARRIS, HON. ROBERT EDWARD, D.C.L., LL.D.—B. 1860; ed. High School, Annapolis Royal; pri. tuition; D.C.L., King's Coll., Univ., Windsor, N.S.; LL.D., Dalhousie Univ., Halifax, N.S.; called to the N.S. bar, 1882; K.C., 1889; practised at Yarmouth, 1882-92; Halifax, 1892-1915; justice, sup. ct., N.S., 1915; ch. just., sup. ct., N.S., 7th Feb., 1918; selected as third arbitr. to determine value of Canadian Northern Rly. stock, on its acquisition by the Dom. Govt.; mem. of the coun. of the N.S. Barrister's Soc., and for some years pres.; chancellor, diocese of N.S., 1906; dir., schl. for blind, Halifax; gov. of King's Coll., Windsor, N.S.

HARRISON, ALBERT SENDON, M.Sc. Manchester, 1908.—B. 1887; on staff of Manchester Univ., and asst. mast., Fielden demonstrn. schl., 1908-10; senr. mast., Halesowen comml. schl., 1910-12; on staff Manchester Univ. educn. dept., and headmr., Fielden demonstrn. schl., 1912-14; inspr. of schl., Ceylon, Apr., 1914; on active serv., 1918-19; ag. asst. dir. of educn., Ceylon, May, 1919, to Apr., 1920; ag. dir. of educn., Apr. to Oct., 1920; ag. asst. dir. of educn., Oct., 1920.
HARRISON, Cuthbert Woodville.—B. 1874; ed. at Sherborne Sch., Clifton Coll., Balliol Coll., Oxford, and with Walter Wren Esq.; 3rd cl. class. mods., 1894; cadet, F.M.S., Nov., 1897; ag. aast. dist. offr., Klang, May, 1899; also ag. harb. mast., Klang, Feb., 1901; passed cadet, Apr., 1901; aast. dist. offr., Ulu Langat, continued also as ag. aast. dist. offr., Klang, and harb. mast., at Port Swettenham, Oct., 1901; ag. dist. offr., Ulu Langat, Dec., 1903; ditto Tampin, Mar., 1904; also aast. dist. offr., Matang, Oct., 1904; ag. aast. sec. to res., Mar., 1905; ag. sec. to res., Aug., 1906; ag. aast. sec. to res., Dec., 1906; ag. regis., sup. ck., Nov., 1907; ag. aast. dist. offr., Larut, Feb., 1908; also ag. dist. offr., Larut, and regis. of titles, Perak North, Aug., 1908; dist. offr., Ulu Langat, Mar., 1909; ag. aast. dist. offr., Larut and Kris, and regis. of titles, Perak North in addition, Feb., 1911; ag. sec. to res., Jan., 1912; dist. offr., Larut Sep., 1914; colls. of land rev., Seremban, and regis. of titles, Negri Sembilan, May, 1915; temporarily ag. British res., Negri Sembilan, in addition, Aug., 1917; colls. of land rev., Kuala Lumpur, and regis. of titles, Selangor, 8th Mar., 1918; sec. to res., Selangor, 24th July, 1919; sec. to res., Perak, Dec., 1921; editor of "Illustrated Guide to F.M.S."; author of "The Magic of Malaya," and "Railway Guide to F.M.S. and Siam"; 2nd lieut., Malayan Vol. Infantry.

HARRISON, James Herbert Hugh.—Ed. Regent's Park Coll., and New College (Lond.), and at University Coll. and Hospital; F.R.C.P. (Lond.); M.R.C.S. (Eng.); dist. mag. and dist. surg., Cayo, Br. Honduras, 1890; ag. dist. surg., Orange Walk, 1891, 1892; dist. comsnr. and dist. surg., Orange Walk, June, 1892; aast. col. surg., Belize, 12th May, 1897; col. surg., 1st Sept., 1906.

HARRISON, John Burchmore, C.M.G. (1901).—B. 1856; Nat. Sc. scholar, Christ's Coll., Camb., B.A. (Nat. Sc. Tripos), 1878; M.A., 1887; prof. of chemistry and agricul. science, Barbados, Sept., 1879; govt. analyst and prof. of chem., Br. Guiana, Dec., 1889; director of dept. of science and agric., Br. Guiana, Jan., 1905; is F.L.C., F.G.S., F.C.S., and F.G.S. of America; author of numerous papers relating to the agric. and geology of the W. Indies and B. Guiana; on spec. serv. to U.S.A. in connection with questions relating to sugar analysis, recd. thanks of U.S. govt.; specially thanked on several occasions by S. of S. for services in connection with tropical agriculture, etc.

HARRISON, Norman, C.M.G., D.S.O., (1918), A.M.I.K.E.—Jnrn. clk., dept. of posts and telegraphs, Pietermaritzburg, 1st Feb., 1890; 4th cls. clk., 27th Feb., 1894; 3rd cls. clk., 1st Sept., 1894; 2nd cls. clk., 1st Jan., 1898; 2nd aast. engrnr., 1st Mch., 1898; 1st aast. engrnr., 1st Nov., 1901; ag. chief engrnr., from 8th June to 13th Sept., 1903; transf. to Transvaal as aast. engrnr. of telegraphs, 1st Dec., 1903; engrnr., 1st Apr., 1908; acted as chief engrnr., 6th Feb. to 4th Aug., 1908; ag. chief engrnr., 1st Nov., 1908; chief engrnr., 1st July, 1909; ag. engrnr.-in-chief, posts and telegraphs, Union of S. Africa, 1910; engrnr.-in-chief, 1st April, 1912; dir. of signals, S. African Forces, 1914; aast. dir. of army signals, B.E.F., France, 1916.

HARRISON-JONES, Charles.—B. 1884; ed. Reading and St. John's Coll., Oxford (B.A.); cadet, Ceylon civ. ser., Nov., 1907; pol. mag., Puttalam, Jan., 1909; aast. govt. agt., Colombo and Negombo dists., July, 1910; ag. aast. gov. agt., Hambantota, Apr., 1912; pol. mag., Matara, May, 1912; ag. aast. gov. agt., Mannar, Feb., 1913; on military duty, Jan., 1915; dist. judge Tangalla, Dec., 1919; ag. aast. govt. agt., Matale, June, 1920.

HARRISONSON, Sydney Thirlwall, C.M.G. (1908), O.B.E. (1919).—Ed. Blackheath; appd. aast. act., P.W.D., G.C. Col., 9th Nov., 1894; ch. act., 2nd June, 1897; aast. act., W.A.F.F., 26th Feb., 1898; ch. act., 8th Nov., 1899; treas., N. Nig., 1st Jan., 1900; comptroller of customs, Barbados, 1908.

HART, Walter Edward.—B. 1847; librarian, public library and museum, Mauritius, 1st Oct., 1903.

HART-DAVIS, Charles Henry.—B. 1874; ed. at Eton and New Coll., Oxford, B.A.; served in 13th I.Y. in South Africa, 1900 (Queen's medal, 3 clasps); priv. sec. to Sir W. Haynes Smith, Cyprus, 1901; aast. insp. of schools, Cyprus, 1901 to 1906; passed exams. in Turkish and Greek, 1903; insp. of schools, Gold Coast, 1906; dist. comsnr., 1906 to 1910; sec. to high comsnr. for the Western Pacific, 1910; on mly. serv., 1915-19; ch. aast. sec., Cyprus, Apr., 1920; ag. ch. inspr. of schls., Aug. to Oct., 1919; ag. ch. sec., Sept. to Dec., 1919; ag. regis.-gen., Dec. to May, 1920; ag. comsnr., July to Oct., 1920; ag. ch. sec., 27th Oct., 1920 to 3rd Feb., 1921, 17th to 23rd Mar. and 11th May to 3rd Oct., 1921.

HARTNELL, G. F. W.—Chief mechanical engrnr., Uganda rlyw., June, 1918.

HARVEY, David Harold.—Entd. Natal civ. serv., Apr., 1898; transf. to Swaziland adminstr. as clk., Mar., 1903; sub-inspr., Swaziland police, Apr., 1907; dep. aast. comsnr., Apr., 1911.

HARVEY, Hon. Horace, B.A., LL.B.—B. 1863; ed. Univ. Coll., Toronto Univ.; called to the bar, Ontario, 1889; admitted to practice in N.W.T., 1893; regis. of land titles for South Alberta regt. dist., 1896; dep. atty.-gen. of N.W.T., 1900; puisne judge, sup. ct., N.W.T., June, 1904; puisne judge, sup. ct. of Alberta, 1907; ch. just. of Alberta, Oct., 1910; ch. just., trial divn., sup. ct., Alberta, 15th Sept., 1921.

HARVEY, Hon. John Musgrave.—B. 1865; judge of the sup. ct., New S. Wales, 1913.

HASKINS, Wilfred J., A.M.C.E.A.—Aast. supt. of wks., S. Stithla, Mar., 1905; dist. engrnr., F.M.S. rlyw., May, 1912; senr. dist. engrnr., grade B., F.M.S. rlyw., July, 1919; ag. engrnr., for ways and wks., Nov., 1920.

HASTINGS, A. C. G.—Served in 43rd Co. I.Y. in S. African war, Jan., 1900, to Aug., 1901; attached to vice-consulate, Fez, Dec., 1901, to Sept., 1905; ag. vice-consul, Nov., 1903, to May, 1904; aast. res., N. Nigeria, Apr., 1906; 3rd cls. res., 1911.

HASZARD, Hon. Francis Longworth.—B. 1849; ed. at Prince of Wales's Coll., Prince Edward Is.; called to the bar, 1872; K.C., 1894; elected to legis., P.E.I., 1904 and 1908; mem. exec. coun., 1905; prem. and atty.-gen., P.E.I., 1908; judge, supreme et., and master of the rolls, P.E.I., 1911.

HATCHER, C. M.—B. 1873; apptd., after compete exam., clk. 2nd div. civ. ser., and assigned to W.O., 11th Sept., 1893; transf. to C.O., 18th Mar., 1896; minor staff offr., Feb., 1902; staff clk., first grade, July, 1913.

HATHORN, Hon. Kenneth Howard, K.C.—B. 1849; puisne judge of supreme ct. of S. Africa (Natal prov. division), May, 1910.

HAUGHTON, T. H.—B. 1881; served in S. African Constab., Mar., 1901, to Dec., 1907;
held rank of lieut. and sub-inspr. (Queen's medal with five clasps); asst. res., Muri Prov., N. Nigeria, 9th May, 1908.

HAWKEN, H. E. A.—B. 1879; ed. pub. schls., Ottawa Colleg. Inst.; ent. civ. serv. of Canada as jun. elk., dept. marine and fisheries, 1901; 2nd ds. elk., 1906; 1st cls. elk., 1910; ch. elk., 1917; asst. dep. min., 1st Apr., 1920.

HAWKINS, GERALD.—B. 1891; B.A., London Univ.; pte., 1/5th Gloucester Regt., 8th Aug., 1914; 2nd lieut., 1/5th Gloucester Regt., 7th Feb., 1915; B.E.F., 29th Mar., 1915; ment. in desp., 20th Dec., 1917; wounded, and discharged with rank of capt., 5th May, 1920; cadet, F.M.S., 20th Nov., 1920; add. to land office, Penang, 21st Dec., 1920; dep. collr. of land rev., Penang, 14th Jan., 1921.

HAY, CLIFFORD H., C.M.G., M.V.O.—Sec. to premier of New S. Wales since Mar., 1916.

HAY, SIR JAMES SHAW, K.C.M.G. (1889), C.M.G. (1887)—B. 1838; joined 89th (Princess Victoria's) regt. in 1858; served in India during the latter part of the Mutiny; was adjt. for some time, and afterwards instructor of musketry; ag. adjt. to the provisional depot catt. at Dum Dum in 1869; adjt. to the Glasgow Highland volks. in 1868 at their formation; asst. inspr., G. Coast armed native pol., 1875; dist. commr. of Accra, Oct., 1875; inspr.-gen., G. Coast constab., Apr., 1877; asst. col. sec., G. Coast col., 1878; had charge of several special missions to the tribes in the interior; ag. col. sec. from Oct., 1878, to Jan., 1880, and again, Aug., 1880; inspr.-gen. of pol., Mauritius; admstr. of the Gambia, 1885; adminstr. the govt. of the W. Africa Stlttns., from July, 1886, to Dec., 1887; gov., Sierra Leone, Oct., 1886; served in the Yonnie expdn., 1887-8 (medal and clasp); ag. admstr., Barbados, 1891; gov., Barbados, 1892 to 1900.

HAYCRAFT, SIR THOR. WAGTAFFER KT. RCH. (1919).—B.A., St. John's Coll., Oxon; called to the bar. In Tem., 1886; practised in the S.E. circuit and Sussex sessions; examr. of the ct., 1889 to 1899; apptd. arbitrator on bd. of Lond. cham. of arbitn., 1897; pres. dist. ct., Larnaca, Cyprus, 1889; pol. mag., Gibraltar, 1911; puisne judge, Mauritius, 1913; ch. just., Grenada, 1916; author of "Executive Powers in relation to Crime and Disorder."

HAYDON, LEONARD GUSCOTE, D.S.O.—M.B., C.M., D.P.H. (Univ. of Aberdeen); admstr. M.O., plague suppression, Mandvi, Bombay, 1897; pub. health serv., Victorian Govt., 1898; civ. surg., etc., S. Africa, 1900; pub. health serv., Natal govt., 1902; asst. M.O.H., Union of S. Africa, 1910; A.D.M.S., central force, S.W. African campaign, 1914; prin. med. offr., S.W. African Prot., 1915; asst. M.O.H., Union of S. Africa, 1917; asst. health offr., Union of S. Africa, 1919.

HAYES, HON. J. B., C.M.G.—Rep. the dist. of Bass, Tasmania, in H. of A. since 1913; min. of lands, works and agr., 1916-19; min. for works and agr. from 1919; is a mag. of the territory.

HAYNES, ALVIN SIDNEY.—B. 1878; ed. at Haileybury Coll.; cadet, F.M.S. civ. serv., Nov., 1901; attached to dist. office, Batang Padang, Jan., 1902; ag. financial asst., Krian, Oct., 1902, to Apr., 1908; passed final exam. in law, Oct., 1902; mag. for Perak, 1902; passed final exam. in Tamil, Aug., 1903; ag. financial asst., Krian, Sept., 1903; administered estate of late Datoh Panglima Kinta in Perak, 1904-1906; passed final exam. in Malay, Nov., 1905; ag. asst. dist. offr., Kuala Kangsar, Mar., 1906; ag. inspr. of schls., Negri Sembilan, Nov., 1906; 1st cls. mag., Negri Sembilan, 1906; ag. asst. supt. of Indian immigrts., Penang, Nov., 1906; asst. supt., ditto, Nov., 1906; examiner in Tamil, Perak and Penang; ag. supt. of Indian immigrts., F.M.S. and S. Stlttns., Feb. to May, 1910; ag. asst. supt. of immigrts., Klang, Jan., 1911; passed final exam. in Siamese, Aug., 1912; ag. dist. offr., Pekan, Sept., 1912; ag. dist. offr., Kuala Kangsar, Dec., 1914; mem. of board of examiners in Malay for Perak, Apr., 1915; dist. offr., Tampin, 1916; sec. to high commr., F.M.S., Apr., 1920.

HAZELTON, ERIC.—B. 1895; 2nd lieut., Monmouthshire Brig., R.F.A., June, 1915; joined B.E.F., France, Nov., 1916; lieut., R.H. and R.F.A., June, 1916; served with E.E.F., Suez Canal, Sinai, Palestine, 1916-19; cadet, F.M.S., Johore, Dec., 1919; 2nd asst. adviser to govt. of Johore, Jan., 1921.

HAZEN, HON. SIR JOHN DOUGLAS, K.C.M.G. (1918). K.C., LL.D.—B. 1860; ed. at Collegiate Schl., Fredericton, and Univ. of New Brunswick; called to the bar, 1883; K.C., 1894; elec. to H. of C., Canada, for St. John City and County, 1891; defeated, 1896; elec. to New Brunswick legis. for Sunbury, 1899, 1903, 1908; leader of the opposition in the New Brunswick legis. during that period; prem. and atty.-gen. of New Brunswick, 1908-1911; has been pres. of St. John law soc. and barristers' soc. of New Brunswick; mem. of the P.C. for Canada, and min. of marine and fisheries in Mr. Borden's cabinet, Oct., 1911; chief just. of New Brunswick, Nov., 1917.

HAZLERIGG, THOMAS MAYNARD, M.C.—Admitted solr., sup. ct., England, Jan., 1906; lieut., R.A.S.C., Aug., 1914-May, 1915; capt., R.A.S.C., May, 1915-Nov., 1920; asst. crown solr., Hong Kong, Oct., 1920; ag. asst. land offr., May-Dec., 1921, in addn.

HKAD, W. G.—B. 1899; apptd. after compet. exam. asst. elk., C.O., Oct., 1916; on mil. serv. from July, 1917, to Oct., 1919; cler. offr., 1st Jan., 1920.

HEARSEY, HERBERT HYDE YOUNG, O.B.E. (1918).—M.B., C.M. (Edin.), 1890; med. offr., Nyasaland Prot., June, 1896; prin. med. offr., Apr., 1902; dir. of med. serv. (with temp. rank of lieut.-col.), Nyasaland Field Force, Mar., 1916.

HEARST, SIR WILLIAM HOWARD, K.C.M.G. (1917).—B. 1884; ed. pub. schls., Collingwood Coll. Inst., and Toronto Univ.; called to the bar, 1888; K.C., 1908; prominent legal practitioner at Sault Ste. Marie, Ontario; now head of firm Hearst, Rowland and Atkin; has been counsel in all more important civil and criminal cases in Algoma district in recent years; unsuccessful cand. for legis. assembly, Ontario, 1894; elec. at g.e., 1908, 1911, and 1914; min. of lands, forests and mines in Whitney administration, 1911; premier of Ontario, 1914; also min. of agric.; defeated at g.e., Oct., 1919; resign. with his govt., Nov., 1919; mem. internat. joint comm. (Can. section), 23rd Feb., 1920.

HEATH, ASHTON MARLER, M.I.C.E. (1898); M.I.M.E. (1898).—B. 1859; ed. at Manchester gram. schl.; served at Messrs. Sharp, Stewart & Co.'s loco. wks., Manchester, 1877-1882; asst. under loco. supt., L. & S. W. Ryw., 1882-1887; inspr. under Sir A. M. Rendel, K.C.I.E., 1887-1897; chief asst. engnr. to J. Carruthers, Esq., M.I.C.E., consulting engnr. to W. Aust. and N. Zealnd govt., 1897-1900; entd. Crown Agents' office as head of engineering and wks. dept., 1900; head of engineering inspnt. dept., and chief inspecting engnr. since 1904; mem. of engineering
standards comte., 1905; assoc. mem. of mech. transport comte. of War Office, 1907; mem. of deptl. conference on leadless glaze, 1908.

HEATH, W. G.—M.B., Ch.B., Edin. Univ.; qualified 1897; med. offr., Windward dist., Dominica, 1898; med. offr., dist. 2, Montserrat, 1901; ag. med. offr., dist. "D," Dominica, 1903; ditto, dist. "A," 1904; ag. med. offr., Montserrat, 1905, 1912, and since 1916; pres. defence reserve, 1909; ag. mem. legis. coun., 1911; ag. med. offr., Antigua, 1911; mem. legis. coun., May, 1915; med. offr.-in-charge of Montserrat recruits for the B.W.I. regt., Mar., 1916; surg.-lieut. defence force, 1916; provisionally mem. exec. coun., 1916; ag. commr., Montserrat, on several occasions since Feb., 1918.

HEDOG-JONES, DAVID.—Ed. at Univ. Coll. of Wales, 1902-1906; dept. of Agric. Science (agric. scholar), and at Jesus Coll., Oxford (Nat. Science exhibitioner), 1907-1911; B.A., 1910; M.A., 1914; holder of National Diplomas in the science and practice of agriculture and dairying (N.D.A. and N.D.D.); associate of Univ. Coll. of Wales; F.R. Anthrop. Inst.; apptd. prin. of secondary schools, Grenada, 1911; deleg. to W. Indian Agric. Conf., 1912; editor of the "Caribbean," and author of "The Development of the Negro" and "Negro Folk Lore," and various agricultural and educational papers; a lieut. and adjutant of the Grenada volunteer force; acted as adjutant to West Indian Overseas Contingent, 1916.

HEIDENSTAM, EDGAR HENRY DE.—Ed. Rossall and private tutors; ag. priv. sec. to Sir W. F. Haynes Smith, high commr. of Cyprus, 1st Nov., 1901, to 13th July, 1902; clk., exec. sec.'s office, 14th July, 1902; inspr. of Cyprus military police, 1st Feb., 1905; a.d.c. and priv. sec. to Sir C. King-Harman, and clk. to exec. coun., 1st Mar., 1906; clk. to legis. coun. and asst. clk., chief sec.'s office, 1st Oct., 1907; ag. chief clk., C.S.O., 13th July to 15th Oct., 1908; ag. asst. sec. to govt., July to Oct., 1915, and from Aug., 1916, to May, 1917; asst. sec., 1st Feb., 1918; ag. priv. sec., Nov., 1918; asst. audr., 1st Sept., 1920.

HEIDENSTAM, OSCAR CHARLES.—B. 1877; ed. at King's Sch., Warwick; vol. clk., col. sec.'s off., Cyprus, 5th Feb., 1897; 3rd div. clk., ditto, 16th Jan., 1899; inspr. of pol., 12th Jan., 1904; sent to Egypt for training with H.M.'s troops, May, June, and July, 1904; in command of depot, 8th Aug., 1904; in command of Kyrenia div., gov. of prison and dep. coroner, 15th July, 1905; in command of Papho div., gov. of prison and dep. coroner, 4th Aug., 1906; acted as commr. for Papho on several occasions; passed in mod. Greek, lower standard, Apr., 1906; ag. priv. sec. and A.D.C. to high commr., Sir C. A. King-Harman, and clk. of exec. coun., 4th Jan. to 15th Feb., 1907; temporarily attached to ch. sea.'s off., 16th Feb., 1907; in comd. of col., Kyrenia div., gov. of pris., and dep. coroner, 24th June, 1907; asst. dist. supt. of pol., Uganda Prot., 12th July, 1907; in comd. of Entebbe pol., and supt. of cent. gaol, 10th Sept., 1907; inspr. of police, Cyprus, Apr., 1910.

HELLINGS, GEOFFREY STUART.—B. 1888; ed. Christ's Hosp. [foundation school] and St. John's Coll., Camb., Stewart of Rannoch Univ. schol., Camb., 1909; B.A., 1910 (cl. trip. ii, 1); cadet, F.M.S., Nov., 1911; seconded for mil. ser., Jan., 1915; 2nd lieut., 8th (Service) Batt. Duke of Cornwall's Light Infy., Mar., 1915; 2nd lieut., 2nd Batt. D.C.L.I., May, 1916; lieut., 2nd Batt. D.C.L.I., Sept., 1916; ag. capt., 2nd Batt. D.C.L.I., June, 1918; demob., Sept., 1919; ag. 2nd asst. dist. offr., Batu (Gajah, Nov., 1919; ag. asst. prot. of Chinese, Perak, Dec., 1920.

HEMSTED, CHARLES SELWOOD.—3rd treasry. asst., E.A.P., 20th Apr., 1900; asst. collr., 1st Apr., 1903; dist. commr., 1st Apr., 1907.

HEMSTED, RUPERT WILLIAM, O.B.E. (1919).—2nd treasry. asst., E.A.P., 12th Sept., 1899; oh. acctnt., Somaliland, 1st Dec., 1901, to 1st Dec., 1903; asst. collr., E.A.P., 1st Dec., 1904; collr., 17th Dec., 1906; offr.-in-charge, Massai reserve, 1912.

HENDERSON, ALEXANDER.—B. 1874; appld. clk. refugee, campa, O.R.C., 1st Nov., 1901; clk. attached to audit dept., Apr., 1902; examnr. of accts, treasry, 20th Aug., 1902; acctnt., dept. of agric., 1st July, 1904; asst. acctnt., Union dept. of agric., Transval, June, 1911; acctnt. irrigtn. dept., Aug., 1912; ch. clk. and acctnt., irrigtn. dept., 1st Apr., 1915; ch. clk., irrigtn. dept., 1st Apr., 1921.

HENRNDSON, FREDERICK LOUIS.—Ed. at Camb. Univ.; B.A., 1897; M.R.C.S. (Eng.) L.R.C.P. (Lond.); med. offr., E. Africa and Uganda Prote., 18th Oct., 1904.

HENDRIE, LIEUT.-COL., HON., SIR JOHN STRATHBURN, K.C.M.G. (1915), O.V.O. (1907).—B. 1857; ed. at pub. schls., Hamilton, and Upper Canada Coll.; engrnr.; mayor of Hamilton, 1901-2; elec. Ontario legis., 1902, 1905, 1908, 1911 and 1914; min. without portfolio, 1906; mem. hydro-electric comn.; mem. battlefields comn.; mem. Strathcona trust; lieut.-col. Canadian Militia; comd. 2nd Bde. Can. Field Artill., 1904 to 1909; ex-pres. Can. Artill. Assoc.: ex-pres. Ontario Artill. Assoc.; lieut. gov. of Ontario, 1914-1919.

HENDRY, WILLIAM, M.A. (Edin.)—B. 1888; ed. Daniel Stewart's Coll., Edinburgh (dux and gold medallist), and Edinburgh Univ.; Egyptian educnl. serv., 1911-15 and 1919-20; served Royal Highlanders and Royal Irish Regt., 1915-19; ment. in deep, 1919; seconded as dir. of educn., Zanzibar, 1920.

HENKEL, JOHN SPURGEON.—Joined forest dept., Eastern Conservancy, Cape, 1st July, 1888; asst. to conservator, 1st Mar., 1890; dist. forest offr., King William's Town, 1st June, 1893; Stutterheim, 1st Aug., 1898; selected to proceed to Royal India Engineering Coll., Cooper's Hill, for scientific course of forestry: obtained coll. diploma and specially commended by pres. of coll., 6th Aug., 1902; asst. conservator of forests, Eastern Conservancy, 1st Oct., 1905; asst. conservator, Western Conservancy, 1st July, 1907; apptd. principal lecturer in forestry, S. African schl. of forestry, 29th Oct., 1906; resig. lecturship, 29th Feb., 1908; ohmn. of bd. of management, S. African schl. of forestry, 18th May, 1907 to 31st Jan., 1909; asst. conservator of forests, Midland Conservancy, 1st Feb., 1909; conservator of forests, Midland Conservancy, 2nd grade, 1st Apr., 1912; Conservator of Forests, Natal Conservancy, Dec., 1914; served as captain with dist. mounted troops during S. African war, 1901-2; Queen's medal; tranf., Rhodesian forest serv., 1st Jan., 1920.

HENLEN, GEORGE WILLIAM.—B. 1902; apptd. after compet. exam., asst. clk., C.O., Feb., 1920; cler. offr., 1st Jan., 1920.

HENNESSEY, PATRICK H.—M.R.C.S. (Eng.), L.R.C.P. (Lond.); house surg., S. Sttlmtn., Feb., 1907; supernumerary med. offr., Penang, Feb., 1908; med. offr. gen. hosp., Singapore, 1st May,
HERDMAN, GEORGE WALKER, M.A., B.Sc., M.Inst.C.E.—B. 1869; ed. Edinburgh Univ.; ast. engr. waterworks, in S. Africa, 1896-1899; engr. waterworks, England, 1900-1903; exec. engr., irrigtn. dept., Transvaal, Sept., 1903; inspecting engr., P.W.D., Transvaal, Mar., 1907; inspecting engr., P.W.D., Union of S. Africa, May, 1910; ast. dir. of irrigtn., Union of S. Africa, Sept., 1917.

HEREFORD, GEORGE A.—Cadet, S. Sttlmt., Nov., 1898; ast. dist. officer, Balik Pulau, Penang, Apr., 1899; passed final exam. in Malay, Oct., 1901; ast. dist. officer, Penang, Nov., 1902; ast. mag., Penang, Jan., 1904; ast. 2nd mag., Penang, Mar., 1906; ast. dist. officer, Batu Gajah, Jan., 1907; ast. mag., Kuala Lumpur, July, 1908; ast. dist. officer, Larut, July, 1909; ast. dist. officer, Kinta, Feb., 1910; ast. dep. pub. prosecutor, Kuala Lumpur, Apr., 1910; dist. officer, Raub, continued ast. dep. pub. prosecutor, May, 1910; offr., cls. III., Jan., 1912; passed final exam. for the bar, May, 1913; ast. regis., sup. ct., F.M.S., June, 1913; ast. censor, Penang, June, 1915; ast. senr. dist. officer, Prov. of Wellesley, June, 1915; ast. 2nd mag., Singapore, May, 1917; ast. dist. officer, Butterworth in addition, Nov., 1917; ast. pres., munic. commrs., Penang, May, 1919; offr., coll., land rev., Penang, May, 1919; offr., cls. II., Jan., 1919; ast. regis. of impts. and expts., Singapore, June, 1921.

HERMION-HODGE, H. B.—B. 1885; ed. Winchester coll. (scholar) and Magdalen coll., Oxford; B.A., hon. in mods. and hist.; ast. res., N. Nigeria, 26th Dec., 1908.

HEROLD, THOMAS BARRY.—Cape civ. ser., 1882-1901; ch. clk. to master of sup. ct., Transvaal, Oct., 1901; ast. master, June, 1902; commr. of protocols, Dec., 1904; master of the sup. ct., Oct., 1906; mem. of prisons advisory bd., Feb., 1907; dir. (chmn., 1907-8 and 1908-9), land and agric. bank, Oct., 1907; chmn. and gen.-man., land and agric. bank of South Africa, 1912; J.P., Union of S. Africa, 1912.

HERRIES, HON. SIR WILLIAM HERBERT, K.C.M.G. (1920), B.A., Camb., F.G.S.—B. 1858; entd. New Zealand parl., 1896; native min., 1912-21; min. of rlyws., 1912-21; min. of cust. and marine, 1919-21; min. of lab., 1920-21.

HERSHENSOHN, J. M. N. A.—1st cls., ast. govt. schls., Natal, 1899; clk., col. sec.'s dept., 1900; sworn translator, Dutch; senr. clk., 1906; civ. ser. exam., 1902; Dutch bd. of exams., 1903; one of the secretaries at S. Africa National Convention, 1908-1909; chief clk., admistr. dept., Natal Prov., 1910; ast. prov. sec., Aug.-Nov., 1913, and from Aug., 1917; prov. sec., 1st Feb., 1918.

HERTZOG, HON. J. B. M., B.A., LL.D., M.L.A.—B. 1866; ed. at Victoria Coll., Stellenbosch, and Amsterdam Univ.; judge of O.F.S., 1895 to 1900; comd. Boer forces of S.W. div., 1899 to 1902; one of the signatories of the treaty of Vereeniging; ast. gen., O.R.C.; min. of just., Union of S. Africa, 1910-1912.

HEWINS, WILLIAM ALBERT SAMUEL, M.P.—B. 1863; ed. at Wolverhampton Grammar schl. and Pembroke Coll., Oxford; M.A.; dir. of London schl. of economics, 1895-1903; teacher of modern economic history, Univ. of London, 1902-3; Tooke professor of economic science and statistics, King's Coll., 1897-1903; mem. of senate of Univ. of London, 1900-1903; late sec. of Tariff
HILL, ARTHUR HEYLIGER.—B. 1876; ed. Queen's Coll., Br. Guiana, and New Coll., Eastbourne; clk., treas., Br. Guiana, 1883; 3rd grade commr. of taxation, 1902; 2nd grade, 1904; sec. excise bd. and supervising commr., treas., in rev. branch, 1905; passed exam. in Hindi, 1906; 1st cls. clk., imgrn. dept., 1907; seconded as ast. emigrn. agt., Calcutta, Mar., 1913; ag. emigrn. agt. at Calcutta for Br. Guiana, Trinidad, Fiji and Jamaica, 14th Apr. to 7th Aug., 1914, and from 20th Nov., 1915 to 6th Nov., 1916.

HILL, JAMES REGINALD.—B. 1877; ed. Queen's Coll., B. Guiana; 7th clk., adminstr.-gen.'s off., B. Guiana, May, 1896; 5th cls. clk., police dept., Feb., 1897; sub-inspr. of police, Dec., 1900; dist. inspr. of police, Apr., 1903; ag. adjut. and musketry instr., July to Nov., 1906; ag. county inspr. of police, Nov., 1909 to Apr., 1910, and from June to Aug., 1911; ag. pay and qtrmr. from Sept., 1911; pay and qtrmr., 1st Jan., 1912.

HILLIER, GEORGE FRANCIS.—Ed. Highbury New Park Coll., Lond.; admitted to the bar of supreme ct., W. Aust., 1888; apptd. clk. of legis. coun. and clk. of parlt., June, 1901.

HILLYER, HERBERT KEYS, O.B.E. (1919).—B. 1881; apptd., after compet. exam., clk. of the 2nd div. of the civil service, and assigned to the C.O., July, 1900; short'h'd writer and ast. clk., col. sec.'s off., Ceylon, Jan., 1908; attd. durbars of native chiefs, Colombo, July, 1908; Kandy, May, 1909; Colombo, May and June, 1909; Kandy, July, 1910; Jaffna, Aug., 1910; Colombo, Aug., 1910; sec. to Colombo Lake development scheme coman., 1909; jt. sec. to agric. banks comittee., 1909; sec. to opium coman., 1909; sec. to legis. coun. constitution coman., 1910; sec. to tuberculous diseases coman., 1910; secret. ast., July, 1910; sec. to ankylostomiasis comittee., 1910; hon. sec. to King Edward VII. memorial fund comittee., 1910; sec. to rlyw. traffic coman., 1911; sec. to educatin. comittee., 1911-12; sec. to Colombo Port Coman., July, 1913; sec. Prince of Wales war fund, Aug., 1914; hon. sec. Brit. Red Cross fund, Ceylon, 1915; hon. sec. wounded French Soldiers fund, Ceylon, 1916; sec. Colombo rivercraft comittee., Oct., 1916; hon. sec., French Red Cross fund, 1917; on war service, 1918-1919; joint sec. pesco celebrations comittee., July, 1919.

HINSON, CAPT. W.—Ed. St. Lawrence Coll. and Lycee Descartes, Tours; solr., 1904; 5th Batt., E. Surrey Regt.; qualified as signalling instr., Aldershot, 1908; ast. dist. commr., G. Coast, 1911; dist. commr., 1916.

HISLOP FRANCIS DANIEL, M.A. (hons.), Edin. Univ.—B. 1891; capt. territorial army res. (3rd Royal Scots); on war serv., 1915-18, Gallipoli, Egypt, France; Hythe instr. machine gunnery, 1918; cadet, S. Stiltns, 1919; attached, treas., Singapore, Deo., 1919; ag. ast. supt., govt. monopolies, June, 1920.

HISLOP, JAMES, M.V.O. (1920), O.B.E. (1919).—B. 1870; entd. New Zealand civ. serv., 1885, New Zealand govt. rlyws., 1890; ast. priv. sec. to min. for rlyws. and postmstr. gen., 1900; priv. sec. to prime min., 1907; under sec. for internal affairs and clk. of wrks, 1912.

HITCHENS, ALFRED EDEN.—B. 1880; ast. engr., water wks., Trinidad, 24th Dec., 1900; 1st grade dist. offr., P.W.D., Trinidad, 24th Sept., 1906.

HOAR, WILLIAM HENRY.—B. 1864; apptd. under prison commrs., England, after civ. ser. exam., 1892; gaoler, St. Kitts-Nevis, June, 1896.
to Dec., 1898; ag. ch. keeper of prisons, Leeward Is., May to Nov., 1897; ch. warder, Belize, Br. Head., Jan., 1899; ag. keeper of prisons, Br. Head., on numerous occasions, 1900-1912; keeper of prisons, 1st Oct., 1913.

HOBBES, GEORGE.—M. Inst. C.E.; ed. at Christ Coll., Finchley; Telford Premium, Inst. C.E., 1906-9; asst. engr., Castries Harbour, St. Lucia, 1895; res. engr., ditto, 1899; res. engr., St. John's harbour, Antigua, 1891-1896; asst. engr. to consulting engineers, 1896-1902; res. engr., Famagusta harbour, Cyprus, 1902-1906; res. engr., Sierra Leone harbour wks., 1906-1909; res. engr., Gold Coast harbours, 1909, including Sierra Leone after 1912.

HODDAY, WILFRED ERNEST.—B. 1889; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., Dec., 1912; attached to col. sec.'s office, Jan., 1913; Colombo Kachcheri, April, 1913; Trincomalee Kach., Nov., 1913; ag. off. asst. to the gov't. agt., Ratnapura, May, 1914; on mil. duty, Sept., 1914; landing survr., Colombo customs, May, 1919.

HOBLEY, CHARLES WILLIAM, C.M.G. (1904).—Geologist to Impl. Br. E. Africa Co., Mar., 1890; 1st cls. asst. Uganda Prot., Aug., 1894; asst. dep. comntr., E. Africa Prot., 1st Apr., 1902; ag. comntr., 27th June to 1st Aug., 1904; assoo. mem. instit. of civ. engnr., Uganda mutiny medal; Nandi medal, 1900; M.L.C., E. Africa Prot., 1914.

HOBSON, WILLIAM EDWARD, M.B.E. (1919).—B. 1865; appkd., after compet. exam., elk. in lower (now 2nd) div. of the civ. serv., and assigned to the office of the comntr. of H.M.'s wrks. and publ. bldgs., 1st Jan., 1886; transf'd. to the C.O., April, 1891; asst. regtr., 1899; promoted to higher grade, Jan., 1900; staff elk., first grade, 1911.

HOCART, ARTHUR MAURICE.—Archaeological comntr., Ceylon, May, 1919.

HODGE, LEONARD PRECIVAL, F.S.I., Assoc. M.Inst.C.E.—Ed. Queen's Coll., Taunton, and King's Coll., Lond.; honors construc., 1886; 2nd el. supt., P.W., Jamaica, 1891; 1st el. ditto, and attached to head off., 1892; dir. of roads, G. Coast, 1894, but did not take up apptnt.; col. engrnr. and surv.-gen., Dominica, 1898; draughtsman, P.W.D., B. Guiana, 20th Mar., 1901; asst. engrnr. and draughtsman, Apr., 1906.

HODGE, S.O.V.—Asst. dist. comntr., E.A.P., Apr., 1914.
