RITCHIE, HON. GEORGE.—B. 1864; M.P., S. Australia, since 1902; comr., public works, 1914-15 and 1919-20; treas., Apr., 1920.

RITCHIE, GEORGE LE HARIVEL KERR BAINBRIDGE.—Natal Civ. Serv., 1891; lieut., 1st batt., N.R.R., 1892; served with Mashonaland Field Force, 1896, attached to Rhodesian Horse, present at the relief of Ft. Charter, Ft. Salisbury, Mazoe and Hartley Hills, ment. in desp. (medal and clasp); asst. collr., Nyasaland Prot., Dec., 1897; 2nd grade resident, Apr., 1907.

RITCHIE, HON. JAMES JOHNSTONE.—B. 1856; ed. Annapolis Acad. and King's Coll. Schl., Windsor, N.S.; LL.B., Harvard Law Schl., admitted to Bar of N.S., Dec., 1877; K.C., 1890; pres., N.S. Barristers Soc., 1910 and 1911; just. sup. ct., N.S., 16th Feb., 1912; judge in equity and judge of ct. for divorce and matrimonial causes, 12th May, 1915.

RITCHIE, PHILIP EMBURT, B.A., B.C.L.—B. 1865; ed. Heidelberg and Friedrichshafen, Germany; Montreal High Schl., gold and silver med., 1882; B.A., McGill Univ., first rank hons. mod. languages, and gov. gen.'s gold med., 1886; res. mast., Bishop's Coll. Schl., Lennoxville, Que., 1896-88; barrister and solr., Osgoode Hall, Toronto, 1891; B.C.L. and silver med., Trinity Univ., Toronto, 1895; Imp. copyright confere., London, 1910; one of the Can. dels. to the Internat. Indus. Property Conf., Washington, D.C., U.S.A., 1911; regiar. of copyrights, trade marks, etc., Canada, 1st Jan., 1906.

RIVERS-SMITH, STANLEY, O.B.E. (1919), M.A. (Cantab.).—B. 1877; ed. at St. Lawrence Coll., Ramsgate, and St. Catharine's Coll., Cambridge, (exhbtr.), entd. Egyptian civ. serv., 27th Sept., 1905; dir. of educn., Zanzibar, 2nd Oct., 1907; seconded for mil. serv., K.A.R., Dec., 1916; dir. of educn., Tanganyika Territory, 12th Sept., 1920.

ROACH, B. S.—B. 1864; entd. educn. dept., S. Australia, 1879; head teacher, 1891; editor of "Children's Hour"; inspr. of schls. since 1915.

ROBB, HON. JAMES ALEXANDER.—B. 1839; ed. at dist. schl. and Huntingdon Acad.; mayor of Valleyfield, 1906-10; el. to H.C., 1908, 1911, 1917 and 1921; min. of trade and commerce in King admin., 29th Dec., 1921.

ROBERT, FREDERIC.—Admitted a solicitor of sup. ct. of Mauritius, 1885; ag. mag., Rodrigues, from Nov., 1895, to Dec., 1896, June, 1897, to Sept., 1898, and Apr., 1900, to June, 1901; dist. clk. and sen. civ. status offr., Plaines Wilhems, Curepipe division, 15th July, 1901; ag. regir.-gen., May to Oct., 1903; ag. mag., Rodrigues, 1st Apr., 1904; ag. dist. and stip. mag. of Mauritius, 20th July, 1904; ag. mag., Lesser Dependencies, 19th Sept., 1904, confirmed assch., 11th Sept., 1905; confirmed as dist. and stip. mag., Mauritius, 1st Oct., 1907.

ROBERTS, ARTHUR HAMER.—B. 1888; ed. Aldenham Schl. and Jesus Coll., Camb.; called to the bar, Inner Temple, Nov., 1914; cadet, Fiji, Jan., 1915; priv. sec. to gov't., Fiji, Mar., 1915; ag. 1st cls. clk., col. sec's office, and clk. to exec. and legis. coun., Jan., 1916; passed cadet, June, 1916; priv. sec., Oct., 1916; 2nd grade dist. commr., 15th Oct., 1916; ag. crown solr., July, 1917; assigned dist. of Savu Savu, Aug., 1917; granted leave to proceed on act. serv., June, 1918.

ROBERTS, CHARLES CLIFTON, B.A.—Ed., St. Paul's Schl. and Keble Coll., Oxford; called to the bar, Middle Temple, 1910; asst. atty.-gen., Nyasaland Prot., Nov., 1919; ag. atty.-gen., May to Oct., 1920 and Mar., 1921.

ROBERTS, DAVID GWYN.—Clk., accounting dept., Cape Govt. rlyws., 1902; passed Cape civ. serv. exam., 1st class, Nov., 1902; clk., col. sec's office, Jan., 1903; transf'd to treasy., Sept., 1906; voluntarily retired from Cape civ. serv., Feb., 1909; clk., customs dept., Nyasaland Prot., 7th Oct., 1910; asst. traffic auditor, Gold Coast rlyws., 24th Sept., 1913.

ROBERTS, GEORGE FUBSE.—B. 1881; ed. Univ. Coll., London; telegraphist, G.P.O., Sept., 1897; 2nd div. clk., exchequer and audit dept., Apr., 1900; cadet, Ceylon civ. ser., Dec., 1905; off. asst. to gov't. agt., Uva Prov., Apr., 1907; pol. mag., Panadure, Jan., 1909; Jaffna, Dec., 1909; asst. gov't. agt., Hambantota, Nov., 1911; dist. judge, Nuwara Eliya, and comrnr. of requests and pol. mag., Nuwara Eliya, Hatton, May, 1912; pol. mag., Galle, Mar., 1915; pol. mag., Colombo, Mar., 1916; tea comsrr., Nov., 1918; controller of estate supplies, in addition to his own duties, May, 1919.

ROBERTS, J. C., F.I.P.S.—Official shorthand writer, Barbados, June, 1895.

ROBERTS, JACOB THOMAS.—B. 1874; ed. at C.M.S. Collegiate schl., Lagos; clerical ast., qtrmr.'s off., Hausa force, 16th Sept., 1898; 6th cls. clk., 3rd Aug., 1899; ast. storekpr., med. dept., 1st Jan., 1900; ag. med. storekpr. and warden, Lagos hosp., 4th Nov., 1903, to 3rd Jan., 1904; 4th cls. clk., med. dept., 1st Apr., 1904; 3rd cls. clk., audit off., 1st Feb., 1905; 2nd cls. clk., ditto, 1st Jan., 1907; 1st cls. clk., ditto, 1st Jan., 1908; in charge of audit off., Ebute Metta, 21st Jan. to 26th Feb., 1908; ast. chief clk., audit off., 1st Jan., 1911.

ROBERTS, PERCY HAMER.—Prison offr., Br. Guiana, 19th Nov., 1901; served penal settlt., Massaruni, and at Essequebo and Georgetown county prisons; clerical ast., Georgetown and Essequebo prisons; gaoler, G. Coast, 5th Mar., 1911; keeper, James Fort prison, 1st June, 1911.

ROBERTS, ROBERT.—B. 1872; apptd. to cust. serv., B. C. Africa Prot., July, 1904; ag. compr., cust., May, 1912 to Feb., 1913; temp. lieut. 1st K.A.R., Aug., 1915 to Mar., 1917; cust. serv.,
Tanganyika Territory, Mar., 1917 to Apr., 1919; ag. compt. of custs., Apr. 1919 to Sept., 1920; asst. ch. of cust., Zanzibar, Feb., 1921; ag. ch. of cust., Nov., 1921.

ROBERTS, THOMAS WHEELOCK.—B. 1880; ed. Hertford Coll., Oxford; cadet, Ceylon civ. ser., Oct., 1902; pol. mag., Matara, Aug., 1905; Panadura, Sept., 1906; dist. judge, Chiwaw, Feb., 1909; ag. dist. judge, Batticaloa, May, 1912; comnr. of requests, Colombo, Feb., 1914; asst. comnr. of excise, Mar., 1917; ag. excise comnr., Aug., 1920.

ROBERTSON, GEORGE HAWTHORN MINOT.—B.A. Oxon.; cadet, S. Stilts, Oct., 1908; sent to China to study Hokkien, June, 1909.

ROBERTSON, GEORGE WATSON, M.R.C.S. (Eng.), L.R.C.P. (Lond.)—Govt. pathologist, Cape Town and med. offr. in ch., govt. vaccine statn., Cape Town, 1921.

ROBERTSON, HON. GEORGE DECKER.—B.1874; ed. pub. and high schls., Welland, Ontario; called to the senate, Canada, 1917; mem. of the P.C. for Canada, 1918; cabinet min. without portfolio; min. of labour in National Govt., 7th Nov., 1918.

ROBERTSON, J. P.—Ed. Trinity Coll., Dublin; headmaster, govt. boys' schl., Acora, G. Coast, 11th Apr., 1908; inspr. of schls., 1st Jan., 1911; provincial inspr. of schls., 1st Jan., 1915; lieut.-G. Coast volunteers.

ROBERTSON, THOMAS ROBERT.—B. 1875; ed. Glenalmond, M.B., Ch.B., Edin.; formerly house surgeon and physician, Swansea hosp. and Victoria Park hosp. for chest diseases; civil surg., S. African Field Force, 1901-2 (medal and three clasps); asst. comnr. and gen. med. offr., Salt Cay., Turks Is., 1905; dist. comnr. and gen. med. offr., Caicos Is., 1905; gen. med. offr., Grand Turk, 1909.

ROBERTSON, WALTER BANNERMAN.—B. 1854; ed. at dist. schls., Marabfield, P. E. Island, high sheriff of Queen's Co., 1896 to 1902; col. of cust., for the port of Charlottetown, Apr., 1902.

ROBERTSON, W. C. F., C.M.G. (1919).—Ed. Trim. Coll., Dublin; exhibitioner, 1886 and 1887; classical scholar, 1888; classical moderator, 1889; inspr. of schls., G. Coast, 1898; director of educn., 1891; ag. comptroller of cust., 1899; compiled census rept., 1901; ag. sec. for native affairs, 14th June to 19th Nov., 1905; prov. comnr., 20th Nov., 1905; sec. for native affairs, 18th May, 1907; ag. col. sec., 4th July to 25th Sept., 1908; chief asst. col. sec., 22nd Jan., 1909; ag. col. sec., 1909; deputy gov., Jan., 1910; ag. col. sec., Sept., 1910, 11th May to 15th June, 1911, 14th July, 1911 to 5th Jan., 1912, 30th Oct. to 26th Dec., 1912, and 7th Mar. to 21st Aug., 1913; dep. gov., Dec., 1912, and April-May, 1913; ag. gov., 1st May to 27th Aug., 1914; dep. gov., 28th Aug. to 6th Sept., 1914; col. sec., Gibraltar, 12th Feb., 1915; lieut.-gov. and chief sec. to govt., Malta, May, 1917.

ROBERTSON-EUSTACE, ROBERT WILLIAM BARRINGTON.—Ed. at Shrewsbury; capt. reserve of officers and late 4th Batt., S. Stafford Regt.; served in the S. African War with Canadian Mounted Rifles and A.S.C. (medal and six clasps); asst. dist. supt. of pol., E. Africa Prot., 10th May, 1904; supl. of pol., 1910.

ROBIN, MAJOR GENERAL SIR ALFRED WILLIAM, K.C.M.G. (1916), C.B. (1909).—B. 1861; ed. privately at Otago high schl.; N. Zealand volr. offr.; comd. squadn., N. Zealand ntd. rifles, Queen Victoria's diamond jub., 1897; xmd. 1st N. Zealand contngt., S. Africa, 1899-1901; comdt., Otago mil. dis., 1902-07 (brev. col.); chief of gen. staff and 1st mil. mem. of coun. of defence, 1907-11 (col.); adjt.and qtrtnr.-gen., 1911-12; represented N. Zealand on imperial gen. staff, War Off., 1912-13; comdt. and G.O.C., N. Zealand mil. forces, 1914-19; maj.-gen., 1916.

ROBINSON, ALFRED FRANCIS.—Ed. privately and Durham Schl.; served European War, 1914-17; 6th K.A.R., E. Africa campaign, 1917-18; Uganda treas., 1911-13 (resigned); cust. dept., Tanganyika Territory, Dec., 1919.

ROBINSON, AUBREY CHARLES.—B. 1875; ed. Lancing Coll., and Hertford Coll., Oxford; B.A.; called to the bar, Inner Temple, Nov., 1901; practised at the bar, Jamaica, 1901 to 1911; comnr., and judge of grand ct., Cayman Is., Jan., 1913; compd. revised edition of Laws of Cayman Is. (publica. deferred during the war); reglar.-gen., Bahamas, Jan., 1918; perf. duties of S. and C. mag. in July and Dec., 1918, and from 25th Mar., 1919; reglar.-gen., Trinidad, Aug., 1919.

ROBINSON, FRANKLIN.—B. 1873; M.A., Durham Univ.; barrister, Inner Temple, 1915; cadet, S. Stilts, Oct., 1902; ag. head of Malay Coll., Malacca, Apr., 1903; demarcation offr., Malacca, 4th Dec., 1903; passed final exam. in Malay, Jan., 1904; mag., June, 1904; passed cadet, July, 1904; ag. dist. offr., Jassin, Dec., 1905; ag. dep. reglar. of sup. ct., sheriff, mag., comnr. of ct. of requests, reglar. of marriages, and chmn. of bd. of licensing justices, Malacca, Sept., 1907; ag. 3rd mag., Penang, Dec., 1907; ag. dist. offr., Prov. Wellesley, Mar., 1908; 3rd mag., Singapore, Mar., 1910; ag. dist. offr., Nibong Tebal, 5th Apr., 1912; ditto, Butterworth, 22nd Aug., 1913; ag. regsr., sup. ct., dist. judge and mag., Malacca, 26th Sept., 1913; offr. of ola. IV., 1st Aug., 1913; asst. dist. offr., Krian, 9th Aug., 1915; ag. 1st mag., Johore Bahru, 28th Dec., 1915; services lent to Kelantan govt., 14th Dec., 1917; dist. offr., Temerloh, 16th Jan., 1919; ag. asst. to atty.-gen., Nov., 1919; offr., ola. II., F.M.S., Jan., 1920; ag. reglar., sup. ct., Penang, Aug., 1920; ag. legal adviser and judge, Kedah, Oct., 1920.

ROBINSON, J. ALK, M.B.E. (1919).—J.P. and notary pub. for the col. (Newfildld.); ed. Vict. Coll., Jersey, and New Kingwood, Bath; prin. of Carbonate gram. schl., 1883-92; cloc. for Bonavista, 1897; col. sec. of Newfildld. and mem. of exec. coun., 1897; accepted leadership of legis. coun., Dec., 1897; May, 1898, retd. to H.A. for dist. of Trinity; mem. treasy. bd., 1898; M.L.C., 1910; postmr.-gen., 1916.

ROBINSON, LIEUT.-COL. SIR THOMAS BILBE, K.C.M.G. (1913), KT. BACH. (1910), K.B.E. (1918).—B. 1853; formerly major in command of 1st Queenslanders, and senior offr. in Cent. Queensland; man. and dir. of various public companies; J.P., Queensland, 1887; pres. of Rockhampton chamber of commerce; Queensland comnr. for Franco-British exhibn.; agt.-gen. for Queensland, 1910; mem. of comtee. for setttn. of ex-serv. men within the Empire, 1917.

ROBINSON, VICTOR GEORGE MELLOR, J.P. (Natal).—Asst. teacher, ed. dep., Natal, 1st Feb., 1890; clk., Eshowe magistracy, 22nd Aug., 1892; govt.'s off., 1st Nov., 1892; treasy., 27th Oct., 1893; res. comnr.'s off., 1st Oct., 1895; 1st clk., 27th Nov., 1897; 2nd ola. clk., chief mag. and ola. comnr.'s off., prov. of Zululand, master, chief mag. etc., and reglar., chief mag.'s and high cls., 30th Dec., 1897; sec. to chief mag. and civ. comnr., 1st Oct., 1900; 1st ola. clk., 1st Nov., 1900; junior mag., 1st Jan., 1904; acted as mag., Eshowe; transfd. to treasy., 9th Jan., 1905; under-treas., 1st May, 1906; mem. civ. ser. bd.;
sec. pub. debt comsrs., fixed estabmt.; ag. under sec. for finance, U. of S. Africa, 1910; mem., pub. serv. comn., 1st Aug., 1912; chmn., pub. serv. comn., Oct., 1921.

ROBISON, CHAS. CARR.—Ed. Dulwich Coll. and St. Paul's, Stony Stratford; served with several banking companies, etc.; attached to treasury, Sarawak, 1901; supt. of cust., 1902; postmr.-gen., shipping-mast. and supt. of cust., 1904.

ROBSON, WILLIAM.—Trained at Royal botanic gardens, Kew; curator, botanic station, Montserrat, Apr., 1905; hon. sec., permanent exhibn. comte.

ROCHE, HON. WILLIAM JAMES, M.D., LL.D.—B. 1859; ed. pub. schl., Lucan, Ontario, and high schl., London, Ontario, Trinity med. coll., Toronto; grad. M.D., with 1st cl. hon., Western Univ., London, Ontario, 1883; 1st grad. in medicine of that Univ.; LL.D. 1911; removed 1883 to Minnedosa, Man., where he is a practising physician; territorial rep. for Manitoba med. comn., 1886-1901; has held highest offices in I.O.O.F., Manitoba; elec. to H. of C., Canada, g.e. 1896; re-elec. g.e. 1900, 1904, 1908 and 1911; conservative whip for the West, 1901-1911; mem. of the privy coun. for Canada, and sec. of state in Mr. Borden's cabinet, Oct., 1911; min. of the Interior, 1912; chmn., civ. serv. comn., 1917.

ROCK, JOHN CHRISTOPHER WILBERFORCE.—B. 1882; ed. Harrison Coll., Barbados and Jesus Coll., Oxford; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., Nov., 1905; off. asst. to govt. agt., S. Prov., June, 1906; Sabaragamuwa, Jan., 1908; pol. mag., Panadure, Dec., 1909; pol. mag., Point Pedro and Chavakachcheri, Nov., 1911; ag. dist. judge, Tangalla, Oct., 1912; ditto, Matara, Oct., 1913; ditto, Kalutara, Aug., 1920; asst. comsrr. of excise, May, 1921.

ROCKS, M. J. W.—Formerly clk. to various distr. comsrs., S. Leone; afterwards gaoler, Gambia, 1891-8; 1st clk., traff. branch, S. Leone govt. rly., 1901.

BODD, A. J.—B. 1886; apptd., after exam., asst. library attendant, C.O., 11th Dec., 1905; library attendant, 18th Feb., 1911; supplementary clk., audit dept., Feb., 1914; on mil. serv. from 5th Aug., 1914.

RODEN, SIR ROBERT BLAIR, KT. BACH. (1918).—B. 1850; called to the bar, Gray's Inn, 1902; clk., public library, Antigua, 1880; 2nd clk. to the gov., Leeward Is., 1881; acted on several occasions as ch. clk., and as clk. to the legis. and exec. couns., and as a dist. mag., Antigua; also acted as priv. sec. to different govts., Leeward Is., in 1883, 1890, 1896 and 1898; mag., Nevis, 1890; mem. St. Kitts and Nevis legis. comns., 1891; mem., fed. leg. coun., Leeward Is., 1898-9; mag., Bridgetown, Barbados, 1903; acted on several occasions as judge, petty debt ct., Bridgetown, and judge of the ass't. ct. of appeal; visiting justice, Glenalry pris., 1904; ch. just., St. Vincent, 1912; admnstd. govt. of St. Vincent from Oct., 1912 to Feb., 1913, and for short periods in Apr., Aug., and Dec., 1913; also from Mar. to Nov., 1914; ch. just., Br. Honduras, Feb., 1915; chmn. of food control comte., Jan., 1918; ret., 1921.

RODESSE, MAURICE.—B. 1871; Priv. sec. to several puisne judges and ch. justices, S. Stltns., from 26th May, 1889; acted as dep. regiar. or as sheriff and dep. regiar. Singapore, on several occasions since 1893; confirmed as sheriff and dep. regiar., 1st Jan., 1902; ag. offl. assignee in addition to own duties, Sept. to Oct., 1907; dep. regiar. sup. ct., and sheriff in addition, Dec., 1908, and again Apr., 1914; ag. regiar., sup. ct., Jan., 1909; hon. gen. sec., agri-horticultural shows in addition, May to Aug., 1910; asst. supt. Indian immigr., May, 1912; ag. marshal, prize ct. in addition, Aug. 1914; in charge of regiar. and sheriff's office, Dec., 1917.

RODRIGO, EDMUND.—B. 1889; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., Dec., 1912; attached to Kurunegala Kachcheri, Mar., 1913; ag. pol. mag., Negombo, Nov., 1913; offl. asst. to govt. agt., W. Prov., May, 1915; mun. mag., Colombo, Oct., 1915; pol. mag., Puttalam, July, 1917; offl. asst. to govt. agt., Prov. of Sabaragamuwa, Sept., 1918; dist. judge, Batticaloa, Apr., 1920.

RODRIGUEZ, FAUSTIN ALBERT, M.B., C.M. (Edin.).—B. 1867; entd. med. ser., Trinidad, 1st May, 1904; dist. med. offr., 1st May, 1904.

RODWELL, SIR CECIL HUNTER, K.C.M.G. (1919), C.M.G. (1909).—Ed. Eton and King's Coll., Camb., B.A., 1897; serv. on staff of high comsrr. for S. Africa since Dec., 1900; Imperial sec., Mar., 1904; gov., Fiji, and high comsrr., W. Pacific, 8th Apr., 1918; assumed duty, 10th Oct., 1918.

ROGERS, ARTHUR WILLIAM, D.S.C., F.R.S.—B. 1872; ed. Clifton Coll. and Christ's Coll., Camb.; Harkness scholar, Camb.; geologist, geological comn., Cape of Good Hope, 1896; asst. dir., geological surv., Union of S. Africa, 1st Apr., 1912; dir. geological survey of Union of S. Africa, 1917.

ROGERS, CLAUDE SOMERSET.—B. 1857; obtnd. higher standard certif. at Imp. Forest schl., Dehra Dun, India, with medals for forestry and forest engnrng., 1893; apptd. to Indian forest dept. as forest ranger, 26th May, 1893; promoted to extra asst. conserv. of forests, 4th grade, 26th Mar., 1894; passed exam. in Burmese language, higher standard, 1897; promoted to 3rd grade, 3rd Sept., 1897; 2nd grade, 27th Nov., 1899; forest officer, Trinidad, 24th Mar., 1901; capt. and adjutant, Trinidad Light Horse, 1908; conservator of forests, 1st Jan., 1918.

ROGERS, RICHARD EDWARD ELMORE.—Covt. printer and comptroller of stationery, S. Australia, 1st June, 1910.

ROGERSON, WALTER JOHN LANCASHIRE, B.A., Cantab.—B. 1889; Cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., Dec., 1912; attached to Kandy Kachcheri, Jan., 1913; ag. additional office ass't, Anuradhapura Kach., Jan., 1914; ag. asst. govt. agt., Trincomalee, May, 1914; addtl. office ass't, Anuradhapura, June, 1914; ag. office asst. to govt. agt., Kandy, June, 1914; ag. asst. govt. agt., Matale, Sept., 1914; offl. asst. to govt. agt., Badulla, Sept., 1914; pol. mag., Matale, Jan., 1915; offl. asst. to govt. agt., Kandy, May, 1917; pol. mag., Avisawella, Jan., 1921; ditto, Kandy, Feb., 1921.

ROLANDO, FRANCOIS ADOLPHE.—B. 1845; regiar. and offr. of civil status, Seychelles, 6th Jan., 1890; ag. judge and stip. mag., 17th July, 1891; ag. stip. mag., 17th Nov., 1891; Crownatty, Mauritius, 10th Sept., 1897; ag. recvr. of regiar. dues and conservator of mortgages, 1st Oct., 1906.

ROLLO, HON. WALTER.—B. Edinburgh, 1875; emigrd. to Canada, 1882; bootmaker by trade; latterly editor of labour journal; pres. of I.L.P.; elec. to legis. assem., Ontario, Oct., 1919; min. of labour and health in U.F.C. govt., Nov., 1919.

ROLSTON, CECIL MICHAEL.—M.D., C.M., Univ. of Manitoba, Canada, 1895; L.R.C.P., Edin.; L.R.C.S., Edin.; L.R.F.P. and S., Glasgow, 1888; mem. Coll. of Phys. and Surgeons, 1903; F.R.I.; pub. health, London; late civil surg., attached to R.A.M.C. during S.African war, 1900-1902; Queen's medal, 2 clasps; King's medal, 2 clasps); apptd. to Leeward Is. med. serv., 1903; med. offr., dist. "D," Dominica, and ag. med. offr. of pub.
ROOKES, C. E.—Asst., traffic man., Uganda rly., 1914.

ROSS, J. G. H.—Asst. dist. commr., E.A.P., Sept., 1919.

ROSS, GEORGE ARCHIBALD PARK, M.D., Ch.M. (Edin.), D.P.H. (Edin.); diploma, trop. diseases, Liverpool.—B. 1879; S. African War, Lovat's Scouts, 1900-02; Anglo-Portuguese boundary, Zambesia, 1904-5; native rebellion, Natal, 1906; trop. diseases investig., 1906-10; govt. pathologist, Natal, 1911; asst. health offr., Union of S. Africa, stand. in Natal, 1918; major, S. African med. corps., in ch. sleeping sickness bureau, Durban, and sanitation offr., Natal, 1914-19.

ROSS, GEORGE I.S.O.—B. 1853; ent. civ. ser., Canada, 1875; apptd. asst. postmtr., Toronto, 1900; ch. P.O. supt., Canada, 1902.

ROSS, GEORGE PAUL.—B. 1881; ed. George Watson's Coll. and Edin. Univ.; M.A.; writer to the signet; capt., 5th Batt., the Royal Scots (Q.R.T.); asst. dist. commr., G. Coast, 13th Aug., 1913; ag. dist. commr., 1914, 1915, 1916 and 1917.

ROSS, S. B. C., O.B.E. (1920).—Ed. Uppingham schl. (1889-93); Owens Coll., 1893-96; B.A., 1896; (Eng. lang., lit. honours); univ. schlr., 1896-7; prize for Roman Law, Constitut. Law, 1898; cadet, F.M.S., 1899; sent to Canton to study Chinese, 1900; transfd. to Hong Kong, 1901; ag. registrar, land ct., 1902 and 1903; ag. asst. postmtr.-gen., 1903; sec. to commn. of inquiry into sup. ct. regisy., 1903; ag. asst. P.M.G., 1903; ag. P.M.G., 1903-4; ag. asst. col. sec., and clk. of couns., 1904; ag. pol. mag., New Territories, 1905; ag. P.M.G., Apr., 1907; ag. asst. land offr., New Territories, Tai Po, Aug., 1907; ag. land offr., N.T., 2nd July, 1908; ag. dist. offr., 6th Dec., 1908, to 1st Feb., 1909, and from 23rd Mar., 1909, to 3rd July, 1911; temporary service as 2nd cls. clk. in C.O., from May to Dec., 1912; apptd. dist. offr., Tai Po, 30th Nov., 1912; returned to Hong Kong, Feb., 1913; ag. P.M.G., Feb. to Aug., 1913; assumed duty as dist. offr., Tai Po, 26th Aug., 1913; ag. sec. for Chinese affairs, and mem. exec. and legis. couns., 20th Jan. to 18th Oct., 1915; postmtr.-gen., 1917; postal censor, 1917-1919; ag. sec. for Chinese affrs. and mem., exec. and leg. couns., 10th Jan., 1921; chmn., comm. on industrial employment of children, 1921.

ROSS, WILLIAM ERNEST.—B. 1870; entd. civ. ser., Trinidad, 20th Aug., 1890; ch. clk., surg.-gen.'s office, and sec. to bd. of health and quarantine authority, 1st Jan., 1912.

ROSS, WILLIAM McGUIRE.—Ed. at Southport Gram. schl. and Liverpool Univ.; M.Sc. (Hons. in engineering, Vict.), B.E., (Hons.) B.A., (R.U.I.), M.Inst.C.E.; asst. engineer, Uganda rly., 18th Apr., 1900; D.P.W., E. Africa Prot., 1st Apr., 1905; M.L.C., Oct., 1918.

ROTH, WALTER E.—B.A. (Oxon), late Demy of Magd. Coll.; M.R.C.S. (Eng.); L.R.C.P. (Lond.); hon. mem. anthrop. societies of Berlin and Florence, and of anthrop. inst., Lond.; late ch. protector of aborigines, Queensland; and Royal commr. to inquire into condition of natives of W. Aust.; stip. mag., dep. prot. of Indians, and govt. med. offr., Pomeroon River, B. Guiana, 8th Dec., 1906.

ROTINI, J. F. AMOSU.—Ed. Baptist elementary schl. and academy, Lagos; marine clk., Calabar, Oct., 1895; ast. regiar. of ct., Calabar, June, 1896; dep. regiar. of ct., Jan., 1899; trav. supervisor of native cts., S. Nigeria Prot., Sept., 1901, to Apr., 1907; ditto, E. Prov., S. Nigeria, Apr., 1907; has recd. thanks of govt. for services in connection with reorganization of native courts, S. Nigeria, 1902-3.
ROUILLARD, Jean Edmond.—Ed. Roy. Coll., Maur., and King Henry VIII.'s schl., Coventry; called to bar, Mid. Tenn., 1891; licent. laws, Paris, 1891; ag. dist. mag., Plaine Wilhelms, Maur., Oct., 1899; ag. Crown pros., Feb., 1900; Crown pros., ag. advr., pol. mag., etc., Seychelles, 4th Sept., 1900; mag., Rodrigues, July, 1902; dist. and stip. mag., Mauritius, 1913.

ROUTH, Reginald Lamy.—B. 1856; ed. St. Mary's Hall, Southsea, and Cadet school; frigate, H.M.S. "Conway"; extra master's certif., Apr., 1897; asst. marine supt., Lagos, Dec., 1902; ag. marine supt., Dec., 1903, to June, 1904; comdr., H.M.C.S.Y., "Ivy," S. Nigeria, June, 1906; sen. marine offr., E. Prov., S. Nigeria, May, 1907.

ROWATT, Hugh Howard.—B. 1861; ed. Ottawa Coll. Inst. and St. Catherine's Affiliated Coll.; ent. civ. serv., Can., 1887, as correspondent; ch. clk., mining lands br., Mar., 1907; contrlr., mining lands, 1912; supt., 1920.

ROWBOTHAM, Capt. Herbert W., LL.D.—St. Joseph's Coll., Springhill, Mobile, U.S.A., and Hon. LL.D., Rome.—B. 1868; served with Cape mounted pol., 1890; mem. (student) of inst. of actuaries, 1893; Rhodesian civ. serv., 1895; (medal for rebellion of 1896-1897); served as an officer (lieut., 1899; capt., 1902) in field and on staff, S. African war, 1899-1902 (two medals and five clasps); Transvaal civ. serv., 1903; clk. to attv.-gen., B. Honduras, 1910; accnt. and trafic asst., Stann Creek riv., B. Honduras, Sept., 1910; capt., A. Co., 8th Batt., Welsh Regt., 1914; staff capt., R.T.O., 1917; temp. pol. mag., Singapore, May, 1920.

ROWE, Major R. H., D.S.O., M.C.—B. 1883; ed. Wellington Coll. and Royal Milly Acad., Woolwich; 2nd lieut., Royal Arty., 1902; served Bermuda and Jamaica, 1902-6; served with native infantry under Sir H. Trenchard in S. Nigeria, 1907-10; Northern Hinterland exped., 1907-8; Niger Cross River exped., 1908-9; operations against Abini, 1909, and against Munchis, 1910; lent to survey of Nigeria, 1910; dep. dir., 1911; Nigeria Dalmahoy landry, comsn., 1912; Cameroons, 1914-16; ch. of admstv. staff, with major-gen. Sir C. Dobell, France, 1916-18; commanding howitzer batty. and brig. major, 11th corps, Heavy Arty., Russia (Murman coast), 1918; three times ment. in despatches; surv.-gen., G. Coast, 1920.

BUDDICK, John Archibald.—B. 1862; dairy expert; asst. to dairy comsn., Canada, 1891; prin. dairy schl., Kingston, Ont., 1896; dairy comsn., New Zealand, 1898; asst. to comsn. of agr., Can., 1900; dairy comsn., Can., 1906; dairy and cold storage comsn., Can., 1906.

RUGGLES, Nepean Clarke, K.C.—Barrister of sup. ct., Nova Scotia; Bachelor of Laws at Dalhousie Coll., Halifax, Canada, with honours, 1891; called to the bar, Nova Scotia, with highest honours, 1891; K.C., Nova Scotia, Jan., 1911; served with the Canadian forces during S. African War; now on the reserve of officers, Canadian militia; public prosecutor at Barberton Transvaal, 1901; asst. ree. mag., 1903 to 1907; mag., Dist. F., Dominica, Oct., 1909.

RUNDLE, Gen. Sir Henry Macleod Leslie R.A.—B. 1856; G.C.B. (1911); G.C.M.G. (1914); G.C.V.O. (1911); K.C.B., 1-98; K.C.M.G., 1901; D.S.O., 1897; ed. Roy. Mil. Acad., Woolwich; entd. R.A., 1876; maj.-gen., 1896; served in Zulu war, 1879; Boer war, 1881; Egyptian war, 1882; Nile expedn., 1884-5; Soudan Frontier field force, 1885-7; Soudan Frontier, 1889; Dongola expedn., 1896; adjt.-gen., Egyptian army; Khartoum expedn., 1898; comdg. S.E. Dist., 1898-9; dep. adjt.-gen. to the forces, 1899-1900; in comd. of div., Aldershot, 1900; lieut.-gen. on staff in comd. of 8th Div., S. African field force, 1900-1902; lieut.-gen. of Nthn. Comd., 1905-7; col.-comdt., R.A., 1907; gov. and comdr.-in-chief, Malta, 1909-1915.

RUSHMER, James.—B. 1876; entered C.O., Oct., 1893; apptd., after exam., library attendant, 1st July, 1896; promoted, after exam., under order-in-council of 1910, clk. of the 2nd div., 18th Feb., 1911; asst. sec. to colonial blue-books comteee, 1917-1918; seconded for serv. at overseas settlement office, Apr., 1920.

RUSHTON, Charles Berkeley.—Ck. comsnr. of rlys. dept., W. Aust., Apr., 1896; ch. clk., July, 1896; ag. sec. to comsnr. of rlys., 2nd Aug., 1901; sec. to ditto, 18th Dec., 1901.

RUSSELL, Alexander David, LL.B.—Puisc judge, Trinidad, 6th Sept., 1906; 1st puisce judge, 1913; ag. chief just. in 1910 and 1912.

RUSSELL, Major-Gen. Sir Andrew Hamilton.—K.C.B. (1918); K.C.M.G. (1915); B. 1868; held coman. as lieut. for 5 yrs. in Imperial Army; vol. offr., New Zealand, 1900; hon. A.D.C. to H.E. the Gov. of N.Z., 1911; brig.-gen., 1914; temp. major-gen., 1915; major-gen. in command of N.Z. Div., 1916; foreign decoration, Order of Danilo (Montenegro), 1917.

RUSSELL, Hon. Benjamin, K.C., M.A., D.C.L.—Ed. at Halifax gram. schl. and Mount Allison Univ.; called to the bar, 1872; for some years law adviser to legis. coun., Nova Scotia; elect. to H. of C., Canada, 1896; judge of supreme ct., Nova Scotia, 1904.

RUSSELL, Hon. E. J.—Senator for Victoria, C. of A., g.e.'s, 1906, 1913, 1914; temp. chmn. of comtese, 1913; mem. of select comtee, on g.e., 1913; asst. min., C. of A., 17th Sept., 1914; reeig., 27th Oct., 1916; asst. min., 14th Nov., 1916; ditto, Feb., 1917; vice-pres. of exec. coun., 27th Mar., 1918.

RUSSELL, John William Pemberton.—Ed. Elizabeth Coll., Guernsey; subaltern, 3rd Batt. East Surrey Regt., 1887; asst. transport offr., Uganda Prot., 21st Aug., 1899; chief of customs, 1st Apr., 1904; director, Uganda transport, 1st July, 1905; Nandi medal, 1905; reeig. badge of honour from H.H. the Duke of Anhalt, 1909.

RUSSELL, Thomas Brownlee.—B. 1873; ed. Pembroke Coll., Oxford, M.A.; cadet, Ceylon civ. ser., Oct., 1897; office asst. to govt. agt., E. Prov., Mar., 1899; agt., Balapitiya, Nov., 1899; dist. judge, Tangalla, Aug., 1900; office asst. to govt. agt., N.C. Prov., Nov., 1901; Uva Prov., Nov., 1902; dist. judge, Batticaloa, July, 1903; office asst. to govt. agent, N. Prov., Nov., 1903; pol. mag., Jaffra, Jan., 1904; ag. dist. judge, Jaffra, Mar., 1904; pol. mag., Kandy, July, 1905; dist. judge, Kalutara, Dec., 1910; ag. dist. judge, Kurunegala, June, 1915; dist. judge, Batticaloa, Aug., 1915; acted on two occasions in 1915 and 1916 as addtl. agt. gov., E. Prov. in addition to his own duties; comsnr. of requests, Colombo, Mar., 1918; dist. judge, Galle, Nov., 1920.

RUSSELL, William Alison.—B. 1875; ed. Rugby and Trin. Coll. Camb.; B.A., LL.B.; honours, 1897; barrister-at-law, Inner Temp., 1900; equity bar, 1900-6; apptd. Crown advoc., pub. proscr., admstr.-gen., prin. regis. of docmts. regis. of companies, Uganda Prot., May, 1906; Crown advoc. and pub. proscr., Jan., 1909; m.
chief sec. to govt., Aug., 1909; to Mar., 1910; Crown advoc. and pub. proscr., Mar. to May, 1910; ag. chief sec. to govt., June, 1910 to May, 1911; Crown advoc. and pub. proscr., June, 1911 to June, 1912; King's advoc., Cyprus, July, 1912; mem. of exec. and legis. couns., 1912; joint commr. under Reprint of Statutes Law, 1913; edition publ., Feb., 1914.

RUSSELL, WILLIAM EAST.—Joined Fiji police, 27th April, 1891; inspr. of imigrts., 1897; J.P., 1901; ag. comsnr., Colo N. and E., and stip. mag., Ra, 1902; ag. stip. mag., Ba, 1904; ag. stip. mag., Lautoka, 1905; ag. comsnr., Colo N. and E., July, 1905, to Jan., 1907; ast. comsnr. and stip. mag., Colo N. and E., 1908; comsnr. and stip. mag., Colo E., June, 1910; Colo N., Nov., 1910; 1st grade dist. comsnr., Apr., 1915.

RUTHERFORD, GEORGE JAMES, M.R.C.S., L.R.C.P., Lond.—Ed. at Epsom Coll. and Middlesex Hosp.; astt. col. surg., G. Coast, 1897; on spec. serv. in Lagos during the Sarki expedition, 1897-98; sen. med. offr., G. Coast, 1907; sen. med. officer, S. Nigeria, 1907; prov. med. offr., Ashanti, 1910; ast. prin. civ. med. offr. and inspr. gen. of hospitals, Ceylon, 1911; Ceylon deleg. at "All India" sanitary conf., 1911-12; ast. prin. civ. med. offr., Ceylon, Oct. to Dec., 1912, Feb. to Dec., 1913, and from June to Aug., 1915; prin. civ. med. offr. and inspr. gen. of hosps., Aug., 1915; M.L.C.

RUTHERFORD, JOHN GUNION, C.M.G. (1910), V.S., H.A.R.C.V.S.—B. 1857; apptd. special quarantine offr. in Gr. Britain, 1901; ch. vet. insp., Canada, 1902; vet. dir. gen., 1904; and live stock comsnr., 1906; mem. of economic and agric. comsnr., 1915; retired from civ. serv., 1912; mem. rly. comsnr., Canada, 1918; comsnr. to investigate race-meets and betting in connection therewith, Aug., 1919.

BUXTON, CAPT. F. H.—Gazetted Worcestershire Regt., 1895; seconded, Royal Niger Constab., 1898-1899; served in S. Africa, 1900; prov. adminstr., N. Nigeria, 1901; 1st cls. rec., 1st Oct., 1908.

RYAN, Sir CHARLES LISTER, K.C.B. (1887), C.B. (1881), J.P., Berks.—B. 1831; apptd. ast. examt., impl. audit officer, Mar., 1851; jun. clk. in H.M.'s treasury., Whitehall, Feb., 1852; was priv. sec. to Mr. Disraeli, Sir Stafford Northcote, and Mr. Gladstone; apptd. to audit office as sec., May, 1865; ast. comptroller and auditor, Mar., 1873; comptroller and audr.-gen., June, 1888; was hon. auditor of certain crown cols., ag. on behalf of H.M.'s S. of S. for the cols.; ret., 1896.

SABINE, GUSTAVUS.—Ch. govt. survr., Papua, 30th Aug., 1908.

SADLER, C.—Ast. gen. manager, govt. rly., Trinidad, 1st Dec., 1914.

SADLER, Sir JAMES HAYES, K.C.M.G. (1907), C.B. (1902).—Lieut.-Col. Indian Staff Corps; late foreign dept., govt. of India; awarded degree of honour, with gold medal and diploma of govt. of India, in Persian, Nov., 1879; Urdu, Oct., 1884, and Arabic, Dec., 1890; 1st coman., 6th July, 1870; served with 61st Foot in Canada and Ireland, and 40th Foot and 33rd Bengal Native Infantry in India; apptd. to polit. dept. in India, July, 1877; ast. agt. to gov.-gen. at Baroda, May, 1881; ast. sec., legis. dept., July to Oct., 1886; Aug. to Oct., 1888, and Apr., 1889, to Dec., 1890; polit. agt. with the ex-Amir of Afghanistan, Apr., 1891; agt., Kotal and Jhalawar, July, 1891; on spec. duty with Prince Damion of Siam, Feb., 1892; polit. agt. and consul at Muscat, Nov., 1892; ag. res. and consul-gen., Persian Gulf, June, 1893; ast. sec., govt. of India, foreign dept., Apr., 1895; polit. agt. and consul, Somaliland Prot., Aug., 1898; ret. from the Indian ser., Mar., 1899; continued to be employed as consul-gen., Somaliland, till 1901; comsnr., Uganda Prot., Dec., 1901; comsnr. and comdr.-in-chief, E. Africa Prot., 11th Dec., 1905; gov. and comdr.-in-chief, E. Africa Prot., 9th Nov., 1906; gov. and comdr.-in-chief, Windward Is., 6th May, 1909; retired, 1914.

SAINTSBURY, JOHN SEYMOUR.—Called to the bar, Lincoln's Inn, 1906; 1st cls. in Evidence, Procedure and Criminal Law, bar exams., 1904; certif. of honour from council of legal educ. at Bar Final, 1905, and a prize of 50L, from the Inn; passed civ. ser. test exam., Barbados, 1882; supernumerary, col. sec. s off., 1883; in P.O., 1884; 7th clk., P.O., June, 1886; 4th clk., audit off., Sept., 1890; offr. of cust., Dec., 1890; inland rev. offr., Oct., 1906; ag. pol. mag., dist. "E," July to Nov., 1906; ag. pol. mag., dist. "A," June to Nov., 1911, and from Apr., 1912 to June, 1913; ag. judge, Bridgetown petty debt ct., 30th June to 31st Oct., 1913; pol. mag. and judge of petty debt ct., dist. F., Sept., 1915; pol. mag., Dist. "E," 1919.

ST. JOHNSTON, Lieut.-Col. THOMAS REGINALD.—Barrister-at-law (Middle Temple); M.R.C.S., L.R.C.P., Lond., etc.; ed. Queen Elizabeth Coll., Guernsey and Cheltenham Coll.; various appts. in home civ. service; entered Fiji civ. serv., 1907; comsnr. Lau Islands, 1909; seconded for European war; D.A.D.M.S.; B.E.F., France; attached to W.O. as staff-major; col. sec., Falkland Is., Dec., 1918; ag. gov., Falkland Is., from Sept., 1919 to Apr., 1920; col. sec., Leeward Islds., Dec., 1919; assumed duty, June, 1920; admntr., Antigua, July and Sept., 1920 and 1921 (twice); author of "The Lau Islands, Fiji," "The Children of the Sun," "The Falkland Islands," "South Sea Reminiscences," &c.

ST. JULIAN, HERBERT PAUL.—B. 1866; clk., postal dept., Fiji, June, 1883; clk., G.P.O., Aug., 1886; clk. and acctnt., Aug., 1888; ag. col. postmr., Jan., 1906; col. postmr., Sept., 1906; M.L.C., Oct., 1913; J.P., Feb., 1917.

ST. LAURENT, ARTHUR, C.E.—Grad. of Polytechnic schl., Montreal, 1885; b. 1859; apptd. draftsman, Dominion pub. wks., Canada, 1888; ast. engr., Winnipeg residency, for Manitoba and N.W.T., 1890; prin. ast. engr. for Dominion pub. wks., 1897; engr. in charge of Georgian Bay ship canal surveys, 1904; ast. ch. engr., 1906; ast. dep. min. of pub. wks., 1908.

ST. QUINTIN, C.—Ck. to A.A.G., Griqualand W., 1879 border pol., 1880; ag. sub-inspr., Cape pol., 1884; sub-inspr., Bechuanaland pol., 1884; lieut., Bechuanaland border pol., 1885; inspr. of native reserves and J.P., 1887; storekeeper, 1889.

SALKELD, ROBERT EDWARD.—Late Oxfordshire Light Infantry, comdy. comdr., 3rd K.A.R.; collr., E. Africa Prot., 12th Jan., 1906.

SALMON, T. G. A.—Ast. dist. comsnr., E.A.P., Dec., 1913.

SALMOND, Hon. Sir JOHN WILLIAM, Kt. Bach. (1918), M.A., LL.B., K.C.—B. 1862; ed. at Univ. of New Zealand and Univ. of London; partly, draftsman, N. Zealand, 1907-1909; solr.-gen., 1910-20; judge, sup. ct., 1920; N.Z. rep. on Br. delegation to Disarmament Conf., Washington, 1921.

SAMPSON, Hon. VICTOR, K.C.—Served for 10 years in Cape civil serv.; passed B.A. and LL.B. exams., and obtained first Chancellor's medal,
Cape Univ.; called to the bar, 1881; holder of special retainer to De Beers, 1898, and later, director; returned to Cape parlmt., 1898; attorney-gen., 1904; ag. puisne judge, Eastern dist., 1911-12; puisne judge, Eastern Dist., 15th July, 1915.

SAMUEL RT. HON. SIR HERBERT LOUIS, P.C. (1908), G.B.E. (1920), M.A.—B. 1870; ed. University Coll., Schl. and Balliol Coll., Oxford; M.P., Cleveland Divn., N. Riding, Yorks., 1902-18; partly, under sec., home dept., 1905-9; chancellor of the Duchy of Lancaster (with a seat in the cabinet), 1909-10 and 1915-16; P.M.G., 1910-14 and 1915-16; pres. of the L.G.B., 1914-15; sec. of state for home affairs, 1916; chmn. of the select comtce. of house of commons on national expenditure, 1917-18; British sp. consmr., to Belgium, 1919; grand offr. of the Order of Leopold of Belgium, 1919; high commr., Palestine, 1920.

SAMUEL SILVERIG L.—Ed. at St. Gregory's Rom. Cath. gram. schl., Lagos; mesnr. and copyt., educ. Off., 1897; clk. to inspr. of schl., Mar., 1899; sec. to comtce. for exhibts. of schl. wks., 1902 and 1903; clk. and interpreter to trav. consmr., Ilesha interior dept., Feb., 1904; 3rd cls. clk., gov't. off., Aug., 1904.

SANDERSON, G. M.—M.R.C.S., L.R.C.P., med. offr., Nyasaland, 1910; temp. major, Nyasaland Field Force, Aug., 1914.

SANDERSON, JAMES.—Clk. to ch. just., Barbados, 1867; clk. to gen. bd. of health, Barbados, Apr., 1871, also clk. to quarantine bd. in 1880; solnr., atty., and proctor, Barbados, in 1873; was deleg. for Barbados to quarantine confe. at Demerara in 1888; govt. dir. on bd. of Barbados rly. co. in 1891; commr. of probates, 1904; J.P., 1904.

SANDERSON, STANLEY.—3rd treasy. astt., E. Africa Prot., 1st Oct., 1901; supt. of inland rev. and conservancy, 6th Feb., 1903.

SANDFORD, G. R.—Astt. dist. commr., E. Africa Prot., Feb., 1915; priv. sec. to gov., 1918.

SANDS, SIR JAMES PATRICK, Kt. Bach. (1917).—B. 1859; mem. H. of A., Bahamas, 1889-1916, and leader for the govt., 1909-1916; M.E.C. since 1901; pres. of leg. coun., 1916.

SANDS, WILLIAM H.—B. 1869 pub. schl. teacher, Bahamas, 1889; Out Island commr. (4th div.) and teacher, 1917.

SANDYS, MELVILL KEVENER TRELAWNY.—B. 1890; cadet, Ceylon civ. ser.; attached to Ratnapura Kach., 1919.

SARAVANAMUTTU, P.—B. 1894; B.A., Lond.; cadet, Ceylon civ. ser., local divn., Aug., 1919; attached to Colombo, Kach., Aug., 1919; ag. office asst. to govt. agt., Kalutara, Feb., 1920; attd. to Matale Kach., June, 1920; addnl. dist. judge, Badulla, Mar., 1921; pol. mag., Dandagamuwa, Sept., 1921.

SARWAR, HAFIZ GHULAM.—Cadet, S. S., Sept., 1897; ag. 3rd mag., Singapore, Jan. to June, 1900; and from Sept., 1900, to Nov., 1901; passed final exam., Chinese, July, 1900; 3rd mag., Sing., 29th Apr., 1902; ag. sheriff, deputy-regis., and astt. official assignee, Penang, May, 1902; dep. regis., sup. ct., Penang, Dec., 1905; astt. regis., sup. ct., Malacca, May, 1907; dep. regis., sup. ct., Penang, Apr., 1906; ag. regis., July, 1909; ag. dist. judge, May, 1915; ag. censor, Dec., 1915 to Jan., 1916; ag. offl. assignee, Penang, in addition, May, 1916; regis. and sheriff, sup. ct., Penang also astt. regis. of cos., Penang, Jan., 1917; offr., cl. II., Jan., 1919.

SAUNDERS, CHARLES JAMES, B.A.—B. 1868; ed. Merchant Taylors and St. John's Coll., Oxon; cadet, S. S., 1891; passed final exam. in Chin., Feb., 1895; ag. 2nd astt. prot. of Chin., Feb., 1895; ag. 3rd mag., Sing., May, 1895; ag. 3rd mag., Penang, Dec., 1896; ag. dist. offr., Penang, Mar., 1897; dist. offr., Malacca, May, 1897; ag. astt. prot. of Chin., Sing., Aug., 1897; ag. astt. prot. of Chin. and astt. of Ind. immgr., Penang, and munic. consmr., for Penang, 1898; ag. astt. prot. of Chin., Sing., Aug., 1898, to Feb., 1899; also ag. 3rd mag., Sing., Sept., 1898; 2nd astt. prot. of Chin., Penang, Aug., 1898; ag. 2nd mag., Sing., May, 1900; ag. offl. assignee, S. S., Sept., to Dec., 1900, Jan., 1901, to Feb., 1905, and Feb., 1906; sheriff, dep. regis., supreme court, and astt. official assignee, Penang, May, 1902; munic. consmr. for Sing., Oct., 1900, and Sept., 1903; also ag. prot. of Chin., Sing., Apr., 1904; also astt. supt. of Indian immgrs.; astt. prot. of Chin., Penang, May, 1904; ag. sec. for Chin. affirs., S.S. and F. M.S., Apr., 1907; ag. consmr., ct. of requests, Singapore, Jan., 1908; ag. dist. judge, Apr., 1908; sec. for Chinese affirs., S.S. and F.M.S., Feb., 1910; ag. offl. assignee, Mar., 1914; regis. of cos. and offl. assignee, Jan., 1915; pres. rent assessment bd., Sept., 1917.

SAUNDERS, SIR CHARLES JAMES RENAULT, K.C.M.G., 1906. C.M.G., 1895.—B. 1857; held various appts. in Natal civ. serv., 1876-87, when he ratified treaty with Queen of Amatongaland (desps.); res. mag., Eshowe, and J.P. for Zululand, 1888; defined bndry. between Amatonga-land and Zululand, 1889 (desps.); variously employed under Zululand Govt., 1883-95 (desps.), when he was apptd. spec. commr. for Trans-Pongoland territory, carried out final act of annexation of that territory and declared British prot. for Amatongaland; acted as res. commr. and chief mag. of Zululand, 1896; apptd. chief mag. and civ. commr. for prov. of Zululand on its incorporation with Natal, 1897; medal, S. African War, 1899-1902; col. representative on Zululand Lands Delimitation Comm., 1902, and commr. for native affirs., 1905; ret., 1909.

SAUNDERS, JOHN C.—B. 1862; ed. pub. schls. and High Schl., Halifax, N.S.; ent. pub. serv., 23rd Mar., 1882; transferred to finance dept., Ottawa, 1st July, 1887; astt. dep. min. of finance, 1st Jan., 1917; dep. min. of finance, 1st Apr., 1920.

SAUNDERS, REGINALD G.—Ed. at Tonbridge and Cheltenham Coll.; ag. 3rd astt. P.M.G., Ceylon, 13th Jan., 1898; ag. astt. collr. of cust., Trincomalee, Sept., 1898; office astt. to govt. agt., N. Prov., and astt. collr. of cust., 1st June, 1901; pol. mag., Matara, 22nd Apr., 1903; extra astt. to govt. agt., N. Prov., 1st Mar., 1904; ag. astt. govt. agt., Manaar, 2nd May, 1904; commr. of requests and pol. mag., Chilaw, 12th Feb., 1906; ag. astt. govt. agt. and dist. judge, 11th Apr., 1906; ag. dist. judge, Chilau and Puttalam, Jan., 1909; ag. pol. mag., Hatton-Nuwara Eliya, Feb., 1909, and dist. judge, May, 1909; offic. astt., Colombo Kachcheri, Nov., 1911; lieut., Ceylon Light Infantry (reserve); on military duty as astt. censor, Dec., 1914; censor, May, 1919; attached to Colombo Kachcheri, Sept., 1919; ag. astt. govt. agt., Chilau and Puttalam, May, 1920; ag. dist. judge, Badulla, Sept., 1920.

SAUVAGE, DANIEL.—Govt. pilot and astt. port offr., Seychelles, 1894, and port offr., May, 1897.

SAVAGE, GEORGE.—B. 1887; supt. of registration, G.P.O., Singapore, Oct., 1914; supt. of mails, ditto, 1st Jan., 1915; ag. supt. of mails, Penang, Jan., 1915; ag. senr. supt. of mails,
Feb., 1917; supt. of mails, Penang, but continued ag. senr. supt. of mails, July, 1917; supt., grade II., Jan., 1919; ag. supt., money order branch and savings dept., May, 1919 and Nov., 1920; supt., grade I., but cont. to act as above, Jan., 1920; supt., posts and telegraphs, Malacca, Sept., 1920.

SAVI, VICTOR GEORGE.—Pol. probationer, S. Stiltns., Nov., 1904; asst. supt.of pol., Jan., 1908; passed final exam. in Punjaubli, Feb., 1910; ag. 2nd supt. of pol., Aug., 1910 and Feb., 1914; ag. supt. of pol., Dec. to Feb., 1914; ag. supt. of pol., Malacca, Sept., 1916; asst. supt. of pol., Penang, Oct., 1917; ag. dir., crim. intelligence, Jan., 1919; dir., crim. intelligence, Jan., 1920; ag. supt., pol. and ch. pol. offr., Singapore, May, 1921.

SAWREY-COOKSON, SYDNEY SPENCER, B.A.—B. 1876; ed. Uppingham and New Coll., Oxford; barrister-at-law, Inner Temple, 1903; judicial commr., Brit. N. Borneo, 1910-20; judge, sup. ct., Gambia, 1920.

SAXTON, SIDNEY WABING.—Ed. Toulouse (France), and Dean Close Schl., Cheltenham; paymr. cadet, R.N., 14th July, 1905; paymr.-lieut.-comdr., 19th Mar., 1918; 1st cls. French interpreter; lent to C.O. and apprd. asst. dist. commr., G. Coast, 17th Sept., 1914, but did not take up apptmt., having resumed duty in H.M. Navy for the period of the war; assumed duties as junr. asst. col. sec., G. Coast, 16th Apr., 1919; ag. asst. col. sec., 16th May, 1919; ag. dist. commr., Accra, and ag. trav. commr. for Accra-Akwapim and Birrim distr., 30th Oct., 1919; passed Tropical African Service course (all subjects, 2nd part.)

SAYER, GEOFFREY ROHLTY, B.A.—B. 1887; ed. at Highgate schl. (foundation) and Queen's Coll., Oxford; open exhibitioner in classics and Fitzgerald exhibitioner; 2nd cls. class. mode.; 3rd cls. Lit. Hum. (B.A., 1910); cadet, Hong Kong, 24th Oct., 1910; passed in Cantonese, Nov., 1912; ag. asst. dist. offr. (South), Nov., 1912 to Feb., 1913, and from Mar. to Nov., 1913; ag. asst. supt. of police, 22nd Nov., 1913 to Oct., 1914; ag. dep. offr., recvr., Oct., 1914 to Mar., 1915; ag. chief asst. sec. for Chinese affairs during Nov., 1914 and Aug., 1915, in addition to other duties; priv. sec. to gov., in addition to other duties, Jan. to Nov., 1915; attached to crown solr.'s offr., Apr. to Sept., 1915; passed final exam. in Hakka, July, 1915; ag. chief asst. sec. for Chinese affairs, Sept., 1915; on milly. serv., 1915-19; dep. regiar. and appraiser, Hong Kong, Jan.-Mar., 1920; ch. of seny. dep. Mar., 1920; passed in Mandarin, May, 1921.

SAYERS, FREDERICK RICHARDSON.—M.D., D.P.H., Dublin Univ.; ed. Rathmines Schl., Dublin, The Meath Hosp., Dublin, and Trin. Coll., Dublin; res. med. offr., Monkstown Hosp., Dublin, 1909-12; med. offr., S. Settmts., 23rd Mar., 1912; med. offr., gen. hosp., Penang, 27th Apr., 1912; med. offr., dist. hosp., Penang, 2nd June, 1912; port health offr. and health offr., rural areas, Penang, cor., Penang, and med. offr. in charge of leper asylum, Pulau Jerejak, Penang, 3rd Sept., 1912; ag. asst. port health offr., Singapore, 10th Sept., 1912; resumed duties in Penang, 21st Oct., 1912; asst. censor, Penang, in addition, Sept., 1915, to Apr., 1916; ag. sen. health offr., S. Settmts., in addition, 1st Mar., 1917; ag. asst. health offr., rural areas, Singapore, 20th Mar., 1919; ag. chief health offr., S. Stiltns., in addition, 4th Apr., 1919; lecturer in hygiene, King Edward VII. medical schl., Singapore, 10th June, 1919; ag. ch. health offr., Singapore, Oct., 1920; ag. senr. health offr., Penang, Jun., 1921.

SAYFES, G. F.—Asst. dist. commr., E. Africa Prot., Feb., 1915; asst. sec., Tanganyika territory, 21st July, 1920.

SCADDAN, HON. JOHN, M.L.A.—B. 1876; leader of Parly. Lab. party in W. Aust. since Aug., 1910; elected for Ivanhoe, June, 1904; premier of W. Australia, 1911-1916; now col. sec.

SCAMMELL, ERNEST HENRY.—B. 1873; ed. privately; sec. various business concerns, 1891-1907; visited Australia, engaged in business and journalism in Canada, 1907-1913; organizing sec., Canadian Peace Centenary Association, under the auspices of the govt. of Canada, 1913; asst. cable censor, dept. of militia and defence, Canada, 1915; sec., mil. hosps. comm., Canada, 1915; asst. dep. min. and sec., dept. of soldiers' civil re-establish., Canada, 1918; negotiated reciprocal agreements between Canadian, British and United States Govts., regarding treatment and training of Naval and Military Forces resident in these countries, 1919; Fellow of the Chartered Institute of Secretaries (London); Fellow of the Royal Colonial Institute (London); mem. of the Exec. of the Canadian Peace Centenary Assoc.

SCHALCH, E. N.—Wharf asst., Kilindini, E. Africa Prot., 1914.

SCHMIDT, CARL FRIEDRICH, B.A.—Civ. serv. law clk., law dept., Cape, May, 1893; control and audit office, July, 1893; asst. examnr. of acts, Jan., 1894; examnr., May, 1898; ch. examnr., July, 1907; inspr. of acts, Jan., 1909; prin. clk., Apr., 1912; sec. educn. dept., Bloemfontein, 16th Aug., 1915; ag. dir. of educn., O.F.S., July, 1918; dir. of educn., O.F.S., June, 1920.

SCHOCH, HERMAN EUGENE.—Surv'r.'s asst., Cape, 1878-1883; surv'r., Cape and Transvaal, 1889-1902; examnr.of diagrams, surv'r.-gen.'s dept., Transvaal, 1st Apr., 1902; registry surv'r., 1st Dec., 1902; asst. surv'r.-gen., 1st May, 1906; ag. surv'r.-gen., 1st Apr., 1912; surv'r.-gen., Transvaal, 1st Apr., 1913.

SCHOFIELD, WALTER.—B. 1888; ed. Univ. of Liverpool, M.A.; non-coll. student, Oxford, 1908-1911, M.A.; cadet, Hong Kong, 17th Nov., 1911; attached to secretariat for Chinese affairs, 19th Mar., 1914; asst. cable censor, in addition to other duties, Aug., 1914 to Apr., 1915; passed cadet, 12th Feb., 1915; ag. 3rd asst. to sec. for Chinese affairs, Feb. to Apr., 1915; ag. 2nd ditto, Apr., 1915; passed law exam., Apr., 1916; seconded to H. Kong and Shanghai Pank, 8th July, 1918; ag. 2nd asst. to sec. for Chinese affairs, 2nd Dec., 1918 to 28th Mar., 1919, and from 10th June to 29th Sept., 1919; ag. dep. regiar. and appraiser, 3rd Feb. to 28th Mar., 1919; ag. chief asst. to ditto, 29th Mar. to 9th June, 1919; ag. 2nd asst. to sec. for Chinese affairs, June to Sept., 1919; ag. ch. asst., Aug., 1920 to Nov., 1921.

SCHOLEFIELD, WILFRED JOCKLYN STUART.—Bechuanaland Border pol., Jan., 1891; line mag., Bechuanaland rly. construction, 1st Feb., 1896; res. mag., Ngamiland, 22nd Jan., 1897; native commr., N.W. Transvaal, 22nd June, 1902; served in Matabele campaign, 1893; Matabele rebellion, 1896; S. Africa, siege of Mafeking, etc.; A.D.C. to Lieut.-Gen. Lord Methuen, etc.; comdt. North Prot., and lines of communication, 1st Mar., 1902; mentioned in despatches; asst. collr., E. Africa Prot., 23rd June, 1906; dist. commr., 1910.

SCHOMBURGK, OTTO HEINRICH.—Clk., engrnr.-in-chief's office, S. Aust., Jan., 1874; clk., ch. sec.'s office, Aug., 1877; clk., regiar.-gen. of descls office, July, 1880; clk., sheriff's office, Nov.,
1882; dep. sheriff, 1891; also returning offr. W. Adelaide, Jan., 1893, to June, 1902; sheriff, July, 1903; major, comdg. field batt. of artillery (ret.).

SCHRADER, LOUIS WILLIAM CONRAD.—B. 1873; ed. Highgate School and Lincoln Coll., Oxford (M.A.); cadet, Ceylon civ. ser., Oct., 1896; off. asst. to govt. agt., Prov. of Uva, April, 1897; pol. mag., Galagedara, July, 1899; off. asst. to govt. agt., S. Prov., Nov., 1899; N. C. Prov., Mar., 1901; asst. govt. agt., Mullaitivu, Nov., 1901; dist. judge, Ratnapura, Jan., 1903; asst. coll. of cust., Trincomalee, Dec., 1904; dist. judge, Tangalla, Feb., 1905; asst. govt. agt., Hambantota, April, 1907; dist. judge, Badulla, Oct., 1909; ag. dist. judge, Galle, Aug., 1912; dist. judge, Matara, May, 1913; comsnr. of requests, Colombo, Oct., 1913; ag. dist. judge, Galle, Feb., 1914; dist. judge, Kalutara, June, 1914; ditto, Negombo, Oct., 1915; ditto, Galle, Dec., 1915; ag. govt. agt., E. Prov., Sept., 1918; ditto, Prov. of Uva, June to Sept., 1919; govt. agt., N. Prov., Nov., 1921.

SCIORTINO, J. C.—B. 1873; ed. at Lyceum Univ., Malta; in service of telegraph companies, 1891-1905; rev. offr., N. Nigeria, 26th Sept., 1903; title altered to asst. res., 1904; 3rd cls. res., 29th Apr., 1907; 2nd cls. res., 15th June, 1910.

SCONCE, HERBERT W.—Ed. at Hurst Coll., Sussex; Gram. Schl., Bristol; Trin. Coll., Camb.; B.A. math. tripus, 1886; M.A. 1897; called to the bar, Inner Temple, July, 1908; asst. master, Faversham Gram. Schl.; Godolphin Schl., Hammersmith, and Grocers' Co.'s Schl., Hackney, 1887 to 1893; asst. mr., Queen's Coll., Br. Guiana, Apr., 1893; asst. inspr. of schl., July, 1895; ag. inspr., May to Nov., 1898; June to Nov., 1900; July, 1902 to Apr., 1903; inspr. of schl. and offl. visitor of Onderneeming Indust. Schl., Apr., 1903; dir. of primary educn., Sept., 1914; mem. bd. of agric. for educnt. matters; examr. for prelim. exam. for govt. clerical serv.

SCOTLAND, DOUGLAS WILLIAM, F.S.I., N.D.A., N.D.D., H.A.A.C. Dip.—Ed. at Mussoorie Schl., India and Alleynes Schl., Stone, Staffs.; Agric. Coll., Newport, Salop, 1904-1907; Salop County Scholar, 1906-1907; Profsl. Assoc. of Survs. Inst., 1909; agric. instr., Tyrone (Board of Agric. Ireland), 1907-08; lectr. at Harpers-Adams agric. coll., 1908-11; asst., agric. dept., Sierra Leone, 1911-1915; ag. dir. of agric. on several occasions; dir. of agric., Sierra Leone, 3rd Dec., 1915.

SCOTT, HON. DAVID LYNCH, K.C.—B. 1846; ed., Gram. Schl., Brampton, Ont.; called to the bar, Ontario, 1870; K.C., 1885; judge of sup. ct., N.W.T., 1894, of sup. ct. of Alberta, 1907; ch. just., appellate divn., sup. ct., with style of ch. just. of Alberta, 15th Sept., 1921.

SCOTT, DUNCAN CAMPBELL, F.R.S.C.—B. 1862; apptd. to Indian comsnr.'s off., Canada, 1879; jun. 2nd cl. clk., dept. of Indian affairs, 1880; promoted to sen. 2nd cl., 1883; 1st cl., 1889; ch. clkship., 1893; ch. acctnt. and supt. of Indian educn., 1908; deputy supt.-gen. of Indian affairs, 1913; hon. sec., Royal Soc. of Canada.

SCOTT, HENRY HAROLD, M.D., London Univ.; M.R.C.F., London; F.R.S., Edin.; D.P.H.; M.R.C.S., Eng.; L.R.C.P., London; Fell. of Royal Soc. of medicine; Fell. of Royal Inst. of preventive medicine; Fell. of Soc. of tropical medics. and hygiene.—Ed. at St. Bart's and St. Thomas's Hosp., Univ. Colls. London and Copenhagen; prosecutor, 1894; ass't demonstrator in Materia Medica, 1885; ass't house physician, 1897; house physician, 1898, all at St. Thomas's hosp.; res. med. offr., Teignmouth hosp., 1898; serv. in S. Africa (Queen's medal with 5 clasps); med. o bacteriological and X-Ray depts., Maritzburg, 1903; M.O. in charge hosp. for women and children, 1904; offr., Kingsbury and Neasden isol. hospital, 1910; bacteriologist to Willenclen hospital, 1910; govt. bacteriologist and chemist, Jamaica, 1910; is also pa. Kingston gen. hosp.; mem. of med. board of examiners, quarantine board, and board of health, Jamaica; during 1915-1916 for war service; bacteriologist at Laboratory, Aldershot, 1915; in charge mobile laboratory, 1916; pathologist specialist, Cambridge hosp., Aldershot.

SCOTT, HERBERT SEPTIMUS.—B. at Eton and Hertford Coll., Oxford; inspr. of schools, Transvaal, 1902; sec. to educnt. dept., Transvaal, 1911.

SCOTT, JOHN.—B. 1878; ed. Bat King's Coll., Cambridge (B.A.); ca civ. ser., Nov., 1901; priv. sec. to H admng. the govt., Nov., 1903; offr. as agt., N. Prov., Jan., 1904; asst. Mullaitivu, Jan., 1905; Mannar, pol. mag., Hatton-Nuwara Eliya, asst. govt. agt., Mannar, Feb., 1 Hambantota, May, 1911; dist. judge Nov., 1911; dist. judge, Chilaw and Mar., 1913; asst. govt. agt., Chilaw an Sept., 1913; addtl. asst. col. sec., attached to censor's off., Apr., 1919; Sept., 1915; prin. asst. col. sec., Apr.

SCOTT, J. H.—Mag., Tembuland, capt. in Tembuli levies, Sept., 1877; ag. Tembuland, Apr. to July, 1878; ch. affairs dept., Oct., 1878; sec. to att. special duty to N. Border during war to Apr., 1879; ag. special comsnr., N. I to July, 1879; special comsnr. and sec. of N. Border, July, 1879; res. comsland, July, 1888.

SCOTT, RALPH.—B. 1874; B.A. I cadet, S.S., Nov., 1895; ag. collr. o Singapore, Mar., 1897; passed fina Malay, Sept., 1897; ag. dist. offr., Mal 1897; confirmed, Aug., 1898; appnt IV., Jan., 1903; ag. dist. offr., Din 1903; attached to land off., Sing., on July, 1905; ag. collr. of land rev., Jan., 1906; ag. 2nd mag., Singapore, ag. comsnr. of ct. of requests, Singa 1906, to Feb., 1907; dist. offr., Din 1906; collr. of land rev., Penang, Feb comsnt., ct. of requests, Singapore, Dec 2nd mag., Penang, Jan., 1908; ag. co rev., Malacca, Oct., 1908; in charge Feb. to May, 1909, and from Feb. to assumed duties as collr. of land rev., Pe 1910; ag. senr. dist. offr., Prov. Well 1911; promoted to ols. ii., Dec., 1911; judge and 1st mag., Penang, Apr., temp. 2nd mag., Penang, Dec., 1911 Penang, Jan., 1916; ag. dist. judge an Jan., 1916; ag. dist. judge (civil), Ma res. and pres., munici. comsnt., Mal 1920; dist. judge and 1st mag., Penang.

SCOTT, THOMAS.—Clt., aud. office, 18th Feb., 1901; inspr., 1st Jan., 1904; revenue div., treasy., 1st Oct., 1904; lec., Mar., 1905; prim. clk., audit office 1908; chief impr., of expenditure au and audit office, Union of S. Africa 1912.
SCOTT, WALTER.—B. 1862; apptd., after compet. exam., clk. of the lower (now 2nd) div. of the civ. sec., and assigned to the C.O., 23rd Jan., 1883; promoted to higher grade, 2nd div., 3rd Nov., 1896; staff clk., first grade, 1911; clk. for legal instruments, 9th Apr., 1915; librarian, 1st Sept., 1921.

SCOTT, WALTER DARK.—B. 1870; ch. clk., Ulus Selangor, F.M.S., 1891; ast. dist. offr., Kuala Lumpur, 1893; ast. dist. offr., Krian, 1903; dist. offr., Raub, 1905; British agt., Trengganu, 1910; supt., convict establishment, Taiping, and inspr. of pris., F.M.S., 9th Mar., 1914; mag., Ipoh, 7th Sept., 1914; offr., cls. II., July, 1918; ag. 2nd mag., Singapore, March, 1919; mag., Kuala Lumpur, Feb., 1920; ag. Brit. res., Pahang, June 1920 to Apr., 1921; offr., cls. I., comnr. of lands and mines, Johore, June, 1920.

SCOTT, WM. ALEXANDER.—B. 1871; clk. to atty.-gen., Fiji, 15th Oct., 1888; ag. stip. mag., Navua and Nadroga, tax inspr., Oct., 1897; stip. mag. and ast. comnr., Colo West, 1898; ch. clk., native dept., and stip. mag., Kadavu, 1899; prov. inspr., Kadavu and Lomaviti, 1901; ag. stip. mag., Rewa, and comnr., Naitasiri, 1902; ag. stip. mag., Navua, and comnr., Namosu, 1903; ast. native comnr., 1904; despatched to Christchurch exhibition in charge of body of Fijian natives, 1906-7; ag. chief pol. mag. and offl. recvr. in bankruptcy, 1907; dep. native comnr., 1908; 1st grade stip. mag., Lautoka, and gov't. comnr., Ba, Oct., 1912.

SCOTT, WILLIAM DUNCA.—B. 1861; comnr. for Canada to the Paris Exhibn., 1900; supt. of immigr., 1903-1919; ast. dep. min. of immigr. and colonization, 1919.

SCOTT, WM. ERNEST.—Ed. at Bradford and Gigglewick gram. schls., England; dep. min. of agric. and supt. of farmers' institutions, B. Columbia, 1909.

SCRIVENOR, JOHN BROOKE.—B. 1876; ed. King's Schl., Canterbury, and Hertford Coll., Oxford; served on geol. surv. of the U.K. in 1902-03; geologist, F.M.S., 14th Aug., 1903; served in the Army in England and France from 8th Dec., 1916 to end of war as 2nd lieut., R.E. signal service.

SEAGOE, ERNEST GOLDFINCH.—B. 1886; clk. to res. dep. comnr., New Hebrides, 1902-1906; impr. of native labourers, British residency, New Hebrides, 1909; ag. ast. to res. comnr., 1912, and 1915-16; joint ag. native advocate, 1916.

SEALY, FRANK DEAN.—Superm. clk., immigr. dept., Br. Guiana, Jan., 1884; 4th class clk., Apr., 1891; 3rd class, Jan., 1894; 2nd class, Apr., 1895; immigr. agt., Oct., 1898.

SEALY, GORDON COURTLAND MILLER.—B. 1863; clk. to the atty.-gen., Tobago, Jan., 1882; clk. in col. sec. s. dept., 1883; acted as confid. clk. to the admstr. and clk. of couns., 1883 to 1886; 3rd clk., surg.-gen.'s dept., Br. Guiana, 1887; 2nd clk., 1897; has acted as ch. clk.; 4th class clk., treasy. dept., 1st June, 1901; 3rd class clk., ditto, 14th May, 1906.

SEALY, JAMES ERNEST CAMERON.—B. 1871; 2nd clk., audit and registry dept., Tobago, Feb., 1888; clk. to comnrns. and financial bd., Nov., 1890, and Oct., 1893; sec. to bd. of educn., Sept., 1892; ch. clk. treasy., June, 1893; postmr. of Tobago, Dec., 1895; clk. to sub-recvr., Tobago, Jan., 1899; clk. to warden, Tobago, Sept., 1899; ch. clk. and cashier, treasy., Tobago, Feb., 1904.

SEARCY, ARTHUR.—Boarding offr., cust., S. Aust., 1873; clk. cust., 1874; clk., audit offr., 1875; clk., cust., 1876; tide inspr. and measurer of ships, cust., 1889; correpdg. clk., cust., and sec., marine bd., 1890; ag. dep. comnr. of taxes and stamps, 1891; correpdg. clk., cust., and sec., marine bd., 1891; sec., cust., and sec., marine bd., 1894; clk. ast. and sergeant-at-arms, H. of A., 1894; dep. comnr. of taxes and stamps, Jan., 1896, to Mar., 1897; comnr., ditto, Mar. to Oct., 1897; dep. comnr., ditto, Oct., 1897, to Feb., 1911; also pres., marine bd., 1902; also inspr. of kerosene, 1902; comnr. of trade marks and regir. of copyrights, 1904-7; also controller, outer harbour, Port Adelaide, Nov., 1907; also controller, ocean steamers wharf, Apr., 1909; also chief inspr. under Inflammable Oils Act, June, 1909; also supt. of life-saving service, Aug., 1909; also controller of harbours, July, 1911; chmn. of harbs. bd. comnr., since 1914.

SEARLE, HON. MALCOLM WILLIAM, K.C.—Puiane judge of sup. ct. of S. Africa (Cape Prov. Div.), June, 1910.

SEATON, G. L.—B. 1860; apptd., after exam., 3rd cl. mess., C.O., 17th May, 1899; 2nd cl., 18th Feb., 1900; King's mess., 10th June, 1904.

SELWICK, N. A.—B. 1890; ed. at Univ. Coll. Schl., London, and St. Peter's Coll., Camb.; B.A., London and Camb.; cadet, S. Stltms. civ. serv., Dec., 1913; dep. to supt., govt. monopolies dept., Jan., 1914; in charge of govt. opium factory, May to Aug., 1914; ag. 3rd mag., Singapore, Jan., 1915; ag. ast. supt., govt. monopolies dept., 1916; passed cadet (Malay), Mar., 1917; attached to col. sec.'s office, Apl., 1917; ag. dist. offr., Jasim, Malacca, Sept., 1917; collr. of war tax, Singapore, July, 1918; supernum. offr., cls. IV., Nov., 1920; ag. ast. treas. and comnr. of stamps, Penang, Dec., 1920.

SEEL, GEORGE FREDERICK.—B. 1895; ed. Maeclesfield Grammar Schl. and Corpus Christi Coll., Oxford (schol.); on mily. serv. with Cheshire Regt. from 20th Nov., 1914 to 23rd Jan., 1919; served in Gallipoli, Egypt and Palestine; higher div. clk. under reconstruction scheme, and apptd. to air miny., 28th July, 1919; res. clk., air miny., 31st Oct., 1921; seconded for serv. in C.O., as ast. prim., 9th Jan., 1922.

SEELY, MAJOR-GEN. RT. HON. JOHN EDWARD BERNARD, P.C. (1909), C.B. (1916), C.M.G. (1918), D.S.O. (1900).—Ed. at Harrow and Trinity Coll., Cambridge; called to the bar, Inner Temple, 1897; lieut. col. comndg. Hampshire Carabiniers; served with Imperial Yeomanry in S. Africa, 1900-1901 (deeps., Queen's medal, five clasps, D.S.O.); M.P. for Isle of Wight, 1900-06; M.P. for Abercromby div., Liverpool, 1906-1910; M.P., Ilkstone div., Derbyshire, 1910; recd. gold medal (French govt.) for saving life at sea, 1891; partly, under sec. of state for the colonies, 1908; chmn. of comtee. to inquire into organisation of crownagents office, 1908; under-sec. of state for war, 1911; sec. of state for war, 1912-14; joint partly sec. to ministry of munitions, 1918; under-sec. of state for air, Jan., 1919.

SEHEULT, JOSEPH EMANUEL.—B. 1861; entd. civ. serv., Trinidad, 12th Mar., 1902; ch. clk., dept. of agric., 1st Jan., 1916; ast. censor, 1914; censor, 18th Apr., 1918.

SEHEULT, LEO GABRIEL, M.I.C.E., A.C.G.I.—B. 1886; ast. dist. offr., pub. works, Trinidad, 1st Mar., 1911; 2nd grade dist. offr., 1st Sept., 1916; 1st grade dist. offr., 1st June, 1917.

SEHEULT, RAUL M.B., C.M. (Edin.).—B. 1867; entd. med. serv., Trinidad, 15th Feb., 1893; res. surg., colonial hosp., Port of Spain, 15th Oct., 1910.

SEIGNORET, CLARENCE AUGUSTUS.—B. 1867; supernumerary treas., Dominica, 1890; sec. to special yawa comnr., Mar., 1891, to Sept., 1892; ch. clk., regist. & office and clk. pub. market, 1892;
ass't sec. to Sir R. Hamilton during his inquiry in Dominica, 1893; govt. offr., treas., 1895; sec., bd. of health and quarantine, 1895; ag. clk., admstr.'s office and exec. coun., 1895; ag. treas., Dominica, July, 1901; harbmr., 1906; survr. of shipping, 1907; ag. treas., Sept., 1910, to Sept., 1911, and from Apr. to June, 1918.

SIGNORET, G. B.—Ck. to postmr., Dominica, 1889; govt. offr., treas., 1893; ch. clk., registr.'s off., 1895; ag. postmr., 1896-7; clk. govt. offr., Roseau, 1897; govt. offr., treas., 1901.

SELBORNE, 2nd EARL OF (creat. 1882), VISCOUNT WOLMER, BARON SELBORNE (U.K.), K.G. (1900), P.C. (1900), G.C.M.G. (1903), THE RT. HON. WM. WALDEGRAVE PALMER.—B. 1859; ed. at Winchester and at Univ. Coll., Oxford; B.A. (1st cls. hist.), 1882; asst. priv. sec. to Mr. Childers, Chanc. of Excheq., 1882-85; was mem. of parlmt. for E. Hants, 1885-92, and for W. Edinburgh City, 1892-95; succeeded his father, 1895; Under S. of S. for Cola., June, 1895; chmn. Pacific cable comtce., 1896; mem. of Pacific cable comtce., 1899; first lord of the admiralty, Nov. 12th, 1900; high comnstr. for S. Africa, and gov. and comdr.-in-chief of Transvaal and O.R.C., 1905 to 1910; ceased to be gov. of O.R.C. on grant of resp. govt., June, 1907; pres. of bd. of agric. and fisheries, 1915-16.

SELDON, A. A.—Asts. dist. comnstr., E.A.P., Dec., 1913.

SELLS, H.C., B.A. (Oxon.)—Cadet, S. Sttlmts., Oct., 1897; ag. priv. sec. to gov., Nov., 1898 to Nov., 1899; ag. 4th mag., Singapore, Jan., 1900; passed fin. exam. in Malay, Apr., 1900; ag. dist. offr., prov. Well., May, 1901; supt., money order branch and govt. savings bank, Sing., May, 1902; head of Malay coll., Malacca, July, 1904; ag. dist. offr., Nibong Tebal, Apr., 1905; ag. ast. postmr.-gen., Penang, Nov., 1906; confirmed, May, 1907; ag. postmr.-gen., Apr. to Dec., 1909; offr. of Cls. III., F.M.S., 1st Jan., 1912; ag. collr. of land rev. and regist. of deeds and regist. of Muhammadan marriages, Penang, 27th Mar., 1912; ast. censor in addtn. to other duties, 1st Jan., 1915; chmn., snty. bd., Kinta, 7th Aug., 1919.

SEMPEL, D. H.—Ck. to atty.-gen., Leeward Islands, 1893; dep. coroner for dist. B., Oct., 1898; ag. Federal treas., Oct., 1902; fed. treas., Mar., 1903; acted as ck., leg. coun., Antigua, Dec., 1902; ditto, ex. coun., Montserrat, Mar., 1903; ag. ch. regist., Leeward Is., and regist. and prov. marshal, admstr. of estates, offl. recvr. in bank, regist. of titles, regis. of friendly societies, and regist. gen. of births, deaths and marriages, Antigua, Feb. to July, 1905; apptd. regist. and prov. marshal, admstr. of estates, offl. recvr. in bank, and regist. of titles, St. Kitts-Nevis, July, 1905; J.P., St. Kitts-Nevis, 1905; ag. mag., dist. C., Feb., 1911; M.L.C., St. Kitts-Nevis, May, 1911; escheator-gen., 1911; offr. in charge of prison discipline, St. Kitts-Nevis, 1911; addtl. mag., Dist. C., St. Kitts-Nevis, 1916.

SENARATNE, CORNELIUS.—B. 1870; cls. V., Ceylon civ. serv., Jan., 1921; extra office ast. to govt. agk., S. Prov., Feb., 1921.

SENEMIRATNE, DIONYSIUS BARTHOLOMEW, M.M.—B. 1893; cadet, Ceylon, Oct., 1920; attd. to B. calos Kacheheri, Oct., 1920.

SENIOR, BERNARD, C.M.G. (1916), I.S.O. (1906).—B. 1866; clk. to the bindry. comn. (Redistribution of Seats Act), 1884; attached to Scotch educn. dept., 1885, and again 1888; priv. sec. to Sir F. R. Sandford, under-sec. for Scotland, 1887; 1st class clk., col. sec.'s office, G. Coast, 1888; local auditor, Lagos, Aug., 1889; ditto, G. Coast, Dec., 1889; ditto, Br. Bechuanaland, Feb., 1894; ditto, Cyprus, 1895; aud.-gen., O.R.C., Sept., 1902; recvd. thanks of S. of S. for war for services rendered in connection with audit of Boer refugee camp accnts. after the S. African war; mem. of comnstr. to inquire into law relating to mining for diamonds and precious stones in O.R.C., 1903, for which recvd. thanks of govt.; ag. col. treas., 12th Aug., 1903, to 15th Feb., 1904; M.I.C., May, 1904; deleg. for O.R.C. at S. African freights confce., 1904-5; mem. of O.R.C. civ. ser. coman., 1905; chmn. of govt. tender bd.; dir. of National Bank of O.R.C.; col. auditor, Ceylon, 1st Mar., 1907; ag. treas. from 16th Nov., 1908, to 5th Feb., 1909; treas. and comnstr. of stamps, Ceylon, 6th Feb., 1909; is also ch. comnstr. of loan bd., a dir. of the W. and O. pension fund, chmn. of rly. advisory bd., and mem. of exec. and legis. couns.; author of "A Guide to the examination of Government Accounts in Cyprus."

SENNETT, CEDRIC WILLIAM ARTHUR.—B. 1890; ed. Plymouth Coll., Edinburgh Univ. and non-collegiate, Oxford (B.A., 1913); cadet, S. Sttlmts., 1914; ag. 4th mag., Singapore, 1915; asst. censor, 1916; asst. regist., impts. and expts., 1917; asst. supt., govt. monopolies, 1920; ag. priv. sec. to ch. sec., F.M.S., 1920; asst. dist. offr., Kuala Lipis, 1920; ag. dist. offr., Raub, 1921.

SERGEANT, JOHN.—Ed. at Athelhampton schl., Birkdale; chief acutt., pub. wks. dept., E. Africa Prot', 30th May, 1905.

SERTSIOS, B. D.—B. 1876; ed., Athens; Ph.D., University of Athens; B.A., Greek College, Serres; barrister-at-law, Middle Temple, 1909; judge, dist. ct., Cyprus, 1939.

SETH, G. G.—B.A., Calcutta; cadet, S. S., Nov., 1901; ag. sheriff, Singapore, Jan., 1913; passed final exam. in Malay, Jan., 1903; ag. 3rd mag., Singapore, 5th May, 1904; ag. dep. regist., sup. ct., Singapore, July, 1904; ag. dist. offr., N. Tebal, June, 1906; ag. dep. regist., sup. ct., Penang, Sept., 1906; ast. to atty.-gen., Apr., 1907; ast. to atty.-gen., 15th Dec., 1910; offr. of Cls. IV., F.M.S., 6th Dec., 1912; collr. war tax, Singapore, 26th Mar., 1917; supernumerary offr. of Cls. III., F.M.S., 1st Jan., 1918; offr. ast. to atty.-gen., Singapore, Nov., 1918; ag. dep. pub. prosecutor in addition, May, 1919; has held numerous acting appts.

SEVERN, CLAUD, C.M.G. (1917).—B. 1869; M.A. Cantab.; temporary clk. in librarian's dept., foreign office, Mar., 1891, to June, 1892; priv. sec. to gov., S. Sttlmts., Feb., 1894; junr. offr., Selangor, Dec., 1895; passed in Malay and law, 1898; ast. dist. offr., Ulu Langat, Selangor, June, 1897; ast. dist. offr., Serendah, May, 1899; ag. mag., Kuala Lumpur, 1900; ast. sec. to res. gen., F.M.S., Aug., 1903; ag. fed. sec., F.M.S., Apr. to Nov., 1905; ag. dist. offr., Ulu Langat, Dec., 1906, to Apr., 1907; ag. sec. to high comnstr., F.M.S. and priv. sec. to gov., S. Sttlmts., May, 1907; sec. to high comnstr., Malay States, Feb., 1911; col. sec., Hong Kong, Feb., 1912; admstd. govt., 16th Mar. to 3rd July, 1912, 21st Aug. to 24th Dec., 1913, 6th Nov. to 8th Dec., 1916, 10th Nov. to 16th Dec., 1917, and from 12th Sept., 1913 to 29th Sept., 1919; L.L.D., Hong Kong; col. sec., Hong Kong, Jan., 1921; admstd. govt., 8th Apr. to May, 1921.

SEVIGNY, HON. ALBERT, K.C.—B. 1881; ed. Nicolet and Valleyfield (Quebec) Colls. and Laval
SEYMOUR, ALFRED WALLACE.—B. 1881; ed. Warwick Schi., and St. Andrews Univ.; cadet, Ceylon civ. ser., Nov., 1905; off. ast. to govt. agt., N.W. Prov., Mar., 1906; N.C. Prov., Apl., 1907; W. Prov., Nov., 1908; ast. govt. agt., Mullaitivu, Aug., 1910; ditto, Trincomalee, June, 1911; ast. govt. agt., Mullaitivu, Dec., 1912; ditto, Nuwara Eliva, Jan., 1913; ditto, Matale, Sept., 1915; on mil. duty, June, 1916; dist. judge, Chilaw, Aug., 1919; ast. govt. agt., Kegalla, Mar., 1920; ag. govt. ast., N.C. Prov., May, 1921.

SEYMOUR-HALL, CYRIL WILLIAM, F.R.G.S.—B. 1897; prob. flight offr., R.N.A.S., 1917; flight sub-lieut., R.N., 1917; lieut., R.N.A.F., 1918; ment. in des., 1919; demob., 1919; ast. dist. commr., Zanzibar, 1921.

SHANKLAND, WALTER CHARLES.—Clerical ast., P.W.D., Br. Guiana, Oct., 1886; engnr.'s ast., P.W.D., 5th Oct., 1887; 3rd cls. acctnt.'s branch, P.W.D., 23rd May, 1889; 4th cls. elk., ditto, 1st Apr., 1892; 3rd cls. offr. and elk. of wks., in charge of P.W.D., Essequibo dist., 9th Nov., 1895; student, Middle Temple, 1900; passed final bar exam., 1900; 2nd cls. offr. and elk., in charge of P.W.D., Essequibo dist., 30th Mar., 1906; ch. elk., local govt. bd., 1st Dec., 1906; 1st cls. offr. and elk. in charge of P.W.D., Demerara dist., 5th Sept., 1906; sec., local govt. bd., and inspr. of dists., 22nd Sept., 1908; attached to L.G.B., London, 1911; ag. stip. mag., 24th Oct., 1912 to 17th Feb., 1914, and from 15th Mar. to 12th Oct., 1914; apptd. by govt. to report on finances of town coun. of New Amsterdam, 1914; commr. to administer oaths to affidavits, 17th Apr., 1914; mem. bd. of agric., 1914; J.P. for the col., 1915; recd. thanks of L.G.B. on two occasions for special work carried out for the bd.

SHANNON, C. M.—B. 1869; clerical ast., P.W.D., Br. Guiana, Oct., 1888; 5th cls. elk., G.P.O., June, 1889; ditto, treasy., June, 1890; 4th cls. elk., ditto July, 1893; ag. acctnt., mines dept., June, 1893 to Mar., 1894; govt. offr. (mining regns.) and J.P., Apr., 1897; 3rd grade land survs., lands and mines dept., Aug., 1902; 3rd cls. elk., ditto, Feb., 1903; 2nd cls. elk., audit dept., Aug., 1908; ag. acctnt., G.P.O., July to Sept., 1911; ag. paymaster of police, June, 1913 to Mar., 1914; 1st cls. elk., audit dept., Aug., 1913.

SHARPE, HAMNET HOLDITCH.—B. 1864; entd. R. Navy, 1880; served in H.M.S. "Tourmaline" and numerous other ships (Egypt, medal, 1882, and Khedive's Bronze Star); sec. to comdr.-in-chief, Pacific station, 1899-1900; ditto, Australia station, 1901-1903; priv. sec. to gov. of N.S. Wales, May, 1903; priv. sec. to gov.-gen. of Australia, 22nd Nov., 1904.

SHARPE, SIR ALFRED, K.C.M.G. (1903), C.B. (1897).—B. 1853; H.M.'s vice-consul, Nyasaland, 14th Feb., 1891; ditto, for territories under British influence North of the Zambesi, 18th Feb., 1893; consul for same territories, 1st Feb., 1894; ag. commr. and consul-gen. at Zomba, 7th May, 1894, to 3rd May, 1895; given rank of deputy commr., 1st Apl., 1896; and again acted as commr. and consul-gen., 16th Apl., 1896, to 14th July, 1897; commr. and consul-gen., for territories under Brit. infl. N. of Zambesi, 15th July, 1897; recd. Jubilee medal, 1897; commr. commdr.-in-chief, and commr.-gen., Br. Cent. Africa Prot., 1st Jan., 1902; recd. Coronation medal, 1902; gov. of Nyasaland (late B.C.A. Prot.), 6th Sept., 1907; ret., 1910; represented E. African Prot. at the Coronation of H.M. King George V., 1911.

SHARPE, H. B.—Temp. ast. dist. commr., E. Africa Prot., Apl., 1919.

SHARPE, RICHARD.—B. 1882; ed. Sexey Schi., Somt. (Somt. county jur. and inter. scholarship) and hon. mention senir. scholarship); entd. Impl. cust. serv. by open compet. exam., and appld. to London, 1903; London Univ. cert. polit. economy with sp. distinc. in exchange, finance and taxation, 1907; seconded to govt. of Liberia as sub-inspr., cust., 1908-10; ch. inspr. cust. and finan. adviser, 1911-12; Br. receiver of Liberian cust., 1911-19; offr. recr., liquidating German property in Liberia, 1917-18; knighted comdr., Order of African Redemption, 1918; treas., Dominica, Feb., 1920; mem. of exec. and legis. couns., collr. of cust. and excise, regier. of shipping, chunn., quarantine bd., Impl. trade corresp.

SHAW, GEORGE ERNEST, O.B.E. (1919).—B. 1877; ed. Trin. Coll., Dublin; scholar and sen. moderator in classics; vice-chancellor's prize man in English prose; B.A., LL.B.; cadet, F.M.S., civ. ser., 1900; collr. of land rev., Krian, 1901; mag. 1st cls., Perak, 1903; offr. of Cls. V., F.M.S., 1st Jan., 1906; collr. of land rev., Lower Perak, 1908; adviser, land office, Kedah, and supt. of mines, 1911; offr. of Cls. IV., F.M.S., 1st Jan., 1912; supernumerary offr. of Cls. III., F.M.S., 1st Jan., 1918; lent to War Office, directorate of prisoners of war, Aug., 1916; adviser, land off., Kedah, 19th July, 1919.

SHAW, WALTER SIDNEY.—B. 1863; ed. Brighton Coll. and Trin. Coll., Camb.; called to the bar, Middle Temple, 1888; pol. mag. and ag. chief just., St. Vincent, 1906; mem. exec. and legis. couns.; confirmed as chief just., 1907; ag. chief just., Grenada, Feb., 1908, to June, 1909; revised and consolidated laws of St. Vincent, 1912; admstr. govt. of St. Vincent, June, 1911, to Jan., 1912, and for various shorter periods; chief just., R. Honduras, 1912; puiana justice, Ceylon, Aug., 1914; ag. chief just., June to Oct., 1916.

SHAWE, HENRY BENJAMIN, I.S.O. (1917).—Cik. at Clanwilliam, Cape Colony, 12th May, 1883; col. sec.'s off., Cape Town, Dec., 1883; sen. examnr. of acctnts., 14th Apl., 1890; chief ditto, 1st July, 1894; acctnt., 10th July, 1895; acctng. offr., 31st Mar., 1899; ch. elk. and acting offr., 1st Mar., 1901; ast. under col. sec., 1st Apl., 1902; ag. undersec. for agric., Sept., 1907, to Mar., 1908; mem. of Rhodesian pub. serv. bd. of enquiry, Apl. to Sep., 1909; under-sec. for the Interior, Union of S.Africa, May, 1910; ag. sec. for the Interior, 28th Sept., 1914; sec. for the Interior, 1st Oct., 1919.

SHEA, THE HON. GEORGE.—M.H.A., Ferryland (Newfild.), 1889-93; again in 1897; mem. exec. coun. (without portfolio), 1897; mem. of treasy. bd., 1898; mayor of St. John's, 1902; mem. exec. coun. 1904.

SHEARMAN-TURNER, PERCY.—B. 1874; ed. at Forest Schi. and Exeter Coll., Oxford; B.A., 1894; M.A., 1898; called to the bar, Inner Temple, 1897; Oxford Circuit, C.C.C.; recorder of titles, E.A.P., 1907 to 1910; ag. dep. prin. regier. of documents and admstr.-gen., 1908 to 1909; legal mem. of coun. and atty.-gen., Zanzibar, 14th Oct., 1910; ag. ast. judge, 7th Aug., 1913; ag. ch. judge, 7th Mar., 1919.
SHEEDY, FREDERICK JOHN, M.B.E., B.Sc., M.R.C.V.S.—late capt., E.A.P. forces; ent. army, A.V.C. 1911; vety. offr., E.A.P., July, 1914; served throughout Great War, 5th Aug., 1914 to 22nd Sept., 1919 (E. Africa Mounted Rifles and E.A.V.C.); adjutant, E.A.V.C., 9th Jan., 1916; M.B.E. (mil.), 1918, "1914-15" Star, Brit. War med., Victory med.; dep. ch. vety. offr., Tanganyika Territory, 31st Oct., 1919; ag. ch. vety. offr., May, 1920 to Mar., 1921.

SHEEHAN, JOHN JOSEPH.—B. 1896; ed. Christian schls., Dublin Univ. and Univ. Coll., Dublin.—Pte., Artists Rifles, Dec., 1916; 2nd Heut., R.F.A., Sept., 1917; demob., May, 1919; cadet, F.M.S.; Mar., 1920; ag. 2nd ast. adviser, Munar, Mar., 1921.

SHEDDON, HUGH FREDERICK, M.R.C.S., L.R.C.P., D.P.H. (Manch.)—Ed. Manchester Grain Schl. and Owen's Coll.; civ. surg., H.M. forces, and capt. and M.O., Health Border Pol., 1901-6; dist. surg. and M.O.H., Ladybrand, 1906-14; 37th Field Ambulance, France, 1915-16; regt. temp. maj., R.A.M.C., 1st Western Gen. Hosp., 1917; ast. health offr., Union of S. Africa, 1920.

SHELDON, ROBERT PAUL.—B. 1889; ed. Harrow and in Germany; ag. vice-consul, Ghent, 1905; ag. vice-consul, Havre, 1906-7; ag. consul, Bordeaux, 1907; ast. collr., Zanzibar, 27th Dec., 1907; sec. to first minister, 1909-10; collr. (now dist. consnr.), Pembes, 16th Oct., 1912; ag. mag., 30th Aug., 1915; ag. ch. sec., 5th Mar. to 17th Nov., 1919; 4th cls., Order of the Aliyeh and 3rd cls., Order of the Brilliant Star of Zanzibar.

SHEPHERD, FREDERICK REZUS.—B. 1859; sup't of Skerrett's training schl., Antigua, Leeward Is., 1891-1905; curator and agric. sup't., St. Kitts, Nevis, Feb., 1904; ag. sup't., sugar cane experiments, Antigua, 1899-1904; deleg. to various agric. confrs. held by Impl. commr.; ag. sup't. of agric., Leeward Is., July to Nov., 1910.

SHEPARD, WALTER SYDNEY, B.A., M.B., B.Ch. (Cantab.).—B. 1871; civil surg. in charge of H.M.'s troops, N.E. dist., Eng., May, 1898, to May, 1899; spec plague med. offr., India, May, 1899, to Nov., 1900; house surg., gen. hosp., Singapore, 19th Nov., 1900; super. col. surg., S. Stithms, 1st Mar., 1901; spec. mission to Brunei, Aug., 1904; col. surg., Prov. Wesley, Aug., 1905; senior med. offr., Singapore, July, 1911.

SHERGOLD, F. Y.—B. 1900; app'td. after compet. exam., ast. clk., C.O., 10th Jan., 1920.

SHERIDAN, JOSEPH.—Ed. at Castletown Coll. and Trin. Coll., Dublin; called to the bar, Ireland, 1907, went Connaught circuit; judg. olk., Nasaland Prot., July, 1908; ag. atty.-gen., Nov., 1908, to Jan., 1910; ag. judge of high ct., Dec., 1909, to Jan., 1910; ag. atty.-gen., July, 1911, to Mar., 1912; app'td. ast. to atty.-gen., Apl., 1912; ag. atty.-gen., Aug., 1912; town mag., E.A.P., 1913; ag. puisne judge, July, 1914.

SHERWOOD, SIR ARTHUR PENCEY, K.C.M.G. (1916), C.M.G., M.V.O., A.D.C.—B. 1854; sup't. of Dominion pol., Canada, 1882; commr., Dominion pol., 1888; ed. commr. of pol. of Canada, 1911; res. 11th June, 1919.

SHERWOOD, MONTAGUE EARLE, M.B.E.—B. 1884; cadet, S. Stithms., 21st Oct., 1907; attached to col. sec.'s office, 1st Jan., 1908; attached to land office, Singapore, 23rd Jan., 1908; dep. collr. of land reg. and dep. regt. of deeds, Singapore, 31st Jan., 1908; ag. dist. offr., Labuan, 29th Jan. to 16th Nov., 1909; attached to dist. office, Alor Gajah, 28th Dec., 1910; passed final exam. in Malay, Jan., 1911; passed cadet, 1911; attached to land office, Malacca, 1911; ag. dist. offr., Jasim, 7th Apr., of Cls. V., 13th May, 1911; ag. dist. ms 15th Oct., 1913; ag. dist. offr., Alor Feb., 1914; ag. ast. to rec., Malacca 1913; ag. harbour-mast., Malacca, in other duties, 26th Jan., 1916; pri A.D.C. to gov., 1st Aug., 1916; offr. 16th Nov., 1919; ag. priv. sec. to H.I. Feb., 1920; ag. sec. to high consnr., 1920.

SHIELD, CHARLES GEOFFREY.—B. mily. service (France) 1914-18; on sts priv. secy. to gov., and clk. to couns., 1920.
